schemes.name: Community Dairy Farming Scheme (Amended 2019)
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Registered community groups (min 5 unrelated members) setting up dairy farms of min 50 milch animals
schemes.eligibility: Group of minimum 5 members registered with competent authority; must possess irrigated land for green fodder at min 5 acres for 50 animals besides infrastructure area; only for new units; each member resident of Goa for at least preceding five years with experience in dairy management; all members need practical training certificate in dairy management. Group must complete project within six months of sanction, run unit min 10 years; fodder cultivation at least two months before animal purchase; animals from Cattle Mela at Govt Livestock Farms or outside State, microchipped, insured 42 months.
schemes.benefit: One-time subsidy @ 50% of permissible unit cost, limited to maximum Rs. 1 Crore, for plant, machinery and milch animals. Unit cost caps: cattle shed 270 sq. m for 50 animals @ Rs. 6000/- per sq. m; cow dung pit 90 cu. m @ Rs. 2500/- per cu. m; store room 80 sq. m @ Rs. 6000/- per sq. m; milch animals Rs. 70,000/- each (cross bred cows, improved she buffaloes, Sahiwal, Gir, Red Sindhi); transport Rs. 600/- per animal (Govt farm Cattle Mela) or Rs. 1500/- (outside State); bulk milk cooler (min 3000 L) Rs. 10,00,000/-; milk parlour 8 points Rs. 20,00,000/-; 20 KVA generator Rs. 7,00,000/-; feed mixing plant (min 1000 kg/day) Rs. 10,00,000/-; other dairy equipment Rs. 4,25,000/- for 50 cows (Annexure I); insurance premium max Rs. 14,455/- per animal for 42 months.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed application form through Area Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer with non-refundable processing fee Rs. 500/-. Full project report plus: land documents (Form I & XIV/sale deed/notarized lease/NOC), NOC and construction licence, group registration certificate, letter from financing institution with ECS, residence certificates (5 years), Aadhar of each member, training certificates, photos, site plan, notarized authority to group leader, member details. Subsidy released by ECS after completion and inspection by Departmental Committee; agreement bond required.
schemes.later_amendments: 10-06-2019 – Community Dairy Farming Scheme (Amended 2019); 2021-07-26 – Community Dairy Farming Scheme (Amended 2021); 22-07-2021 – Community Dairy Farming Scheme (Amended 2021)
schemes.notes: Notification No. 13-102/AHVS/CDFS/19-20/1296; restated amended scheme superseding notification No. 13-102/AHVS/CDFS/16-17/1655 dated 30-06-2016 (approved U.O. dated 20-02-2019). schemes.name: Development of Horticulture 2018
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Horticulture cultivators across all talukas of Goa
schemes.eligibility: All owners of land willing to cultivate agricultural/horticultural crops, name in Krishi Card abstract as owner or with right of cultivation; land in own name, inherited, or leased for not less than ten years (valid lease of at least 8 years on application date; two years for annual flowers and vegetables). Minimum area 0.1 ha for coconut, mango, pineapple, papaya, cashew, chickoo, kokum, guava, breadfruit, jackfruit, banana and spices; 0.05 ha for flowers and vegetables; no minimum for fruit plants to households, kitchen gardens and vegetable seeds.
schemes.benefit: Coconut area expansion: 75% of cost of cultivation limited to Rs. 50,000/- per ha (max 5.0 ha per beneficiary), 60:40 instalments over two years. Banana/Pineapple/Papaya: 75% up to Rs. 1,20,000/- per ha (max 4.0 ha), 75:25 instalments. Flowers: 75% limited to Rs. 1,20,000/- per ha for bulbous/perennial; Rs. 75,000/- per ha for loose flowers (max 4 ha). Fruits/Spices: 75% limited to Rs. 60,000/- per ha. Vegetable seeds: 50% subsidy at source; seedlings: 75% subsidy at source. Fruit plants for homestead garden: one or two plants free per household (cost not exceeding Rs. 150), ceiling Rs. 1.50 lakhs per constituency; schools, colleges, NGOs, clubs up to 200 plants. GOI subsidy adjusted, balance under State Sector.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit application in prescribed format with Krishi Card abstract copy; use quality planting material from registered nurseries; submit bills and receipts on completion; site inspected by Zonal Agricultural Officer.
schemes.valid_period: Retrospective from 1-4-2018 until withdrawn
schemes.notes: Department of Agriculture notification No. 3/3/Hort/SSS/1/2018-19/D.Agri/185 found inside this AH&VS portal document (header department kept per instructions). notified_on is Gazette issue date. Per-hectare rates; no single per-beneficiary rupee cap stated. Trimmed: details may be on later pages.

Not applicable to poultry bird traders, egg traders, hatcheries, integrated farmers, contract farmers; farm must not be managed by integration/contract farming nor used for trading; broilers and layers not permitted on one common premises; not entitled to feed transport subsidy along with this scheme; no bills prior to notification.
schemes.benefit: Recurring assistance for rearing L.I.T. birds till growing stage: 20% of poultry feed cost limited to 400 kg feed per month with 200 birds in house; 80% of day old chick cost limited to 100 day old Low Input chicks per month. Maximum per month: feed Rs. 1600/- + chicks Rs. 2400/- = Rs. 4,000/-. Entitlement per Annexure-III.
schemes.how_to_apply: Approach Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director of the area for Registration Form (on website); register farm with Dept of AH&VS (mandatory); bank account linked with Aadhaar for DBT; submit original purchase bills within 30 days through Area Officer, bank passbook copy, livestock and feed registers countersigned by Area VO/AD, certificate of no integration/contract farming. Assistance by DBT only.
schemes.notes: Portal title refers to the Infrastructure scheme, but the extracted text covers the Rearing scheme (same gazette issue as cef82892e8). Notification No. 2-5(4)/2018-19 dated 5th November 2018, Official Gazette Series I No. 32 dated 8-11-2018; approved U.O. No. 1380 dated 29-6-2018. Trimmed: Annexure details partly cut. max_benefit_inr is the per-month maximum.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to Dairy Farmers belonging to Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Caste for purchase of basic dairy equipments
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: SC/ST dairy farmers
schemes.eligibility: Farmer belonging to Scheduled Tribes/Scheduled Caste community; must have at least two milch animals (local/indigenous/cross bred cows, local/improved buffaloes); resident of Goa for at least five preceding years; must not have availed subsidy under any Government of Goa scheme for the equipment applied for. One time assistance per family.
schemes.benefit: 100% subsidy for dairy items of general use, subject to maximum of Rs. 30,000/- or actual cost, whichever is lower (items include SS cans, 500 L water tank, calf nipple bucket, spray pump, steel buckets, 0.5 HP water pump, ceiling fans, steel vessels, spade, grooming brush, gamelas, nylon rope, sickle, pickaxe, rubber mat; total Rs. 30,000). Proportionate subsidy for limited purchase; credited directly to bank account. Replaces the existing Dairy Kit Scheme.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed application form in duplicate through local Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director with caste certificate, Aadhaar consent form, 5 years residential certificate, 2 passport photos, notarised affidavit, ration card copy, bank pass book copy. No processing fee. Officer forwards to Directorate of AH&VS, Patto-Panaji within 15 days; after approval submit original bills within 90 days; subsidy released within 60 days.
schemes.notes: Notification No. 2-5(3)AH/2021-22/5310; notified_on is Gazette issue date (Series I No. 38); Finance concurrence U.O. dated 01-11-2021 and 19-11-2021. Equipment must be used for minimum 3 years. The same gazette extract also contains an amendment of 'Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi' (Directorate of Art & Culture; aged/needy and pandemic-affected Goan artists; e.g. medical up to Rs. 50,000, house damage up to Rs. 25,000, funeral up to Rs. 10,000) - not extracted as a separate row. Trimmed: details may be on later pages.

schemes.name: Goatery Scheme — Assistance for Goat Rearing
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Goat farmers resident in Goa (unemployed youth, women, small farmers)
schemes.eligibility: Any farmer residing for minimum 5 years in the State; should have undergone training in Goat Management; should have goat shed at height approx. 1.5 m from ground, min 30 sq. m, flooring of bamboo/matti and roof of tiles/sheets/straw. Application asks whether applicant/family availed subsidy from the Department for other AH schemes earlier.
schemes.benefit: Unit of 10 does + 1 buck (5 pregnant, 5 empty, age 1-2 yrs). Female goat max cost Rs. 6000/- (max 20 kg @ Rs. 300/kg), subsidy @ 75% = Rs. 4500/- each, Rs. 45,000/- for 10; buck max cost Rs. 7,500/- (max 25 kg), subsidy 75% = Rs. 5625/-. Goat unit cost limited to Rs. 67,500/-, one-time subsidy 75% = Rs. 50,625/-. Shed cost approx. Rs. 30,300/- subsidized @ 75% = Rs. 22,725/-. Feed cost for one year Rs. 78,292/- (11 animals). Total unit cost (animals+shed+feed) Rs. 1,76,092/-, subsidy @ 75% = Rs. 1,32,069/-. Transport incentive Rs. 2,000/- (within State) or Rs. 5,000/- (outside State) or actual cost whichever is lower. Payment through ECS.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application form to Directorate of AH&VS; verified/recommended within 15 days by area Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director after site visit. Documents: Residence Certificate (min 5 years) from Mamlatdar, Aadhar consent form, training certificate, land ownership (Form I & XIV) or 3-year lease deed or 3-year NOC from land owner, passport photo; on approval Bond and Affidavit (Annexure I & II). Feed bills to be submitted quarterly in triplicate certified by AD/Local VO.
schemes.notes: Notification No. 2-3(15)/2018-19/6795 (index lists 2-3(5)/2018-19/6/95, OCR). Signing date not in extract; notified_on is Official Gazette Series I No. 46 issue date. Trimmed: details may be on later pages. Same scheme as doc 90662ec6bf.

schemes.name: Gopal Ratna Award Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Dairy farmers with highest individual milk production
schemes.eligibility: Individual Goan dairy farmer with extraordinary contribution/highest milk production; member of a Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/SHG registered with the Department; dairy farm registered with AH&VS through Area Officer; maintains records of animals, lactation, yield, calving etc.; bonafide resident of Goa for at least preceding five years; owns cattle shed with milch animals in Goa; produced and poured minimum 1 lakh litres of milk in preceding year (April-March) with minimum average 250 litres per day to the Dairy Co-op Society/Bachat Gat/SHG. No posthumous award (except if death occurs after application).
schemes.benefit: Gopal Ratna Award: Certificate of appreciation, Memento and cash prize of Rs. 1 lakh only, conferred on Independence Day by the Chief Minister.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through concerned Area Officer in prescribed format (Annexure-I) with residence certificate (min five years) from Mamlatdar, Aadhar copy, 2 photos, mandate form/bank passbook copy; Area Officer recommends to Director AH&VS; Task Force Committee scrutinizes and visits.
schemes.notes: Notification No. 1-1(23)/AHVS/Gopal Tatna/16-17/903 dated Panaji 20th May 2016, published Gazette Series I No. 9 dated 02-06-2016; in force with immediate effect. Gazette extract also contains unrelated Forest, Elections and TCP notifications. Trimmed: details may be on later pages.

schemes.name: Gramashakti - Supply of Low Input Technology Poultry Birds to Rural Farmers (2018)
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Rural farmers (preferably women) with backyard for poultry
schemes.eligibility: Any individual rural farmer, preferably women, with facility to rear poultry in backyard; Goan residents in hired/rented houses with backyard can avail (proof of backyard to VO). Once a year per beneficiary (eligible again after 365 days from first supply); must keep birds min 12 months, no transfer. Not for beneficiaries of Establishment of Backyard Poultry Unit (Special Component Plan for SC & ST); not for poultry/egg traders, hatcheries, integrated or contract farmers; no rearing with broilers/layers or trading on same premises.
schemes.benefit: Free grown up L.I.T. birds (09 females + 01 male, above seven weeks, vaccinated) @ Rs. 80/- = Rs. 800/- plus 10 kg poultry feed @ Rs. 20/- = Rs. 200/-; total Rs. 1,000/- per family (husband, wife and unmarried children) per year, collected from Government Poultry Farm, Ela, Old Goa.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application form (Form Poultry C-2018, on website) from Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director of the area, submitted to VO for onward submission to Director with recommendation; Director issues sanction through VO; beneficiary collects birds at own cost from Govt Poultry Farm, Ela, Old Goa with personal identity.
schemes.valid_period: In force from date of notification in the Gazette
schemes.notes: Notification No. 2-5(6)/2018-19/6378; signing date not in extract, notified_on is Official Gazette Series I No. 43 issue date; Finance concurrence U.O. No. 1400051845 dated 10-01-2019. Intended to benefit 2000 rural farmers. Same gazette contains an unrelated Higher Education scheme (financial support for seminars/workshops, valid up to March 2023) - not extracted; its validity does not apply here. Trimmed.

schemes.name: Incentive to Dairy Farmers for Renovation /Repair of Cattle Shed
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Dairy farmers in Western Ghats area with 5+ milk animals
schemes.eligibility: All farmers in the Western Ghats Area having minimum five milk animals irrespective of income status; farmers who availed such benefits in past not eligible; must produce Form 1 & 14 or NOC from landlord of at least 5 years. Bank finance not required.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy of Rs. 15,000 on completion and verification of renovation/repair (shed incl. manger and flooring, drainage system, dung pit, water storage tank).
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit prescribed application form to local Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director with Form 1 & 14/NOC/lease deed, cattle shed plan, NOC from Panchayat for repair/renovation, photo of existing shed; after approval and completion, VO/AD issues utilization certificate with photo and bills to Head Office.
schemes.notes: One-page summary; no notification date. Panchayat NOC required but no processing role for panchayat.

schemes.name: Interest subsidy on loans for Agriculture and Allied Activities
schemes.target: Farmers, animal husbandry and fisheries borrowers in Goa
schemes.eligibility: All bonafide agriculturists, individuals under animal husbandry sector and fisheries sector, with or without Kisan Credit Cards, from the State of Goa. Loans of Rs. 5.00 lakhs and below sanctioned after the date of notification; cumulative ceiling Rs. 5.00 lakhs per beneficiary (one or more loans, one or more purposes). Repayment of principal and interest must be regular (subsidy stopped on default). Sectors: agriculture incl. horticulture, animal husbandry, fisheries, processing and marketing of agricultural produce. Eligible irrespective of other Government subsidies for the activity.
schemes.benefit: Rate of interest to farmers will be 4%; interest over and above this ceiling charged by the lending institution is borne by Government as interest subsidy, released directly to the institution (quarterly). Subsidy for a maximum period of five years on short, medium and long term loans. Lending institutions: Nationalized Banks, Scheduled Commercial Banks, Goa State Co-operative Bank and Primary Agricultural Co-operatives (PACs).
schemes.how_to_apply: Farmers under Agriculture and Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services apply directly to banks with requisite documentation; fisheries loan applicants apply through the nearest office of the Directorate of Fisheries, which scrutinizes and forwards them to banks. Bank branches claim subsidy quarterly from the Director of Agriculture / Animal Husbandry / Fisheries.
schemes.valid_period: Initially three years, to be reviewed for continuation
schemes.later_amendments: 12-09-2017 – Interest subsidy on loans for Agriculture and Allied Activities - extension 2017-18; 20-09-2016 – Interest subsidy on loans for Agriculture and Allied Activities - Krishi Card amendment and extension 2016-17; 2023-12-15 – Interest subsidy on loans for Agriculture and Allied activities (amendment)
schemes.notes: Original notification No. 3/4/ISA/2008-09/D.Agri/353 dated 2-3-2009 (Official Gazette Series I No. 51, 19-3-2009). Rs. 5.00 lakh is the loan ceiling, not a subsidy amount, so max_benefit_inr left null. OCR text; scheme text cut off at Budget head. Same gazette bundle also contains unrelated Education notifications (RTE HIV child category, Bal Rath honorarium) and the start of a Human Resource Development in Agriculture notification (truncated).

amendments.name: Interest subsidy on loans for Agriculture and Allied activities (amendment)
amendments.notes: Notification No. 3/5/EXTN/137/2017-18/D.Agri/387; text is struck-through/garbled OCR; amendment content unreadable.

amendments.name: Interest subsidy on loans for Agriculture and Allied Activities - extension 2017-18
amendments.benefit: Scheme extended for further period of one year w.e.f. 1-4-2017 to 31-3-2018.
amendments.notes: Notification No. 3/5/EXTN/137/2017/D.Agri/407, Official Gazette Series I No. 25 dated 21-9-2017. OCR text.

amendments.name: Interest subsidy on loans for Agriculture and Allied Activities - Krishi Card amendment and extension 2016-17
amendments.benefit: Notification /382 adds Krishi Card requirement; notification /383 extends the scheme for further period of one year w.e.f. 01-04-2016 to 31-3-2017.
amendments.notes: Two notifications dated 20-9-2016 (Nos. 3/5/EXTN/137/2016-17/D.Agri/382 and /383), Official Gazette Series I No. 26 dated 29-9-2016.

schemes.name: Piggery Development (For 20 Sows and Two Boars)
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Farmers setting up piggery units
schemes.eligibility: Any farmer residing for minimum 15 years in the state. Unit of 20 sows and 2 boars set up within 3 months of sanction; unit not closed for minimum 3 years (bond) / rear unit minimum 6 years (agreement).
schemes.benefit: Approved unit cost Rs.1,97,500/- of which Rs.49,375/- is subsidy; maximum subsidy admissible 25% of unit cost.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit prescribed application to Directorate of A.H.&V.S. through Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director with NOC from Village Panchayat; own finance or bank loan (subsidy to loan account); release on utilization certificate, bills/vouchers certified by valuer/engineer, purchase receipts with health certificate, bond, agreement, certified Aadhaar copy.
schemes.notes: No notification date. Piglets from Government Piggery Farm, Curti Ponda. Inconsistent minimum periods (3 years bond vs 6 years rearing). Village Panchayat NOC required (no processing role).

schemes.name: Revised Modern Dairy Scheme - Farm Equipment for existing unit
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Existing dairy farmers with 10 adult milch animals
schemes.eligibility: Any farmer having 10 adult milch animals (residence in Goa at least 15 years per scheme eligibility).
schemes.benefit: Milking Machine (electrically operated): 30% of cost subject to maximum Rs.15,600/-. Chaff cutter (electrically operated): 25% of cost subject to maximum Rs.3000/-.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply on plain paper to Area Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director; submit original bill of purchase for release of subsidy.
schemes.notes: No notification date.

schemes.name: Revised Modern Dairy Scheme - Financial Assistance for establishment of Modern Dairy Farm and purchase of Dairy Farm Equipments
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Individuals setting up/expanding dairy units (educated unemployed rural youth)
schemes.eligibility: Any person residing in Goa for at least 15 years. Minimum unit size 10 cross-bred cows or 10 adult improved she-buffaloes; unit located in Goa; maintained minimum 10 years; animals purchased from outside Goa; new equipment only.
schemes.benefit: 30% of cost of plant and machinery as subsidy subject to maximum of Rs.4.50 lakhs for new dairy farm, expansion, modern equipment for existing units and renovation of cattle shed. Cost limits: cattle shed Rs.4,000/sq.mt (54 sq.mt for 10 animals), dung pit Rs.300/cu.mt, store room Rs.4,000/sq.mt, milch animal Rs.18,000/- each, milking machine Rs.82,000/- (subsidy 30%, max Rs. 24,600/-), water pump Rs.14,000/-, A.I. crate 5,000/-, other items Rs.8000/-, chaff cutter subsidy 30% max Rs. 3,600/-, cow chains etc Rs. 10,000/- for 10 animals.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit project report to Director of A.H.&V.S. through Area Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director with Form 1 & XIV or lease deed/landlord NOC (min. 10 years) and NOC from Municipality/Panchayat. After completion submit construction bills, animal purchase receipts with health certificate, original equipment receipts, insurance documents; agreement with Dept. If loan availed, subsidy released through financing institution.
schemes.notes: No notification date. NOC from Municipality/Panchayat required (no processing role). Milking machine max differs between new-unit list (Rs.24,600) and existing-unit component (Rs.15,600).

schemes.name: Revised Scheme for Incentives to Milk Producers
schemes.department: Department Of Handicrafts, Textile And Coir
schemes.target: Dairy farmers who are members of Dairy Co-operative Societies/Bachat Gat/SHGs
schemes.eligibility: Farmers from Goa who are members of Dairy Co-operative Societies/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group registered with Dept. of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services; bonafide resident of Goa for at least preceding 5 years; own cattle shed with milch animals in Goa registered with AH&VS (via Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital); must produce own milk (not procured from others); proof of membership; UID card mandatory; must be registered with Agriculture Department as Agriculturist (text truncated).
schemes.benefit: Composite subsidy @ 40% (incentive on milk @ 32.28% & cattle feed @ 7.72%) on the proceeds of milk supplied to the Dairy Co-operative Society/Bachat Gat/Self Help Group, paid monthly through ECS to beneficiary bank account.
schemes.how_to_apply: Register dairy farm with AH&VS through respective Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital using Registration Form; society/Bachat Gat/SHG submits monthly consolidated report (by 8th of following month) to area Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director; bank account with CBS/ECS required.
schemes.notes: Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services Notification 7-7(47)/AH/2015-16/6529, Gazette Series I No. 49 dated 03-03-2016; supersedes Notification 7-7(47)/AH/2012-13/4040 dated 31-10-2012. Signing date not in extracted text. Linked to cattle feed subsidy scheme. Posted under HT&C because same gazette contains VKY renaming notification. Trimmed.

schemes.name: Scheme for Breeding of Local Cows in the State of Goa
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Owners of local (non-descript) cows, incl. NGOs
schemes.eligibility: All farmers availing Artificial Insemination for local cattle and registered with local Government Veterinary Services, irrespective of financial status; NGOs and other organizations availing A.I. to local cows; no limit on number of animals. Cow must be kept tied on A.I. day and two days after.
schemes.benefit: Cash incentive Rs.100/- per A.I. of local cow (only one repeat A.I. cycle incentivised); on confirmation of pregnancy, feed incentive @ 2.5 Kg per day per animal for six months from 4th month.
schemes.how_to_apply: No documents required; register all local cattle free with local Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital and intimate Veterinary Centre when animal is in heat; local Veterinary Doctor recommends feed incentive to Head Office.
schemes.notes: No notification date. Benefit is per A.I./per animal in cash and kind; no per-beneficiary rupee cap.

schemes.name: Scheme for Incentive to Green Fodder Cultivation (Amended) 2017-18 - Hydroponic green fodder production
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Dairy farmers with minimum 5 milch animals
schemes.eligibility: Any individual/farmer/agricultural labourer/Dairy Society/Farmers club/Self Help Group (Bachat Ghat) who arranges land (fallow, agricultural, marad land etc.) with Form I & XIV and affidavit. Beneficiaries who cultivated green fodder under existing Departmental scheme are eligible. Minimum area 500 sq. mt for perennial/seasonal fodder. For hydroponic fodder and silage making: minimum 5 milch animals and minimum 5 years residence in Goa. Must cultivate/set up within 2 months of approval; perennial plots to continue 2 more years; hydroponic/silage units run min. 3 years.
schemes.benefit: Incentive at 75% of hydroponic unit cost by category: 5 milch animals unit cost Rs. 50000/-; 10 milch animals Rs. 70,000/-; 20 milch animals Rs. 1,50,000/-. Plus maize seed incentive at 50%: Rs. 11250/-, Rs. 22,500/- or Rs. 45000/- per quarter (5/10/20 animals) for three years (twelve quarters).
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed form to Director of A.H.&V.S. through area Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer with residence certificate (Mamlatdar/Sarpanch/Dairy Society chairman, attested by VO/AD), Form I & XIV or notarized affidavit/land documents/NOC from landlord on Rs. 50 stamp paper, quotations, photo; show land to officer. Release on inspection report/utilization certificate, dated photographs, agreement bond, original bills.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: details may be on later pages. Scheme titled (Amended) 2017-18; no notification date in text. Tussocks available free from Govt Livestock Farm Dhat-Mollem, Cattle Breeding Farm Copardem, Fodder Seed Production Farm Kalay. Subsidy amounts on unit cost not computed in text (75% of listed unit costs); per-quarter maize seed incentive up to Rs.45,000.

schemes.name: Scheme for Incentive to Green Fodder Cultivation (Amended) 2017-18 - Seasonal fodder
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Farmers, dairy societies, SHGs cultivating seasonal green fodder
schemes.eligibility: Any individual/farmer/agricultural labourer/Dairy Society/Farmers club/Self Help Group (Bachat Ghat) who arranges land (fallow, agricultural, marad land etc.) with Form I & XIV and affidavit. Beneficiaries who cultivated green fodder under existing Departmental scheme are eligible. Minimum area 500 sq. mt for perennial/seasonal fodder. For hydroponic fodder and silage making: minimum 5 milch animals and minimum 5 years residence in Goa. Must cultivate/set up within 2 months of approval; perennial plots to continue 2 more years; hydroponic/silage units run min. 3 years.
schemes.benefit: Incentive @ Rs. 15,000/- per hectare of land per crop; minimum area 500 sq. mt.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed form to Director of A.H.&V.S. through area Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer with residence certificate (Mamlatdar/Sarpanch/Dairy Society chairman, attested by VO/AD), Form I & XIV or notarized affidavit/land documents/NOC from landlord on Rs. 50 stamp paper, quotations, photo; show land to officer. Release on inspection report/utilization certificate, dated photographs, agreement bond, original bills.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: details may be on later pages. Scheme titled (Amended) 2017-18; no notification date in text. Tussocks available free from Govt Livestock Farm Dhat-Mollem, Cattle Breeding Farm Copardem, Fodder Seed Production Farm Kalay. Rate per hectare per crop; no cap stated.

schemes.name: Scheme for Incentive to Green Fodder Cultivation (Amended) 2017-18 - Silage production
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Dairy farmers with minimum 5 milch animals making silage
schemes.eligibility: Any individual/farmer/agricultural labourer/Dairy Society/Farmers club/Self Help Group (Bachat Ghat) who arranges land (fallow, agricultural, marad land etc.) with Form I & XIV and affidavit. Beneficiaries who cultivated green fodder under existing Departmental scheme are eligible. Minimum area 500 sq. mt for perennial/seasonal fodder. For hydroponic fodder and silage making: minimum 5 milch animals and minimum 5 years residence in Goa. Must cultivate/set up within 2 months of approval; perennial plots to continue 2 more years; hydroponic/silage units run min. 3 years.
schemes.benefit: Incentive @ Rs. 2/- per kg of silage produced (cost of silo bag/pit and labour), paid quarterly for three years (twelve quarters); minimum production 500 kg per quarter.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed form to Director of A.H.&V.S. through area Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer with residence certificate (Mamlatdar/Sarpanch/Dairy Society chairman, attested by VO/AD), Form I & XIV or notarized affidavit/land documents/NOC from landlord on Rs. 50 stamp paper, quotations, photo; show land to officer. Release on inspection report/utilization certificate, dated photographs, agreement bond, original bills.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: details may be on later pages. Scheme titled (Amended) 2017-18; no notification date in text. Tussocks available free from Govt Livestock Farm Dhat-Mollem, Cattle Breeding Farm Copardem, Fodder Seed Production Farm Kalay.

schemes.name: Scheme for incentive to Green Fodder Cultivation for Perennial and Seasonal Fodder Development in the State (Amended) 2017-18
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Farmers, agricultural labourers, dairy societies, farmers clubs, SHGs growing green fodder
schemes.eligibility: Any Individual/Farmer/Agricultural Labourer/Dairy Society/Farmers club/Self Help Group/Bachat Ghat, provided they arrange the land (fallow, agricultural or marad land) with Form I & XIV and affidavit; for hydroponic fodder and silage making, minimum 5 milch animals and minimum 5 years residence in Goa; minimum area 500 sq. mts. for perennial/seasonal fodder; previous beneficiaries under existing departmental scheme eligible; must cultivate within 2 months of approval and keep units running minimum three years.
schemes.benefit: Perennial fodder per hectare: 1st year Rs. 15,000/- + Rs. 15,000/-, 2nd year Rs. 10,000/- + Rs. 10,000/-, 3rd year Rs. 7,500/- + Rs. 7,500/- (per 6 months; described as Rs. 65,000/- per hectare). Irrigation (perennial only) unit costs: Rs. 5,500/- (500-1,000 sq m), Rs. 32,000/- (1,000-4,000 sq m), Rs. 50,000/- (4,000-10,000 sq m), Rs. 80,000/- (10,000 sq m and above); implements with 75% subsidy on total cost. Seasonal fodder: Rs. 15,000/- per hectare per crop. Hydroponic unit: 75% of unit cost Rs. 50,000/- (5 animals), Rs. 70,000/- (10), Rs. 1,50,000/- (20). Maize seed: 50% subsidy per quarter (Rs. 11,250/-, 22,500/-, 45,000/-) for three years. Silage: Rs. 2/- per kg quarterly for three years (min 500 kg/quarter). Free tussocks from Government farms.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed form to Director of AH&VS through area Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer with residence certificate (Mamlatdar/Sarpanch/Dairy Society Chairman, attested by VO/AD), Form I & XIV/notarized affidavit/NOC from landlord on Rs. 50 stamp paper, quotations for irrigation/hydroponic/silo bags, photograph. Inspection committee verifies; agreement bond and original bills needed for release.
schemes.notes: Notification No. 4-1 (10)/2017-18/7806; notified_on is Gazette issue date (Series I No. 51). Title says 'Amended' but the extract does not cite the earlier notification. Rates are per hectare/per unit; no single per-beneficiary cap. Same gazette lists other schemes (Goan Maand culture, brackish water ponds, open sea cage culture, WCD internship) not extracted. Trimmed: details may be on later pages.

schemes.name: Scheme for Incentive to Green Fodder Cultivation for Perennial and Seasonal Fodder Development in the State (Amended) 2017-18 - Perennial fodder and irrigation
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Farmers, dairy societies, SHGs cultivating perennial green fodder
schemes.eligibility: Any individual/farmer/agricultural labourer/Dairy Society/Farmers club/Self Help Group (Bachat Ghat) who arranges land (fallow, agricultural, marad land etc.) with Form I & XIV and affidavit. Beneficiaries who cultivated green fodder under existing Departmental scheme are eligible. Minimum area 500 sq. mt for perennial/seasonal fodder. For hydroponic fodder and silage making: minimum 5 milch animals and minimum 5 years residence in Goa. Must cultivate/set up within 2 months of approval; perennial plots to continue 2 more years; hydroponic/silage units run min. 3 years.
schemes.benefit: Per hectare: 1st year Rs.15,000/- per 6 months (x2), 2nd year Rs.10,000/- per 6 months (x2), 3rd year Rs.7,500/- per 6 months (x2). Irrigation incentive (perennial only) by area: 500-1,000 sq.mt Rs.5,500/-; 1,000-4,000 sq.mt Rs.32,000/-; 4,000-10,000 sq.mt Rs.50,000/-; 10,000 sq.mt and above Rs.80,000/- (pump, pipes, sprinklers). Intro states Rs. 65000/- per hectare and 75% subsidy on implements.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed form to Director of A.H.&V.S. through area Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer with residence certificate (Mamlatdar/Sarpanch/Dairy Society chairman, attested by VO/AD), Form I & XIV or notarized affidavit/land documents/NOC from landlord on Rs. 50 stamp paper, quotations, photo; show land to officer. Release on inspection report/utilization certificate, dated photographs, agreement bond, original bills.
schemes.notes: Trimmed: details may be on later pages. Scheme titled (Amended) 2017-18; no notification date in text. Tussocks available free from Govt Livestock Farm Dhat-Mollem, Cattle Breeding Farm Copardem, Fodder Seed Production Farm Kalay. Largest single figure is Rs.80,000 irrigation unit cost; per-hectare rates scale with area so no clear per-beneficiary cap.

schemes.name: Scheme for setting up Poultry of 500 Broilers/1000 Layers
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Farmers setting up new 500 broiler / 1000 layer poultry units
schemes.eligibility: Any category of farmer. Bank loan is mandatory (only from Bank, not credit societies). Unit to run minimum 3 years.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy 25% of the cost of the poultry unit set up, limited to Rs.15,000/-, released on completion and final utilization certificate from Area Veterinary Doctor and Bank Manager.
schemes.how_to_apply: Obtain application form from Government Veterinary Doctor of area, submit to same officer for onward transmission to Director with recommendation; Directorate refers to bank; obtain loan and licences/NOC from Gram Panchayat/Municipality and Health Dept; bank claims subsidy with purchase statement, receipts, utilization certificate, insurance documents and agreement bond.
schemes.notes: No notification date. Same scheme as doc f09e668f49. Panchayat/Municipality licences/NOC required; no processing role.

schemes.name: Scheme for Supply of Dairy Kits to Tribal and Scheduled Caste Families (Dairy Kit)
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe dairy farming families
schemes.eligibility: Beneficiary/farmer should have at least one milch animal (local cow/buffalo); SC/ST certificate from Sarpanch or Mamlatdar; ration card copy certified by gazetted officer. One-time assistance per family (one kit per family). Application asks whether family availed subsidy earlier under Modern Dairy, Kamdhenu or Revised Kamdhenu schemes.
schemes.benefit: A dairy kit free of cost; total value of items shall not exceed Rs. 5000/-. Items: ghamella, steel bucket, steel cans, steel vessels, spade, brush, steel pot, feeding trough and water storage tank.
schemes.how_to_apply: No fees. Application form with caste/tribe certificate, certified ration card copy, passport photo, notarized undertaking on stamped paper; verified by Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer. Bond (equipment not sold for 42 months) and affidavit (use kit min. 5 years).
schemes.notes: Document is application form, bond, scheme text and affidavit; no notification date given. Bond mentions 42 months; affidavit says 5 years minimum use.

schemes.name: Scheme for Tribal & Scheduled Caste Families — Dairy Kit
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe dairy farming families
schemes.eligibility: SC/ST family; beneficiary/farmer should have at least one milch animal (local cow/buffalo); SC/ST certificate from Sarpanch or Mamlatdar; ration card copy certified by Gazetted Officer; notarized undertaking on stamp paper. One-time assistance per family; one kit per family.
schemes.benefit: Dairy kit free of cost; total value of items not to exceed Rs. 5000/-: ghamella, steel bucket, steel cans, steel vessels, spade, brush, steel pot, feeding trough and water storage tank. Kit must be used min 5 years; cost recoverable if misused.
schemes.how_to_apply: No fees. Application form with caste/tribe certificate, certified ration card copy, photo and notarized undertaking; verified by Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer. Form asks whether family availed subsidy under Modern Dairy, Kamdhenu, Revised/Modified Kamdhenu, Kamdhenu Sudharit schemes.
schemes.notes: Notification No. 2-5(3)/AH/2012-13/5254, Official Gazette Series I No. 43 dated 24-01-2013. Same gazette has unrelated Fisheries amendment (Goa VAT based subsidy on HSD oil for fishing vessels, 2012), recruitment rules and lottery rules, not extracted.

schemes.name: Scheme of Purchase of milch Animals under Western Ghat Development Programme
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Residents of Western Ghat talukas (Canacona, Sattari, Sanguem)
schemes.eligibility: Any person residing in Western Ghat Area i.e. Canacona, Sattari and Sanguem Talukas; knowledge/experience in dairying desirable; must have cattle shed and land for green fodder cultivation. Documents: ration card copy, passport photo, land ownership document/NOC from landlord/affidavit, caste certificate for SC & ST.
schemes.benefit: Maximum of 5 crossbred cows or improved breed she buffaloes in 2 or 3 phases. General category: subsidy @ [OCR-damaged '£0%'] of the cost per animal subject to maximum Rs. 10,000/- per animal; SC & ST: extra subsidy @ Rs. 2000/- per animal. Insurance incentive reimbursed up to Rs. 2000/- per animal. All animals purchased from outside the State.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed form through Area Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer; non-refundable processing fee Rs. 100/- at Government Veterinary Dispensary/Hospital; forwarded to H.O. within 15 days. Financing institution submits purchase documents, insurance, notarized Rs. 20 agreement bond, health certificate within 1 month of purchase.
schemes.notes: OCR text; subsidy percentage for general category unreadable ('£0%'). max_benefit_inr is per-animal cap for general category (SC/ST get Rs. 2000 extra per animal). Animals must be insured 3½ years, microchipped, not disposed for 3½ years. No notification number/date in text; funding not stated.

schemes.name: Short Scheme for Mission Rabies (Amended) — Financial Assistance to Mission Rabies Goa Phase II Mass Vaccination Programme
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Mission Rabies, Worldwide Veterinary Service, India (stray dog anti-rabies vaccination)
schemes.eligibility: Only Mission Rabies, Worldwide Veterinary Service, India, authorized by the Animal Welfare Board of India, is eligible; organizations that applied to AWBI for grants for the same components are not eligible for the same grants.
schemes.benefit: 100% grant-in-aid for wages of dog catchers and Veterinary Assistants, Veterinary surgeon salary, vaccination (syringes, needles), post-vaccination survey staff and transport, cold chain and rabies test kits, disposal of euthanized rabid dogs. One-year budget: Vaccination Rs. 3,29,200; Human resources Rs. 40,80,000; Vehicle expenses Rs. 10,58,400; Grand total Rs. 54,67,600 for 1 year; could be extended for 3 years based on performance (5467600 x 3 = Rs. 1,64,02,800).
schemes.how_to_apply: Mission Rabies signs MoU with Government of Goa and applies to Director of AH&VS (Annexure-I); Director recommends to Government for sanction; grants released by ECS in 2 installments after Monitoring Committee scrutiny; HQ premises with NOCs required; local Assistant Directors North & South verify bills.
schemes.valid_period: In force from date of enforcement of MOU; 100% grant initially for a year, extendable (text says 2 years / up to 3 years total) based on assessment
schemes.notes: Notification No. 14-9-AH/MR/Part III/18-19/1782; signing date truncated ('Panaji, 13th ...'); notified_on is Official Gazette Series I No. 14 issue date. max_benefit_inr is the 1-year total to the single grantee. Budget head 2403-Animal Husbandry, Scheme for Rescue Animal Welfare. Rest of gazette (Homoeopathy ordinance, Gratuity Act etc.) unrelated. Trimmed.

schemes.name: Special Calf Rearing Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Farmers rearing cross-bred calves into heifers
schemes.eligibility: Farmer must register birth of cross-bred calf within 1 to 15 days of birth (with sire certificate of A.I. and ration card copy); calf must weigh at least 60 kg at 3 months and gain at least 40 kg per quarter (25-40 kg at Department discretion with VO certificate). Maximum 10 calves per farmer family.
schemes.benefit: 4 quarterly instalments of feed (3-6, 6-9, 9-12, 12-15 months), 100 kgs of feed per quarter, supplied at doorstep or nearest Key Village Sub Centre/Dairy Society.
schemes.how_to_apply: Register calf at local Key Village Sub Centre / Area Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director of Taluka with sire certificate and ration card copy; calves microchipped; Director AH&VS sanctions feed quarters.
schemes.notes: No notification date. Benefit in kind (feed); no rupee amount stated.

schemes.name: Subsidy for Transportation of Ready Poultry Feed from Outside the State of Goa by Poultry Farmers
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Registered layer/broiler poultry farmers in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Poultry farmer registered with Directorate of AH&VS (with capacity details); bonafide resident of Goa for last 10 preceding years; unit of layers or broilers within Goa; must be a producer from day old chicks selling own produce, not a trader bringing birds from outside Goa.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy @ Rs. 200/- per metric ton of ready-to-use feed purchased from outside Goa.
schemes.how_to_apply: Buy ready feed from another State (quantities below 3.0 tons via Goa Bagayatdar); submit feed bills (in tons) to Taluka Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director, who certifies and forwards to Director; inform local officer in advance and maintain register countersigned by Department; certified Aadhaar copy.
schemes.notes: Undated; no notification number or date. Rate only, no overall cap.

schemes.name: The Goa Small Animal Rescue Management Scheme, 2014
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Local bodies and Animal Welfare Organizations running stray dog ABC/anti-rabies programmes
schemes.eligibility: (a) Municipal Corporations, Municipal Councils and Panchayats who have signed MoU with Animal Welfare Organizations; (b) AWOs must be registered in Goa and working in Goa for last 3 years; (c) International Animal Organizations authorized by Animal Welfare Board of India may also apply; (d) organizations that applied to AWBI for grants for the same components are not eligible for the same grants.
schemes.benefit: Grants up to 90% of vehicle cost (vehicle cost Rs. 3,00,000/-); 100% grants for driver cum dog catcher salary (Rs. 10,000/- per month), sterilization (Rs. 900/- per animal), sheds (Rs. 5,000/- per sq. m), cages (Rs. 5,000/- per cage), feeding 3 days (Rs. 25/- per dog per day, Rs. 75/- for 3 days), vaccination (Rs. 50/- per animal), Veterinary surgeon (Rs. 30,000/- per month); other expenses: survey Rs. 5/- per dog, disposal of dead dogs Rs. 500/- per dog, microchip Rs. 200/- per dog, publicity and contingencies; maximum limit for other expenses Rs. 2,00,000/-.
schemes.how_to_apply: AWOs with MoU apply to the Director of AH&VS through the local body (Annexure-I application, Annexure-II undertaking on Rs. 10 stamp paper); local bodies may also apply individually; local body verifies and recommends via local AH&VS officer; land ownership/lease documents and NOC from statutory authorities for infrastructure grants; grants disbursed to local body by ECS, kept in separate account; Commissioner/Chief Officer/Panchayat Secretary certify bills and submit audited report with Utilization Certificates. Organ count certificate from local AD/VO required for release.
schemes.valid_period: In force from date of publication in Official Gazette
schemes.notes: Not. No. 14-9-AH/GRAWO/2015-16/2367, published Official Gazette Series I No. 19 dated 6-8-2015; signed Panaji 30th July 2015 (doc c51c3b7a8e shows 29-07-2015). Component caps only, no single per-beneficiary ceiling, so max_benefit_inr null. Gazette issue also contains unrelated items (Fisheries OBM fuel scheme notification withdrawal, Goa Municipalities (Amendment) Bill 2015) not extracted. Trimmed.

schemes.name: The Goa Stray Cattle Management Scheme, 2013 (Modified)
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Local bodies, Animal Welfare Organizations, Goshalas and Civic & Consumer Forums impounding stray cattle
schemes.eligibility: AWOs, Goshalas and Civic & Consumer Forums (CCF) must be registered in Goa and working in Goa for last 3 years in this field, have audited annual accounts, and own land or leased land with lease of minimum 10 years; Municipal Corporations, Municipal Councils and Panchayats can also apply.
schemes.benefit: Vehicle with hydraulic lift up to 90% grant (vehicle cost Rs. 18,00,000/-); driver salary Rs. 10,000/- per month; sheds Rs. 5,000/- per sq. m; feeding of cattle Rs. 75/- per day; Veterinary Surgeon salary Rs. 30,000/- per month; attendants' salary Rs. 6,000/- per month per attendant (six attendants); rumenotomy Rs. 2000/- per animal; other expenses: survey Rs. 5/- per animal, burial Rs. 2000/-, microchip/notching Rs. 200/- per animal, max Rs. 2,00,000/- for these.
schemes.how_to_apply: AWOs, Goshalas and CCF apply through the local body in whose jurisdiction they work; local bodies may apply individually; local body verifies and recommends to Directorate of AH&VS through local Area Officer; land/lease (10 yrs) documents and NOC for infrastructure; grants disbursed to local body by ECS into separate account; Commissioner/Chief Officer/Panchayat Secretary certify bills and submit audited report with utilization certificates.
schemes.valid_period: In force from date of publication in Official Gazette
schemes.later_amendments: 29-10-2015 – The Goa Stray Cattle Management Scheme, 2013 (Modified)
schemes.notes: Department file copy No. 14-9-AH/Stray Cattle/2015-16/ dated 21/10/2015; restated modified version of the 2013 scheme opening it to Municipalities, Panchayats, AWOs, Goshalas and CCF. Component caps only, no single ceiling. Owners reclaiming impounded cattle pay fine Rs. 3000/- (within 7 days) or Rs. 5000/- (7-15 days) plus delivery charges; unclaimed cattle may be auctioned after 15 days.

amendments.name: The Goa Stray Cattle Management Scheme, 2013 (Modified)
amendments.benefit: Grants: vehicle with hydraulic lift up to 90% grant (cost of vehicle Rs. 18,00,000/-); driver salary Rs. 10,000/- per month; construction of sheds Rs. 5,000/- per square meter (subject to NOC); feeding of cattle Rs. 75/- per day; Veterinary Surgeon salary Rs. 30,000/- per month; six attendants Rs. 6,000/- per month each; rumenotomy Rs. 2000/- per animal; survey Rs. 5/- per animal, burial Rs. 2000/-, microchip/notching Rs. 200/- per animal (max Rs. 2,00,000/- for these three).
amendments.notes: Notification No. 14-9-AH/Stray Cattle/2015-16/4006; notified_on is Gazette issue date (Series I No. 31). max_benefit_inr is the vehicle cost (grant up to 90%) - largest rupee figure; several items are monthly/per-day rates. Also sets fines for release of impounded cattle (Rs. 3000 within 7 days, Rs. 5000 within 15 days). Trimmed: details may be on later pages.

schemes.name: Varah Palan Scheme (Guidelines to Varahpalan Scheme)
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Pig farmers in Goa (Panchayat areas)
schemes.eligibility: Any farmer residing for minimum 05 years in the State (residence certificate or 5-year election roll/driving licence/passport/bank account/other Govt document); should have undergone training in Piggery Management; applicable to any individual in the State but area of operation only Panchayat; land ownership (Form I & XIV/Kisan Card) or 6-year lease/NOC or tenancy evidence; NOC from Village Panchayat.
schemes.benefit: Purchase of piglets (max 20 kg) or adult sows (max 90 kg)/boars (max 120 kg), max 20 females + 2 males, cost Rs. 120/- per kg live weight; subsidy @ 62.5% for males max Rs. 9,000/- each and @ 74% for females max Rs. 8000/- each. Shed infrastructure subsidy max Rs. 2000/- per pig (Annexure I: max Rs. 44,000/-). Gobar gas unit cost max Rs. 50,000/-, subsidy 75% = Rs. 37,500/- (if not obtained from other agencies). Other equipment (Annexure III) max cost Rs. 32,800/-, subsidy 75% = Rs. 26,100/-. Subsidy by DBT.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed form to Directorate of AH&VS, Panaji through respective Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director, with Village Panchayat NOC, residence certificate, Aadhar, training certificate, land documents, site plan, project report, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC) and photo; piglets to be purchased from Govt Piggery Farm, Curti, Ponda (or other registered farm with NOC); unit within 6 months of sanction; agreement bond that unit runs min 5 years; subsidy released after completion and committee inspection (to bank loan account if financed).
schemes.notes: Undated guidelines; no notification number or date. Inconsistencies in text: equipment max cost Rs. 32,800/- in body vs Rs. 34,800/- in Annexure II; boar max weight 120 kg in body vs 90 kg in Annexure I. max_benefit_inr = largest single component cap (infrastructure Rs. 44,000/-); components are separate. Village Panchayat NOC required. Trimmed.

amendments.name: Varahpalan Scheme (Varah Palan)
amendments.benefit: Subsidy towards setting up of piggery unit (amount not stated in this addendum).
amendments.notes: Addendum No. 3-1(13)/2018-19/5051, Official Gazette Series I No. 35 dated 29-11-2018: adds affidavit and agreement bond formats at end of the scheme notification; on default, entire subsidy plus damages recoverable as arrears of land revenue. Scheme benefit amounts not in this text. Same gazette contains end of an Agriculture Department fruit/flower/vegetable scheme (50% seed / 75% seedling subsidy, notified 22-11-2018) whose name is not in the excerpt - not extracted.

schemes.name: Infrastructure Development Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services
schemes.target: Goan farmers constructing/extending pucca cattle sheds with bank finance
schemes.eligibility: All farmers residing in Goa with minimum 10 animals (or plan of action for purchase of animals certified by VO); unemployed youth given preference. Lease/NOC for minimum 15 years for tenants. Bank loan for shed for 10 up to 20 animals. Must possess animals equal to shed capacity at release.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy Rs 5000/- per animal for a maximum of 20 animals, with minimum carpet area of 5.4 sq mts per animal, for construction/extension of pucca cattle shed.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in duplicate in prescribed form from Departmental sub-offices with non-refundable fee Rs 100/-, ownership documents/Form I & XIV/lease/NOC, construction licence and approved plan from Panchayat/Municipality, bank letter, attested photo; AD/VO submits to Director within 15 days. For release: consolidated bill attested by VO/AD and countersigned by financing institution, valuation certificate, completion certificate from Panchayat/Municipality.
schemes.notes: No notification date. Per-animal rate (Rs 5000 x max 20 animals) - not multiplied. Panchayat/Municipality issues construction licence, plan approval and completion certificate (regulatory, not scheme processing).

amendments.name: The Deendayal Panchayat Raj Infrastructure Development (Golden Jubilee) Scheme, 2013
amendments.benefit: Clause 19: "rupees 1.5 crores" substituted by "rupees two crores"; first proviso: "rupees two crores" substituted by "rupees 2.5 crores".
amendments.notes: Notification 25/7/DEV/Vol/2016/6238 under section 244-A Goa Panchayati Raj Act; signed by Director & ex officio Additional Secretary (Panchayats). Context of clause 19 limits not in text (likely per-panchayat project ceiling) - not assumed. Comes into force on publication.

schemes.name: The Goa Archaeological Research Fellowship Scheme - Junior Research Fellowship
schemes.target: Post-graduate scholars in archaeology/history/Indology, up to 35 years
schemes.eligibility: Completed post-graduation (M.A.) in Ancient Indian History Culture and Archaeology / History / Indology; up to 35 years of age on closing date. Fellowship awarded once in lifetime per category; Goan scholar (15 years residence in Goa) or Indian scholar (Indian citizenship). Fellow not eligible for any other Department fellowship for 5 years after submission of project.
schemes.benefit: Fellowship of Rs. 25,000/- per month for 24 months.
schemes.how_to_apply: Department releases press advertisement inviting applications; committee constituted by Department selects scholars. Half-yearly progress reports; project report (2 hard copies + soft copy) within 30 days of completing 24 months.
schemes.valid_period: Scheme valid for 2 years
schemes.notes: Notification F.No. 1(5)/Scheme/2022-23/Archaeology; approved by Finance (Exp.) Dept U.O. No. 2626/F dated 21/06/2025; comes into force from date of Gazette notification (not given). Maximum two fellowships per category. Monthly amount; max_benefit_inr is the monthly figure. OCR shows '7 25,000/-' (rupee symbol misread).

schemes.name: The Goa Archaeological Research Fellowship Scheme - Senior Research Fellowship
schemes.target: Doctorate holders in archaeology/history/Indology, up to 45 years
schemes.eligibility: Completed Doctorate in Ancient Indian History Culture and Archaeology / History / Indology; up to 45 years of age on closing date. Fellowship awarded once in lifetime per category; Goan scholar (15 years residence in Goa) or Indian scholar (Indian citizenship). Fellow not eligible for any other Department fellowship for 5 years after submission of project.
schemes.benefit: Fellowship of Rs. 40,000/- per month for 24 months.
schemes.how_to_apply: Department releases press advertisement inviting applications; committee constituted by Department selects scholars. Half-yearly progress reports; project report (2 hard copies + soft copy) within 30 days of completing 24 months.
schemes.valid_period: Scheme valid for 2 years
schemes.notes: Notification F.No. 1(5)/Scheme/2022-23/Archaeology; approved by Finance (Exp.) Dept U.O. No. 2626/F dated 21/06/2025; comes into force from date of Gazette notification (not given). Maximum two fellowships per category. Monthly amount; max_benefit_inr is the monthly figure.

schemes.name: Assistance for Construction of Godown - PACS/Marketing/Consumer Cooperatives
schemes.department: Department Of Cooperation ( Office Of The Registrar Of Coop. Societies)
schemes.target: PACS, Marketing and Consumer Cooperative Societies
schemes.eligibility: Society earning profit and functioning found satisfactory by the Registrar; land owned or leased for not less than 20 years; construction licence, NOC from PDA/Town and Country Planning, PWD technical approval.
schemes.benefit: Loan up to 50% and subsidy up to 50% of the estimated cost of the godown approved by the P.W.D.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application with Board resolution, audited accounts, write-up, Plan & Estimates, land title/lease documents, construction licence, NOC and PWD technical approval, to the Registrar through the Asstt. Registrar.
schemes.notes: Undated departmental summary.

schemes.name: Assistance for fencing
schemes.department: Department Of Cooperation ( Office Of The Registrar Of Coop. Societies)
schemes.target: Farmers protecting crops from domestic and wild animals
schemes.eligibility: Farmer carrying out agricultural activities in the State; right to plot as sole owner, co-owner, lessee or on contract; cultivating minimum 0.2 ha in general (0.1 ha for paddy, pulses, oilseeds, vegetables, flowers, banana, papaya, pineapple for barbed/GI wire or wire mesh if no dwelling unit in plot; 500 sq. mtrs for traditional small vegetable growers and nursery raisers); groups/societies of farmers jointly fencing eligible; Private Limited Companies and Institutions with agriculture as major activity eligible; Communidade land vegetable growers eligible by declaration.
schemes.benefit: Traditional fencing: 75% (general) / 90% (SC/ST) assistance. Barbed/G.I. wire (3-7 lines) @ Rs. 12.00 / Rs. 14.40 per meter per line or 75%/90% of cost whichever is less; poles max Rs. 300/ (Rs. 360 SC/ST) per pole (admissible RCC pole cost max Rs. 400/-). Stone wall: 75% limited to Rs. 300/- per running metre (90% limited to Rs. 360/- per RM for SC/ST). Chain link/wire mesh: subsidy limited to Rs. 150/- per R.M. (Rs. 180/- SC/ST) plus poles. Solar powered battery fencing: 90% of admissible cost for all categories restricted to Rs. 2.00 lakhs for individuals; no ceiling for registered farmer groups in large compact blocks. Overall subsidy limit Rs. 2.00 lakhs per farmer; groups/societies jointly fencing get 75% without the Rs. 2.00 lakh ceiling. GoI subsidy adjusted within total.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit application with cost estimate before starting work to the Zonal Agriculture Officer with land documents (Annexure-I) and project feasibility report if bank loan; ZAO inspects and forwards for administrative approval (Dy. Director Agronomy approves within 10 working days); after completion submit bills/vouchers to ZAO; subsidy paid by ECS. Solar fencing only through dealers registered with Directorate of Agriculture.
schemes.valid_period: In force with immediate effect till withdrawn or amended
schemes.notes: Department of Agriculture notification 3/4/Agron/PPG/3-2(3)/2013-14/D.Agri in Gazette Series I No.15 dated 11-07-2013 (portal lists Cooperation Dept). Gazette also contains groundnut programme (separate row), HYV seed scheme and Dairy Infrastructure scheme (not in extracted text).

amendments.name: Assistance for fencing (amendment)
amendments.benefit: Assistance 75%/90% for general and SC/ST respectively on standard cost or actual (whichever less) for revised barbed wire/RCC/metal pole specifications; new component 4A(iv) Hybrid Fence (stone wall base + solar power or chain link/wire mesh): 75%/90% for stone wall and chain link portion, solar portion 90% subsidy; maximum subsidy for hybrid fence Rs. 3.0 Lakh for individual farmers; no limit for farmers jointly fencing consolidated plots forming group/society.
amendments.notes: Notification No. 3/5/EXT/Fencing/188-A/2018-19/D.Agri/392; Official Gazette Series I No. 23 dated 6-9-2018. OCR heavily jumbled.

schemes.name: Business Development Planning Programme (Extension counter)
schemes.department: Department Of Cooperation ( Office Of The Registrar Of Coop. Societies)
schemes.target: PACS and taluka farmers service co-op societies
schemes.eligibility: Primary Agricultural Credit/Taluka Farmers Service Co-op. Societies.
schemes.benefit: Share capital contribution of Rs.50,000/-; subsidy @ Rs.50,000/- per extension counter.
schemes.notes: Compendium page (State Plan Scheme) listing pattern of assistance only; eligibility/procedure details not given. Listed under heading 'Notification No.1-31-2013/PLG/RCS/ dated 27/02/2014'; unclear whether all subsequent items belong to that notification.

schemes.name: Computer and accessories (Taluka Farmers/Marketing/Consumer/Processing Co-op. Societies)
schemes.department: Department Of Cooperation ( Office Of The Registrar Of Coop. Societies)
schemes.target: Taluka farmers, marketing, consumer, processing co-op societies
schemes.eligibility: Taluka Farmers/Marketing/Consumer/Processing Co-op. Societies; number of branches considered; 40% ST/SC shareholder societies get higher subsidy share.
schemes.benefit: Loan & subsidy up to maximum Rs.2.00 lakhs (50% loan, 50% subsidy) considering number of branches; 35% loan and 65% subsidy up to maximum Rs.2.00 lakhs for societies with minimum 40% ST & SC shareholders.
schemes.notes: Compendium page (State Plan Scheme) listing pattern of assistance only; eligibility/procedure details not given. Listed under heading 'Notification No.1-31-2013/PLG/RCS/ dated 27/02/2014'; unclear whether all subsequent items belong to that notification. Max is combined loan+subsidy.

schemes.name: Computerization (Urban Co-op. Credit Societies and Primary Agricultural Co-op. Credit Societies)
schemes.department: Department Of Cooperation ( Office Of The Registrar Of Coop. Societies)
schemes.target: Urban co-operative credit societies and PACS
schemes.eligibility: Urban Co-op. Credit Societies and Primary Agricultural Co-op. Credit Societies; limit depends on number of branches/extension counters.
schemes.benefit: Loan & subsidy up to maximum Rs.1.00 lakhs (50% loan, 50% subsidy) per society with 3 or less branches/extension counters; up to maximum Rs.2.00 lakhs (50% loan, 50% subsidy) for societies with more than 3 branches/extension counters.
schemes.notes: Compendium page (State Plan Scheme) listing pattern of assistance only; eligibility/procedure details not given. Notification No.1-17-2008-09/PLG/RCS dated 04/08/2011. Max is combined loan+subsidy.

schemes.name: Computerization for Urban Co-operative Credit Societies, Primary Agricultural Credit Co-operative Societies having branches/extension counters
schemes.department: Department Of Cooperation ( Office Of The Registrar Of Coop. Societies)
schemes.target: Urban Cooperative Credit Societies and PACS with branches/extension counters
schemes.eligibility: Minimum working capital Rs.1.00 lakh; audited accounts for last three years; audit class A, B or C during last three years; sufficient repaying capacity.
schemes.benefit: Loan and subsidy (50% loan, 50% subsidy): up to maximum Rs. 1.00 lakh per society with three or less branches/extension counters; up to maximum Rs. 2.00 lakhs for more than three branches; further maximum Rs. 1.00 lakh for societies that earlier availed and have more than three branches. Loan for 7 years in 7 equal annual instalments with interest @ 11% p.a.; penal interest @ 2%. Subsidy released on completion with technical expert certificate.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit proposal through the concerned Assistant Registrar with detailed proposal, three quotations with comparative statement, audited accounts; execute Agreement Bond. Scrutiny Committee chaired by Registrar of Co-operative Societies.
schemes.notes: Notification 1-17-2008-09/PLG/RCS in Gazette Series I No.19 dated 11-08-2011; rest of gazette mostly unrelated (fertilizer order, post creation). Same scheme as in doc 22b88b9231.

schemes.name: Computerization for Urban Cooperative Credit Societies, Primary Agricultural Credit Cooperative Societies having branches/extension counters
schemes.department: Department Of Cooperation ( Office Of The Registrar Of Coop. Societies)
schemes.target: Urban Cooperative Credit Societies and Primary Agricultural Credit Cooperative Societies with branches/extension counters
schemes.eligibility: Urban Cooperative Credit Societies / PACS having branches/extension counters; minimum working capital Rs.1.00 lakh; audited accounts for last three years; placed in audit class A, B or C during last three years; sufficient repaying capacity to repay loan.
schemes.benefit: Loan and subsidy (50% loan, 50% subsidy) for computerization of records: up to maximum Rs.1.00 lakh per society with three or less branches/extension counters; up to maximum Rs.2.00 lakh for societies with more than three branches/extension counters; societies that earlier availed the scheme and have more than three branches can avail further maximum Rs.1.00 lakh (50% loan, 50% subsidy).
