schemes.name: The Revised Common Scheme to provide financial assistance to the Primary Agricultural Credit Co-operative Societies, Taluka Farmers Service Co-operative Societies, Marketing Co-operative Societies, Consumer Co-operative Societies, Processing Co-operative Societies, Dairy Co-operative Societies and Women Self Help Group Co-operative Societies, 2013 - Share Capital Contribution
schemes.department: Department Of Cooperation ( Office Of The Registrar Of Coop. Societies)
schemes.target: PACS, Taluka Farmers Service, Marketing, Consumer, Processing and Dairy cooperative societies
schemes.eligibility: Eligible cooperative society types as listed; society must adopt byelaw making share capital non-refundable for 15 years, refund Govt share capital after 15 years via Redemption Fund, increase share capital by 1/15 yearly, not declare dividend above 12% till Govt contribution refunded; not a defaulter in repayment of Govt investments; Managing Committee/Board resolution; audited accounts for last 3 years.
schemes.benefit: Government Share Capital Contribution: PACS up to Rs. 50,000/- after registration, further Rs. 1,00,000/- (turnover < Rs. 5.00 lakhs) or Rs. 1,50,000/- (turnover > Rs. 5.00 lakhs); Taluka Farmers Service up to Rs. 2,00,000/- without matching after registration, further to Rs. 12,00,000/- in aggregate if turnover > Rs. 20.00 lakhs for two consecutive years; Marketing up to 6 times members' paid up share capital; Consumer up to Rs. 50,000/- on matching basis, further Rs. 1,00,000/- without matching if profitable; Processing up to 5 times members' share capital to maximum Rs. 5,00,000/-; Dairy up to Rs. 50,000/- without matching after registration.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit Managing Committee/Board of Directors resolution and audited accounts for last 3 years.
schemes.valid_period: In force from date of publication in Official Gazette
schemes.notes: Notification 1-31-2013/PLG/RCS in Gazette Series I No.49 dated 06-03-2014 (other docs in batch cite it as dated 27-2-2014; signature date not in extracted text). Repeals notifications 1-24-2010-11/PLG/RCS/154 dated 11-10-2011 and 1-27-2012/PLG/RCS/187 dated 02-08-2012. Max Rs.12 lakh is aggregate share capital for Taluka Farmers Service societies. Trimmed: managerial subsidy/other components and Women SHG societies' terms may be on later pages.

schemes.name: The revised scheme to provide financial assistance to the Dairy Co-operative Societies
schemes.department: Department Of Cooperation ( Office Of The Registrar Of Coop. Societies)
schemes.target: Dairy Co-operative Societies
schemes.eligibility: Dairy cooperative societies; SCSP/TSP treatment for societies with minimum 40% ST/SC shareholders.
schemes.benefit: Government Share Capital contribution up to Rs. 50,000/- without matching contribution immediately after registration; 50% loan and 50% subsidy for construction of godown-cum-office building on PWD-approved estimated cost subject to maximum of Rs. 5.00 lakhs; also managerial subsidy and assistance for computer and furniture (details cut off).
schemes.notes: Notification 1-23-2010-11/PLG/RCS in Gazette Series I No.19 dated 11-08-2011; text truncated (trimmed) mid-scheme: SCSP/TSP terms, managerial subsidy, computer/furniture amounts and date not available. Rs.5 lakh maximum includes loan component.

schemes.name: Women's Self Help Group Cooperatives - one time grant
schemes.department: Department Of Cooperation ( Office Of The Registrar Of Coop. Societies)
schemes.target: Women's self help group cooperatives
schemes.eligibility: Women's Self Help Group Cooperatives.
schemes.benefit: One time grant of Rs.20,000/-.
schemes.notes: Compendium page (State Plan Scheme) listing pattern of assistance only; eligibility/procedure details not given. Listed under heading 'Notification No.1-31-2013/PLG/RCS/ dated 27/02/2014'; unclear whether all subsequent items belong to that notification.

schemes.name: Development of wadas with proper sanitation/road & infrastructure
schemes.target: Needy localities (wadas)
schemes.benefit: Department undertakes works for upgradation of environmental conditions in needy localities, including solid waste treatment/disposal, sanitation, roads and infrastructure. Total budget Rs. 80.00 lakhs; sanctioned till date for 2018-19 Rs. 47.00 lakhs.
schemes.notes: Brief one-page summary; no eligibility or application details. Budget figures are scheme totals, not per-beneficiary.

schemes.name: Water supply scheme for small/remote pollution affected wadas
schemes.target: Remote wadas affected by water pollution
schemes.eligibility: Provided to local bodies, Municipalities, Panchayats, Institutions, NGOs etc.
schemes.benefit: Support to set up water harvesting projects and ground water treatment to ensure potable drinking water. Total budget Rs. 15.00 lakhs.
schemes.notes: Brief summary; no per-project amount or procedure. Budget is scheme total.

schemes.name: Dr. Verghese Kurien Rojgar Yojana (VKRY) (amended Chief Minister's Rozgar Yojana, with Share Capital Assistance to Self Employed Scheme of DITC)
schemes.department: Department Of Finance – Debt Management Division , Secretariat
schemes.target: Educated unemployed persons seeking self-employment
schemes.eligibility: Age 18 to 42 years (relaxable by 5 years for widow, disabled, SC, ST, OBC; further 10 years may be considered by VKRY Task Force Committee, limited to 10% of previous year's sanctioned cases; not for regular ex-Govt employees/VRS); VIIIth passed (relaxable; preference to technical/professional qualifications); family income (with spouse, dependents, minor children) not exceeding Rs. 3,00,000/- p.a.; permanent resident of the area for at least 15 years; not a defaulter to any nationalized bank/FI/cooperative bank; not already assisted under another subsidy-linked scheme unless relaxed. All economically viable/legal activities except dealing in alcohol & tobacco.
schemes.benefit: Loan assistance: project cost maximum Rs. 20.00 lakh including 50% share capital under DITC scheme (80% for SC/ST) for individuals with professional degree/diploma/I.T.I. or special Govt training; maximum Rs. 15.00 lakh including 50% (80% for SC/ST) share capital under DITC scheme for others.
schemes.valid_period: Effective from 1-9-2014
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No.26 dated 25-09-2014; one-page extract, cut off after loan assistance section (operational guidelines, interest, repayment, how to apply on later pages). Max is maximum project cost (loan + share capital), not a grant. Implemented through EDC Ltd per doc 0b65dccfb8. Name later reverted to CMRY (doc 0b65dccfb8).

amendments.name: Chief Minister's Rozgar Yojana (CMRY)
amendments.notes: Not. 2/6/2013-Fin(DMU)/02, OG Series I No. 41 dated 07-01-2021; effective from publication. Only the eligibility clause is in the text; benefits not stated. Page also has unrelated kerosene price table.

amendments.name: Chief Minister's Rozgar Yojana (CMRY) - amendment of clause (1)(e) Defaulter/Non Eligibility
amendments.notes: Notification 2/6/2013-Fin(DMU)/02 published in Gazette Series I No.41 dated 07-01-2021 (page also carries an unrelated Civil Supplies kerosene price table). Only the amended clause is given; rest of scheme not in this document.

schemes.name: Swavalamban Yojana for Handicrafts Artisans (Handholding Support for Handicrafts production and marketing)
schemes.department: Department Of Handicrafts, Textile And Coir
schemes.target: Handicrafts artisans of Goa and handicrafts trainees
schemes.eligibility: All artisans from Goa who are practicing Handicrafts or persons undergoing trainings in Handicrafts or such persons who are registered as artisans with the DC Handicrafts, Ministry of Textiles, GoI or registered with GHRSSIDC, Government of Goa. Applicant must give an undertaking that assistance will be used only for production of Handicrafts items (further conditions truncated).
schemes.benefit: (a) Financial assistance up to Rs. 2000/- for purchase of tools, as reimbursement on producing bill/voucher/receipt (during or on completion of skill training); (b) Rs. 1000/- for raw material during the training period plus additional one time Rs. 2000/- for raw material on successful completion of training; (c) needy artisans engaged in dressmaking/stitching to be given the Sewing Machines used during their training; sewing machines to SHGs stitching uniforms/dress material. Also exhibitions/fairs, market linkage via GHRSSIDC emporiums, Common Facility Centres, Master Artisan empanelment.
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 16 dated 16-07-2020, Notification 4/40/2017/HT&C/37; signing date not in extracted text. Comes into force from date of notification in Official Gazette. Trimmed: list of crafts and conditions of sanction (clause 7) cut off; application procedure likely on later pages.

schemes.name: The Goa Integrated Skill Development Scheme, 2014
schemes.department: Department Of Handicrafts, Textile And Coir
schemes.target: Youth aged 18-45 seeking training in handicrafts, textile and coir trades
schemes.eligibility: Resident of Goa for last 15 years; passed at least Std V; age 18-45; must be resident of the locality in which the centre is located. Preference: 40% of seats reserved for marginalized groups - women, SC, ST, OBC, differently abled persons and school drop outs (filled by general category if insufficient candidates). Selection by committee formed by the Director. 80% attendance compulsory each month.
schemes.benefit: Free training (1 to 6 months) in powerloom weaving, tailoring and embroidery, garment and dress making, handloom weaving, dyeing and painting, carpet weaving and wall-hanging, carpentry, wood carving, bamboo and cane craft, pottery ceramic, papier mache, metal crafts, dolls and embroidery, other village crafts, coir spinning and weaving. Stipend of Rs. 1000/- for each completed month of training; SC/ST trainees additional stipend of Rs. 500/- per month. Trade Excellency Certificate to those securing 50% in end-course assessment; marketing support via exhibitions, melas, fairs; possible deployment in Government Powerloom Production Units.
schemes.how_to_apply: Director of Handicrafts, Textile and Coir invites applications in prescribed proforma (Annexure 'A'); submit with prescribed documents to the Director. Batches commence in January and July each year.
schemes.valid_period: In force from date of publication in Official Gazette (OG Series I No. 24, 11-9-2014)
schemes.later_amendments: 2020-07-13 – Changing the nomenclature of scheme to "Vishwakarma Kaushal Yojana"
schemes.notes: Not. No. 3/2/2014/HT & C/57. max_benefit_inr is the monthly stipend for SC/ST trainee (Rs. 1000 + Rs. 500 per month); general trainees Rs. 1000 per month. Training conducted in premises of concerned Village Panchayats or nearest government premises (rent cap Rs. 3500/month rural, Rs. 5000 urban) - panchayat role is only as venue. Finance concurrence U.O. No. 1496343 dated 25-07-2014.

amendments.name: Changing the nomenclature of scheme to "Vishwakarma Kaushal Yojana"
amendments.notes: Only the gazette index entry (HT&C Not. 3/2/2014/HT&C/28, page 1646, Gazette Series I No. 49 dated 03-03-2016) is in the extracted text; the notification body is not. Doc cc7a3c608a gives notification date 24/02/2016.

amendments.name: Goa Integrated Skill Development Scheme, 2014
amendments.notes: Official Gazette Series I No. 25 dated 18-09-2014: Corrigendum No. 3/2/2014/HT&C/64 (correction of numbering of paras) and Addendum No. 3/2/2014/HT&C/65 (addition of Annexures 'A' & 'B' to the scheme notification), signed Under Secretary (HT&C), Porvorim 15-09-2014. Only the tail of the annexure (staff qualifications table) is in the text; the scheme's eligibility/benefits are not in this document. Rest of gazette is the Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University Act, 2014 (unrelated). Trimmed: details may be on other pages.

schemes.name: Guidelines for identification of eligible household as per section 10 of National Food Security Act, 2013
schemes.department: Department Of Handicrafts, Textile And Coir
schemes.target: Priority households (PHH) and AAY households for subsidised food grains under NFSA
schemes.eligibility: Priority household if any of: AAY ration card; BPL ration card; household income below Rs. 50,000 p.a.; ST or SC household with income below Rs. 50,000; homeless/temporary shelter; notified slums; kaccha house/hut; GRB/WRD resettlement zone; DSSS beneficiary in household; Griha Aadhar beneficiary with income below Rs. 50000; transgender/HIV/AIDS member (included suo moto via GSACS); physically/mentally challenged member; single women (unmarried/widow/divorcee) head of family with income below Rs. 1.2 lakh p.a.; orphan/minor headed household; occupationally vulnerable (unskilled labour incl. fisheries, scrap yards); destitute institutions (e.g. Apna Ghar, old age homes). Exclusions: income above Rs. 50,000 (only for Sr. 3,4,5,14); any member owns a four-wheeler; any member is Central/State Govt/local body/corporation/aided institution employee (except daily wagers/casual/contract); electricity connection above 4KW (not for institutions); exclusions not applicable to Sr. 17.
schemes.benefit: Entitled quantity of food grains at the notified (subsidized) rates; new/stamped ration card (eldest female as head of household).
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply after public notice in prescribed format at the concerned Taluka Office of Civil Supplies Department and/or at local bodies at village level (online filing to be provided). Documents: category certificate per Table 1, EPIC of adult members, Aadhaar, bank details, residence proof, existing ration card copy, declaration on exclusion criteria, biometrics of adult members. Self-certified documents admissible.
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs, Notification DCS/S/Food Security/2014-15/533, Gazette Series I No. 24 dated 11-09-2014 (posted under HT&C because same gazette contains ISDS 2014). Taluka Officer sends draft list to local body for objections. Trimmed: end of text cut off.

schemes.name: Swavalamban Yojana for Handicrafts Artisans
schemes.department: Department Of Handicrafts, Textile And Coir
schemes.target: Needy skilled tailoring artisans/tailors/SHGs of Goa for stitching primary school uniforms
schemes.eligibility: Needy skilled Tailoring Artisans/Tailors/Self Help Groups of Goa with competence and experience in stitching School Uniforms of Primary Students
schemes.benefit: Empanelment with the Department (for stitching school uniforms); no amounts stated
schemes.how_to_apply: Send Full Name, Age, Qualification, Experience in Stitching, Address, Village Panchayat, Contact No., Aadhar Card No and Place of Stitching by email to dhtcgoa@gmail.com, WhatsApp 8805174188, or hard copy by post to Director, Department of Handicrafts, Textile & Coir, Craft Complex, Neugi Nagar, Panaji; applications till 11th April 2022
schemes.notes: Press Note No. DHTC/Swavalamban/2021-22/10 inviting applications for empanelment; scheme rules not included.

schemes.name: Goa Logistics and Warehousing Policy, 2023 - Capital and Interest Subsidy (11.3)
schemes.target: Developers of MMLP/Dry Port/ILP (non-mega), warehouses, cold storage and testing facilities
schemes.eligibility: MMLP/Dry Port (ICD/CFS)/Integrated Logistic Park (ILP) - Non-Mega Project category: minimum area 18 Acres for ICD and Mini-MMLP, 5 Acres for CFS, 1000 sq. metres for AFS. Large Warehouse, Cold Storage and Testing Facilities: minimum area Warehouse 10000 sq.m., Cold Storage and Testing Facilities 2000 sq.m. Warehouse, Cold Storage and Testing Facilities constructed in backward taluka: minimum area Warehouse 1000 sq.m., Cold Storage and Testing Facilities 200 sq.m. Mega projects instead get tailor-made incentives under Goa Industrial Growth and Investment Promotion Policy, 2022
schemes.benefit: MMLP/Dry Port/ILP (non-mega): interest subsidy 5% of annual interest payable on loans taken for construction, for 5 years; capital subsidy 10% of fixed capital invested in building, plant and machinery; capped INR 25 Lakhs/year/unit. Large warehouse/cold storage/testing: 5% interest subsidy for 3 years; 10% capital subsidy; capped INR 25 Lakhs/year/unit. Warehouse/cold storage/testing in backward taluka: 5% interest subsidy for 5 years; 15% capital subsidy; capped INR 50 Lakhs/year/unit
schemes.how_to_apply: A separate detailed notification may be published laying down guidelines and procedures to avail incentives (stated for technology incentives); GIPB acts as State Logistics Cell
schemes.valid_period: Benefits applicable for the first 2 years from the date of issuance of the Policy; extension to be decided after assessment
schemes.notes: Goa Logistics and Warehousing Policy, 2023 published in Official Gazette Series I No. 10 dated 8th June, 2023; notification date/number not in extracted text (trimmed: only Chapter 7 incentives section extracted). Caps are per year per unit (INR 50 Lakhs/year/unit for backward taluka category). Table layout reconstructed from text-layer columns.

schemes.name: Goa Logistics and Warehousing Policy, 2023 - Development Charges concession (11.4)
schemes.target: Developers of logistics units and warehouses
schemes.eligibility: Developers of logistics units and warehouses; stamp duty/registration subsidy considered case-to-case for ICDs/Dry Port/projects not falling under Mega Project Category (Rail based) and Integrated Logistics Parks
schemes.benefit: 50% concession on land conversion charges; Government will strive to subsidise charges such as stamp duty, registration charges etc. on case-to-case basis
schemes.how_to_apply: A separate detailed notification may be published laying down guidelines and procedures to avail incentives (stated for technology incentives); GIPB acts as State Logistics Cell
schemes.valid_period: Benefits applicable for the first 2 years from the date of issuance of the Policy; extension to be decided after assessment
schemes.notes: Goa Logistics and Warehousing Policy, 2023 published in Official Gazette Series I No. 10 dated 8th June, 2023; notification date/number not in extracted text (trimmed: only Chapter 7 incentives section extracted).

schemes.name: Goa Logistics and Warehousing Policy, 2023 - Incentives for Skilling (11.5)
schemes.target: Logistics business units training local manpower
schemes.eligibility: Business units undertaking skill upgradation and training of local manpower
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of 50% of cost of skill upgradation and training of local manpower, per business unit, limited to Rs. 5000/- per person, up to a maximum of 1000 persons for the initial two years
schemes.how_to_apply: A separate detailed notification may be published laying down guidelines and procedures to avail incentives (stated for technology incentives); GIPB acts as State Logistics Cell
schemes.valid_period: Benefits applicable for the first 2 years from the date of issuance of the Policy; extension to be decided after assessment
schemes.notes: Goa Logistics and Warehousing Policy, 2023 published in Official Gazette Series I No. 10 dated 8th June, 2023; notification date/number not in extracted text (trimmed: only Chapter 7 incentives section extracted). max_benefit is the per-person limit (up to 1000 persons per unit).

schemes.name: Goa Logistics and Warehousing Policy, 2023 - Incentives for Technology Enhancements (11.2)
schemes.target: Logistics operators/companies; truck operators registered in Goa
schemes.eligibility: (a) trucks under operators registered in Goa; (b) logistics companies installing logistics management software; (c) units implementing a Quality Management System (IMS/ISO 9001/ISO 14001/OHSAS 18001/SA 8000) in their infrastructure
schemes.benefit: (a) Reimbursement of 50% of cost of installation of tracking devices or INR 1,000 per tracking device per truck, whichever is lower; (b) one-time reimbursement of 50% of cost of installation of logistics management software or INR 20,000 per installation per company, whichever is lower; (c) reimbursement of 50% of cost of implementing a Quality Management System, capped at a maximum of INR 5 Lakh
schemes.how_to_apply: A separate detailed notification may be published laying down guidelines and procedures to avail incentives (stated for technology incentives); GIPB acts as State Logistics Cell
schemes.valid_period: Benefits applicable for the first 2 years from the date of issuance of the Policy; extension to be decided after assessment
schemes.notes: Goa Logistics and Warehousing Policy, 2023 published in Official Gazette Series I No. 10 dated 8th June, 2023; notification date/number not in extracted text (trimmed: only Chapter 7 incentives section extracted). max_benefit is the QMS cap (component c).

schemes.name: Incentives To Encourage Purchase From Local Suppliers Scheme, 2017
schemes.target: Micro, small and medium manufacturing units buying inputs locally
schemes.eligibility: Units under white, green and orange category; micro, small and medium manufacturing units purchasing minimum 50% (in value) of raw material/component/tools (input requirement for production) from local sources/manufacturers; Schedule A negative list (natural resources, major/minor minerals, alcoholic beverages, tobacco) excluded; not applicable if similar benefit claimed under other GoG scheme; registered under Umbrella Scheme.
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement to the extent of 2% of the cost of local purchase consumed by the unit to the maximum of Rs.5.00 lakh per year (value excluding GST); for five consecutive years from first application. Local purchases = every industrial input incl. consumables purchased from Goa (whether manufactured in Goa or not) except service.
schemes.how_to_apply: After close of each financial year (by end of December of subsequent FY) apply in specified format to DITC with Umbrella Scheme registration, affidavit, self-certified local purchase bills, statement of local purchases with GST vouchers, final accounts, CA statement on local purchases, CA certificate of no similar claim, partnership deed/MoA.
schemes.notes: Notification No.3/20/2017-IND, date printed OCR-damaged ('1st August, 20'); Finance concurrence dated 28/06/2018. Per year amount. Subject to budgetary allocation.

schemes.name: Incentives to Green Investment Scheme, 2017
schemes.target: Micro, small, medium and large manufacturing units adopting water/energy audits and energy conservation equipment
schemes.eligibility: Manufacturing units under micro, small, medium and large category registered under the Umbrella Scheme; audits by BEE-certified institution/consultant; equipment certified as energy-conserving fixed asset by BEE-certified institution/consultant; equipment benefit in addition to other State/Central subsidies except Capital Subsidy Scheme benefits for the same energy conservation equipment, with total subsidies capped at 100% of purchase value.
schemes.benefit: (i) Water and Energy Audit Reimbursement: 25% of cost of water and energy audits, maximum Rs. 1.00 lakh per unit during scheme validity; (ii) Energy Conservation Equipment Capital Reimbursement: 40% of capital cost of equipment subject to Rs 10.00 lakh per unit (can be availed multiple times within the ceiling).
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in specified proforma to DITC with Umbrella Scheme registration, self-declaration/affidavit, documentary proof of BEE certification, CA certificate of equipment purchase value and all subsidies/soft loans availed. Task Force Committee includes Member Secretary of Goa Energy Development Corporation (sic).
schemes.valid_period: 1st October 2017 to 30th September 2022
schemes.notes: Finance (Exp.) U.O. No. 1400045039 dated 28/06/2018; no notification date printed. Two components with separate caps (Rs.1 lakh audit; Rs.10 lakh equipment).

schemes.name: Incentives to Industries for Training Prospective Employees Scheme, 2017
schemes.target: Manufacturing enterprises training Goan youth (18-42 years) through approved Skill Training Providers
schemes.eligibility: Micro, Small, Medium and large manufacturing enterprises registered under the Umbrella Scheme; courses only by approved STPs (recognised by DTE, DSCT, DITC); trainees aged 18 to 42 years who are Goans (born in Goa or 10 years Residence Certificate or other residence document issued over 10 years ago); not for refresher/retraining courses; not applicable if similar benefit claimed under other GoG scheme. Stipend/wages paid to trainees not counted as training cost.
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of 60% of training costs for prospective employees subject to a maximum of Rs.60,000/- per employee and Rs 7,20,000/- per unit per year.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed format to Directorate of Industries Trade & Commerce with self-declaration, Umbrella Scheme registration, proposal to STP, STP approval, STP completion certificate, course report with attendance, fee receipt, CA certificate of no similar claim; trainee details with Aadhaar and age proof. Recommended by Task Force Committee.
schemes.notes: Notification No.3/17/2017-IND; date printed is OCR-damaged ('Dated: 0 2018'), Finance concurrence dated 28/06/2018. max_benefit_inr is per unit per year. Subject to budgetary allocation.

schemes.name: The Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme, 2017 (Umbrella Scheme)
schemes.department: Directorate Of Industries, Trade and Commerce
schemes.target: Manufacturing units (mainly micro and small) in Goa; framework for target incentive schemes
schemes.eligibility: Units must submit Udyog Aadhar Memorandum, Permanent Registration Certificate from DITC, or Entrepreneurs Memorandum-II. Target schemes apply to micro and small manufacturing units; medium/large and service units only if specified in a target scheme. Eligible classes (unless target scheme says otherwise): units going into production on/after 1-10-2017; units in production on/after 1-10-2007 that have not availed benefits under old schemes (Schedule B); units in production on/after 1-10-2007 that have not exhausted old-scheme benefits (to extent specified); units that availed old-scheme benefits and carry out substantial expansion (cumulative investment from 1-10-2017 at least 25% of gross investment as on 30-09-2017) during scheme validity. Hinterland eco-tourism projects in lesser developed talukas eligible for Interest Subsidy and Employment Subsidy schemes. Lesser developed talukas: Pernem, Satari, Bicholim, Sanguem, Quepem, Canacona, Dharbandoda.
schemes.benefit: Framework; specific incentives under separately notified target schemes. Maximum cumulative financial benefit: 50% (70% in lesser developed talukas) of Cumulative Capital Investment at original value for new units/units not availing old schemes; maximum 10% additional benefit to all women and SC/ST entrepreneurs; for substantial expansion, 50% (70% in lesser developed talukas) of the substantial expansion investment; for units with unexhausted old benefits, as per Schedules C and D.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to the Director, Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce in the prescribed proforma for each target scheme, within the timeline in Schedule A; applications scrutinised by Task Force Committee (chaired by CEO, Goa Investment Promotion and Facilitation Board); payment within 15 days of sanction with affidavit-cum-self-declaration.
schemes.valid_period: From 01-10-2017 for five years unless extended; old-scheme applications accepted only up to 31-12-2017
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 28 dated 12-10-2017, Notification 3/10/2017-IND/268. Schedules A-D appear as blank pages (likely images, not captured). Same gazette includes Atal Asra Yojana extension to OBC/SC (Social Welfare, Not. 61-22-2017-BC-DSW) but text is cut off mid-eligibility (family income up to Rs. 1.50 lakhs p.a.), so no separate row made.

schemes.name: Capacity Building Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications
schemes.target: State Government officials / policy and decision-making bodies (NeGP HRD and training)
schemes.benefit: Technical & professional support and specialized skills training for e-Governance (e.g. E-sign & GIGW guidelines workshop for State Government officials).
schemes.notes: Brief information note on the NeGP Capacity Building component; M/s Goa Electronics Limited is State Designated Agency; more than 150 officials benefited. No eligibility or amounts stated.

schemes.name: Co-Working Space/ Incubators/ Accelerators Subsidy Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications
schemes.target: Start-ups occupying seats at SPC-listed co-working spaces/incubators/accelerators
schemes.eligibility: Seats at co-working spaces/incubators/accelerators listed by SPC; max 2 years at co-working, 1 year at incubators, 3 months at accelerators; max 8 seats
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of 50% per seat cost: max INR 3000 per seat (co-working), INR 5000 per seat (incubators), INR 6000 per seat (accelerators), up to 8 seats
schemes.how_to_apply: Through Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC); selection by SPC as per its guidelines/due diligence
schemes.notes: Goa Start-up Policy 2017 notified September 2017; summary of 14 schemes formulated under it. Benefits not an entitlement; SPC may accept/reject. Amounts per seat; period unit (monthly) not stated.

schemes.name: Empower ST/SC Communities using ICT tools (IT Knowledge Center - ITKC)
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications
schemes.target: ST/SC communities - local youth, housewives and other citizens
schemes.eligibility: Members of Schedule Tribe (ST)/Schedule Caste (SC) communities.
schemes.benefit: IT Training programmes free of cost: basic computer skills, job oriented IT training courses including BPO Operations/Call Center Executives, structured training programmes.
schemes.how_to_apply: Through IT Knowledge Centres (ITKCs) at various areas in the State, implemented by M/s Info Tech Corporations of Goa Ltd; details at https://infotech.goa.gov.in/itkc.html
schemes.valid_period: Extended for three years, 2019 to 2022
schemes.notes: One-page information note, not formal scheme rules. 2019-20: 328 ST and 25 SC beneficiaries.

schemes.name: Grant for Incubation Centers within educational Institutes Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications
schemes.target: Educational institutes in Goa affiliated to a recognized public university
schemes.eligibility: Educational institutes in Goa affiliated to a recognized public university, setting up or expanding incubators; maximum 15 institutes per year; incubation facilities not restricted to own students
schemes.benefit: One-time grant of up to INR 10 lakh towards capital expenses
schemes.how_to_apply: Through Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC); selection by SPC as per its guidelines/due diligence
schemes.notes: Goa Start-up Policy 2017 notified September 2017; summary of 14 schemes formulated under it. Benefits not an entitlement; SPC may accept/reject.

schemes.name: Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Reimbursement Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications
schemes.target: Start-ups certified by Start-up Promotion Cell (Goa Start-up Policy 2017)
schemes.eligibility: All start-ups certified by the Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC) with a valid start-up certificate number; IP must be registered successfully; [remaining eligibility conditions cut off in text].
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of up to 50% of cost incurred in fees and all other costs associated with IP application, if IP is registered successfully, subject to cap of INR 2 lakh for national IP and INR 5 lakh for international IP. Maximum 200 start-ups each year. Not an entitlement; SPC may accept or reject.

schemes.name: Interest Subsidy Reimbursement Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications
schemes.target: Start-ups with loans

schemes.benefit: 30% of loan interest amount up to INR 5 lakh per annum for initial two years (up to 3 projects); 10% of interest up to INR 2 lakh per year for two years (other start-ups)
schemes.how_to_apply: Through Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC); selection by SPC as per its guidelines/due diligence
schemes.notes: Goa Start-up Policy 2017 notified September 2017; summary of 14 schemes formulated under it. Benefits not an entitlement; SPC may accept/reject. Cap is per annum.

schemes.name: Matching Grant Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications
schemes.target: Pre-launch start-ups raising funds from registered/recognized funding sources
schemes.eligibility: Start-ups certified by SPC with valid start-up certificate number; product not previously available in market; apply at least 1-3 months prior to product launch; bank accounts of Directors linked to Aadhaar; only expenditure incurred after notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2017, within policy validity and paid digitally (else at SPC discretion).
schemes.benefit: 25% of the matching funds or a maximum benefit of INR 25 lakh, at proportionate ownership of stock, subject to SPC due diligence. Availed by 20 start-ups each year. Not an entitlement.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit application form with requisite documents to the Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC) by e-mail or on the web portal; SPC decides within 45 days of receipt and disburses within 60 days of approval. Can apply any time in the financial year.
schemes.valid_period: Expenditure within the validity of Goa Start-up Policy 2017
schemes.notes: Scheme under Goa Start-up Policy 2017; document undated.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications
schemes.target: Youths from backward or rural areas; at least one person from each authorised household
schemes.benefit: Technical and digital literacy training (theoretical and practical).
schemes.how_to_apply: Through registered centres (46 in Goa); https://www.pmgdisha.in
schemes.notes: Central scheme information note; Goa target 40000 citizens. Extension of scheme awaited from Government of India. No eligibility conditions or amounts stated.

schemes.name: R&D Reimbursement Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications
schemes.target: Local (Goan) start-ups in R&D stage
schemes.eligibility: Local start-ups certified by SPC with valid certificate; only Goans and local start-ups (local start-up: at least 50% equity held by one or more Goans continuously since inception; Goan: born in Goa, or domicile of 10 years or more in Goa, or spouse of such person through marriage registered in Goa); Directors' and employees' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar; reimbursed employees hired for at least 12 months and hold PhD or equivalent from Government-recognised institute; in R&D stage developing technology/products in Policy domains; must have a working prototype (preference to patent applied/obtained); only digitally paid expenditure after notification of Policy 2017.
schemes.benefit: 50% of R&D expenses, including salaries of PhD holders employed by start-ups, reimbursed for two years, subject to cap of INR 5 lakh per annum; salary component not in excess of INR 2 lakh. Maximum 100 start-ups each year.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit application form with requisite documents to the Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC) by e-mail or on the web portal; SPC decides within 45 days of receipt and disburses within 60 days of approval. Prior approval from SPC needed (Annexure 2 format); apply within 6 months of incurring expenditure; claim bi-annually/annually.
schemes.valid_period: Expenditure within the validity of Goa Start-up Policy 2017
schemes.notes: INR 5 lakh is per annum for up to two years. Document undated.

schemes.name: Reimbursement of Expenses for Startups Operating from Leased/Privately Owned Premises Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications

schemes.eligibility: Start-ups selected by SPC (20 each year per category); lease rental subsidy only for local start-ups in rented premises. [Eligibility section cut off in text.]
schemes.benefit: Privately owned premises: internet connectivity, software licence and cloud services fees reimbursed up to INR 1 lakh per quarter for one year. Rented premises: same, up to INR 1 lakh per quarter for one year; plus for local start-ups a lease rental subsidy of up to INR 20/- per square foot per month, reimbursed quarterly for up to two years, subject to a cap of INR 3 l[akh - text cut off].
schemes.how_to_apply: Application to SPC (procedure section cut off in text).
schemes.valid_period: Expenditure within the validity of Goa Start-up Policy 2017
schemes.notes: Text truncated mid-clause. max_benefit_inr is the INR 1 lakh per-quarter cap; the lease subsidy cap (apparently INR 3 lakh) is cut off.

schemes.name: Salary Reimbursement Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications
schemes.target: Start-ups hiring local talent
schemes.eligibility: Start-ups hiring local freshers (100 start-ups per year); start-ups whose workforce comprises 60% locals (100 per year); maximum 25 people per start-up
schemes.benefit: 50% of salary of fresher reimbursed, cap INR 10,000 per month per recruit, for 3 years; for 60%-local workforce start-ups up to 25% of salary of local workforce, cap INR 25 lakh per year, for 3 years
schemes.how_to_apply: Through Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC); selection by SPC as per its guidelines/due diligence
schemes.notes: Goa Start-up Policy 2017 notified September 2017; summary of 14 schemes formulated under it. Benefits not an entitlement; SPC may accept/reject. INR 25 lakh is per year cap; fresher component is INR 10,000 per month per recruit.

schemes.name: Seed Capital Scheme

schemes.how_to_apply: Through Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC); selection by SPC as per its guidelines/due diligence
schemes.notes: Goa Start-up Policy 2017 notified September 2017; summary of 14 schemes formulated under it. Benefits not an entitlement; SPC may accept/reject.

schemes.name: Skill Development Fee Reimbursement Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications
schemes.target: Students completing SPC-approved technical skill training

schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of 50% of the fees up to INR 50,000/-
schemes.how_to_apply: Through Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC); selection by SPC as per its guidelines/due diligence
schemes.notes: Goa Start-up Policy 2017 notified September 2017; summary of 14 schemes formulated under it. Benefits not an entitlement; SPC may accept/reject.

schemes.name: Skill Development Promotion Scheme
schemes.department: Department Of Information Technology, Electronics And Communications
schemes.target: Retail educational institutes imparting programming/technical skills in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Educational institutes listed by SPC with valid Startup Cell Registration Number; at least one established learning centre in Goa; recognised by authorised Government body such as AICTE, UGC, NBA as applicable; preference to institutes with OEM tie-ups; employees' and Directors' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar; expenditure from one year before notification of Policy 2017, paid digitally; courses at pre-fixed rates in technical areas of Annexure 2.
schemes.benefit: Internet subsidy up to INR 5 lakh per year for two years; power subsidy up to INR 1 lakh per year for two years; 25% capital investment reimbursement up to INR 5.0 lakh (capital procurement over two years); 10% salary cost subsidy up to INR 3 lakh for two years. Aggregate benefits not to exceed INR 10 lakh per year. Up to 10 institutes per year; reviewed yearly on performance.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit application form with requisite documents to the Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC) by e-mail or on the web portal; SPC decides within 45 days of receipt and disburses within 60 days of approval. Apply within 6 months of incurring expenditure; benefit availed only once in policy period for two consecutive years; claims quarterly/bi-annually/annually.
schemes.valid_period: Expenditure within the validity of Goa Start-up Policy 2017
schemes.notes: INR 10 lakh is the aggregate per-year cap. Document undated.

schemes.how_to_apply: Through IT Knowledge Centers of Info Tech Corporation of Goa Ltd.
schemes.notes: Descriptive department note (implemented since 2010-11); CSC and SOHO support described as plans, no rupee cap per beneficiary stated. Not formal scheme rules.

schemes.how_to_apply: Through Start-up Promotion Cell (SPC); selection by SPC as per its guidelines/due diligence
schemes.notes: Goa Start-up Policy 2017 notified September 2017; summary of 14 schemes formulated under it. Benefits not an entitlement; SPC may accept/reject.

schemes.how_to_apply: Through IT Knowledge Centers of Info Tech Corporation of Goa Ltd.

Treatment of serious diseases (cancer, renal failure, heart) - amount not stated; 9. Mobility equipment for disabled ESM - amount not stated; 10. schemes.notes: Funded from Armed Forces Flag Day Fund (AFFDF)/KSB; funding labelled '100% Central'. Document ends with a second copy of the gallantry award table.

schemes.name: Schemes provided by the State Government to Ex-Servicemen, widows and their dependents
schemes.target: Ex-servicemen, their widows and dependents; gallantry award winners; families of defence personnel killed/disabled
schemes.eligibility: Ex-Servicemen/widows/dependents belonging to the State (registered with Department of Sainik Welfare for some benefits). Conditions per item: WW-II veterans/widows not in receipt of any pension; war widows whose husbands were killed in action prior to Jan 2000; document/stamp duty exemptions only for personal (not commercial/real estate) use.
schemes.benefit: (a) Cash Grant, Cash in lieu of Land and Annuity to Gallantry and Distinguished Service Award winners; (b) special package: Rs. 10.00 lakhs to NOK of deceased in enemy action/action against militants etc., Rs. 3.00 lakhs to disabled in such action; Rs. 8.00 lakhs to NOK / Rs. 2.00 lakhs to disabled for accidents attributable to military service; Rs. 8.00 lakhs to NOK / Rs. 2.00 lakh to disabled from acts of violence by terrorists/anti-social elements; (c) Rs. 8000/- per month to WW-II Veterans and widows not in receipt of pension; (d) Rs. 2500/- per month to War Widows (killed in action prior to Jan 2000); (e) registration fee exemption; (f) house tax exemption; (g) stamp duty exemption; (h) 2% reservation in Group C and D posts; (i) 1% seats for children in professional colleges/ITI/Polytechnic; (j) exam fee exemption for State Civil Service; (k) Green Card for NOK of martyrs; (l) 3% quota for Fair Price Shop; (m) 2% quota in Goa Housing Board plots/flats; (n) free KTCL bus travel for WW-II veterans and widows; (o) 50% VAT exemption on motor car purchase for registered ex-servicemen.
schemes.notes: Summary list from OCR (minor OCR damage in numbering). Monthly pensions: Rs. 8000/month (WW-II) and Rs. 2500/month (war widows). Could be split into components; kept as one row as it is a summary list without application procedure. Undated.

schemes.name: Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana (Grant of Financial Assistance for Performance of Funeral and Religious Ceremonies related to last rites of a person of ST Community)
schemes.target: ST families in which a death has occurred
schemes.eligibility: ST family with income not exceeding Rs. 2.00 lakhs per annum; resident of Goa for last 15 years; not covered under any other Government scheme; claim within 6 months of death by next of kin.
schemes.benefit: Rs. 20,000/- or actual cost whichever is less for funeral and last-rite religious ceremonies (incl. 12th/30th day rites) in Goa.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application to Tribal Welfare Department within 6 months with caste certificate, income certificate, death certificate, bills/receipts; enclosures ration card, election card, residence certificate.
schemes.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/55, Official Gazette Series I No. 29 dated 18-10-2012. Document also contains fragments of an unrelated 2012 scheme notification (DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/51) and hospital empanelment order.

amendments.name: Amendment to Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana (2015)
amendments.benefit: Unchanged.
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13; date OCR-damaged ('Panaji, May, 2015'); gazette Series I No. 8 dated 21-05-2015 per later reference.

amendments.name: Amendment to Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana (2018)
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/Amendment/2018-19, Official Gazette Series I No. 11 dated 14-06-2018.

amendments.name: Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana
amendments.benefit: Financial assistance (amount not visible in extracted text).
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13 in Official Gazette Series I No. 8 dated 21-5-2015; signature line reads 'Panaji, May, 2015' (day missing). Amends Sr. Nos. 3, 4 and 8 of the scheme; the assistance amount is not visible (text partly trimmed).

amendments.name: Grant of Financial Assistance for Performance of Funeral and Religious Ceremonies of Scheduled Tribe families under Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana Scheme
amendments.benefit: Not changed by this amendment (amount not stated).
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/SAT/PC/2021-22/64/4307, Official Gazette Series I No. 36 dated 08-12-2022. Also amends Clause 7: Monitoring Committee of Secretary Tribal Welfare (Chairman), Director Tribal Welfare (Member), Dy. Director Tribal Welfare (Member Secretary). Rest of gazette is unrelated (CZMA fees, recruitment rules).

schemes.name: Ashraya Adhar Scheme (Goa State Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation Ltd.)
schemes.target: ST members needing repair/renovation/reconstruction of house
schemes.eligibility: Any person of Scheduled Tribe community having a house (including mundcarial house) owned individually or jointly; where jointly owned with separate family units residing separately, each unit eligible (family = husband, wife, unmarried children, plus dependent parents and unmarried siblings staying with applicant). Age not more than 55 years on date of application (relaxed to 58 for employees of State/Central Government, Government Corporation/Board or aided institute).
schemes.benefit: Loan up to Rs. 5,00,000/- at 2% simple interest per annum for repair/renovation/reconstruction of house; released in two instalments: Rs. 3,75,000/- on sanction and Rs. 1,25,000/- on utilisation of first (work to start within 3 months). Repayment in 120 EMIs over 10 years with 3-month moratorium (interest charged during moratorium); applicants above 50 repay by age 60; govt employees by retirement + 6 months; 2% interest on overdue instalments; life and property insurance premium borne by loanee.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed loan application form with 2 passport photos to the Corporation, with ST certificate, age proof, notarised affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper, latest house tax receipt, NOC from co-owner, income proof, 2 sureties (one if govt-employed surety; none if applicant is govt employee), estimate of cost, photos of house, Aadhaar, bank mandate; physical verification by Corporation officer; approved by Chairman with a Director and sanctioned by Managing Director.
schemes.valid_period: Implemented by GSSTFDC Ltd. for five years from date of issue
schemes.notes: Notification DTW/ADMN/GSSTFDCL/171/2018-19/LA/6911, Official Gazette Series I No. 39 dated 27-12-2018; signing date not in text. Benefit is a concessional loan, not a grant. Recoverable as land revenue arrears on default.

schemes.name: Ashraya Adhar Scheme (Goa State Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation Ltd., Panaji)
schemes.target: Scheduled Tribe members owning a house needing repair/renovation/reconstruction
schemes.eligibility: Any person belonging to Scheduled Tribe Community having his house (including mundcarial house) owned individually or jointly; if jointly owned with different family units residing separately, each unit eligible (family = husband, wife, unmarried children, plus dependent father, mother and unmarried brothers/sisters staying with applicant). Age not more than 55 years on date of loan application, relaxed up to 58 years for employees of State/Central Government/Government Corporation/Board or aided Institute.
schemes.benefit: Loan up to Rs. 5,00,000/- at 2% simple interest per annum for repair/renovation/reconstruction of house, released in two installments: Rs. 3,75,000/- immediately after sanction, Rs. 1,25,000/- on utilization of first installment. Repayment in 120 equated monthly installments within 10 years with 3-month moratorium (interest charged during moratorium); repayment re-fixed till age 60 if applicant above 50, or till retirement + 6 months for government employees. 2% interest on overdue installments. Life and property insurance premium borne by loanee.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed loan application form with 2 passport photos to the Corporation; scrutiny and physical verification by Corporation officer; approval by Chairman with one Director, sanction by Managing Director. Documents: ST certificate, age proof, self affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper (notarized), latest house tax receipt, NOC from co-owner (if any) on Rs. 50 stamp paper, income proof, 2 sureties (one govt-employee surety suffices; none needed if applicant is govt employee), estimated cost of work (as per format), photos of house, Aadhar copy, two photos, bank mandate form. Work to commence within 3 months of release.
schemes.valid_period: Implemented by Goa State Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation Limited for five years from the date of issue
schemes.notes: Notification No. DTW/ADMN/GSSTFDCL/171/2018-19/LA/6911 in Official Gazette Series I No. 39 dated 27-12-2018; signing date not visible (text cut). It is a loan scheme, not a grant. Funding source not stated. Not the portal-title scheme; included as complete in text.

schemes.name: Assistance for construction of retaining wall for soil conservation
schemes.target: Farmers needing soil/field protection through retaining walls
schemes.eligibility: Farmer should be registered under Krishi Card Programme; apply in prescribed format indicating approximate length and height of proposed retaining wall; existing structures are not eligible.
schemes.benefit: Assistance @ 50% of cost for construction of retaining wall of average width 0.4 mt and height upto 1.5 mts. Random masonry with hard laterite stones: standard rate Rs. 285/- per sq m, assistance Rs. 142/-; masonry with river pebble stones: standard rate Rs. 340/- per sq m, assistance Rs. 170/-.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to Zonal Agriculture Officer before commencement of work with photo (with natural reference point); ZAO/District Agriculture Office scrutinizes, inspects site and issues administrative approval; after completion submit photo, bills/vouchers to ZAO, claim forwarded to District Agriculture Office. Documents: copy of Krishi Card, GAR-32 in duplicate, bills and vouchers.
schemes.valid_period: Immediate effect; in force till withdrawn or amended
schemes.notes: Issued by Directorate of Agriculture (Not. 3/4/Agron/PPG/3-2(3)/2015-16/D.Agri/115) in the same gazette issue; header department is Tribal Welfare because the portal file is filed under Atal Asra Yojana. Assistance is per sq m; no overall ceiling stated. 'State' funding inferred from Finance Dept concurrence only.

schemes.name: Assistance to traditional/Artisanal Fishermen for (a) Procurement of FRP boats up to 10 meters OAL as a replacement for traditional/wooden boats including net (b) Procurement of insulated fish and ice holding boxes
schemes.target: Traditional/artisanal fishermen replacing wooden canoes
schemes.eligibility: Must possess NOC issued by Directorate of Fisheries for procurement of FRP craft up to 10 m OAL replacing old wooden canoe and purchase of fishing net and insulated boxes; produce original GST bill from authorized dealer; applicant shall not be a fishing trawler owner or defaulter of the Department. Fishermen who availed other State scheme (financial assistance for fisheries requisites - gill net with accessories and insulated boxes) not eligible for subsidy on both equipments, but eligible for subsidy on fishing canoe only.
schemes.benefit: General category: 40% of unit cost limited to Rs. 1,70,000/- (canoe unit cost Rs. 4,00,000/- subsidy Rs. 1,60,000/-; insulated fish/ice boxes unit cost Rs. 25,000/- subsidy Rs. 10,000/-). SC, ST, Women and their co-operatives: 60% of unit cost limited to Rs. 2,55,000/- (canoe Rs. 2,40,000/-; boxes Rs. 15,000/-). Subsidy shared Central 60% / State 40%; paid by ECS/DBT.
schemes.how_to_apply: Obtain NOC from Directorate of Fisheries; claim subsidy with original GST bill; craft and nets to be registered with Directorate of Fisheries; not to sell/mortgage/transfer for five years.
schemes.valid_period: Immediate effect
schemes.notes: Issued by Directorate of Fisheries (Not. DF/GB/SCHEME/ARTISINAL F.M./2017-18) under Blue Revolution scheme, in the same gazette issue; header department is Tribal Welfare because of portal filing.

schemes.name: Atal Asra Yojana (Financial Assistance for Construction of New Houses and Repairs)
schemes.target: ST families of Goa needing construction/reconstruction/repair of houses
schemes.eligibility: Any individual from ST community of State of Goa having family income upto Rs. 1.50 lakhs p.a. (family = father/mother/spouse/son and unmarried daughter; major son residing separately excluded). Applicant should be owner of the land; construction per plan by registered Engineer/Architect. Assistance in addition to and irrespective of Rajiv Awas Yojana/Indira Awas Yojana. Priority: BPL families first; households headed by widow/unmarried/divorcee women; physically disabled; households affected by flood, fire, natural calamities; forest dwelling applicants; others. No second sanction for same house except deserving case with Monitoring Committee approval
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs. 2.00 lakhs for construction of new house or reconstruction of existing house; up to Rs. 75,000/- for repairs; Monitoring Committee may increase limit to Rs. 2.50 lakhs and Rs. 1.00 lakh respectively in deserving cases. Fees of registered Engineer/Architect paid directly by Director of Tribal Welfare, max 5% of total cost
schemes.how_to_apply: Documents include family income certificate issued by V.P. Secretary countersigned by BDO (Village Panchayat areas) or by Chief Officer of Municipal Council (municipal areas); estimate by registered Engineer/Architect (or self/mason for reconstruction/repairs, no fee reimbursed); where construction permission is pending, BDO processes file and recommends
schemes.later_amendments: 20-04-2020 – Amendment to Atal Asra Yojana (recovery/closure and evaluation clauses, 2020); 2022-04-05 – Atal Asra Yojana
schemes.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/51/5879 (Official Gazette Series I No. 41 dated 9th January, 2014) replaces scheme notified vide No. DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/51 dated 14th March, 2013. Signing date not in text. Trimmed: conditions of sanction cut off mid-clause; later clauses may be on later pages. Portal title refers to recruitment rules in same gazette.

amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2017-18/51, Official Gazette Series I No. 45 dated 08-02-2018 (signature date not in extracted text). Work to commence within 90 days; 2nd instalment applied within 90 days. Trimmed.

amendments.name: Atal Asra Yojana
amendments.benefit: Financial assistance for construction, re-construction and repairs of house (amounts not stated in this amendment).

amendments.name: Atal Asra Yojana
amendments.benefit: Clause 4 (Benefit under the Scheme), addendum clause (iii) amended: Construction/Re-construction licence fees for construction or re-construction of house under the scheme will be exempted to beneficiaries subject to maximum of Rs. 1,050/- for which area of house falls in the jurisdiction of Village [Panchayat - text cut off].
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/51/3316 in Official Gazette Series I No. 14 dated 02-07-2015; signing date not in text (truncated mid-clause). Same gazette has Goa Land Development and Building Construction (Amendment) Regulations, 2015 inserting Annexure XV for Atal Asra Yojana houses: should conform to Settlement Zone of RPG 2021; no new construction in Eco-I land (repairs in forest/1 km buffer with Forest NOC); max 100 sq. m plinth, ground plus one floor, total built-up not over 150 sq. m; min plot 60 sq. m for new construction, coverage of reconstruction not over 60%; at least 1.50 m access and 1.00 m side setback; no conversion Sanad/licence copy insisted for repairs; applicant must own land or have irrevocable NOC/Mundkar proof; no infrastructure tax or other fees. Rs. 1,050 is a licence-fee exemption cap, not the main housing grant (main benefit amounts not in text). Trimmed: details may be on later pages.

schemes.name: Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana - Coaching to Scheduled Tribe Students Studying in Class Xth, XIth & XIIth
schemes.target: ST students in class X, XI (Science), XII (Arts, Science, Commerce) taking coaching
schemes.eligibility: Student belongs to ST category (communities notified in Goa); regular full-time student in Government school/higher secondary or school recognised by Government of Goa or Central/State Board, attending regular classes in institutions in Goa aided by Government of Goa; no income limit; not for open school or similar mode; fees not reimbursed for a repeated class; benefit once per standard (once on change of stream); coaching institute in Goa recognised by Directorate of Education or registered under Goa Coaching Classes Regulation Act, 2001; must apply each academic year (no deemed renewal).
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement of 75% of coaching fees paid, up to a ceiling of Rs. 10,000/- per annum per subject in rural areas and Rs. 12,000/- per annum per subject in urban areas. Subjects: X - Mathematics, Science, English; XI Science and XII Science - Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology; XII Commerce - Accountancy, Mathematics; XII Arts - English, Economics. Paid by DBT: 50% in first term on fee receipt, 25% after first-term attendance certificate. Refund required if coaching discontinued.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed application form available at Director, Tribal Welfare, Panaji and Office of Dy. Director, Tribal Welfare, Margao; affix signed photo; documents: caste certificate, birth certificate, Aadhar card, bank mandate form, institution ID card, fee receipt and fee structure, coaching institute registration certificate; coaching institute certifies enrolment. Director of Tribal Welfare sanctions.
schemes.notes: Not. DTW/AD(N)/EPY/2022-23/CSS-37/2854, OG Series I No. 27 dated 06-10-2022. Max is per subject per annum (urban). Budget head 2225-02-277-17. Same gazette has S&T 'Scheme to encourage students for innovative projects' (only tail visible; up to Rs. 50,000 per project) - not extracted.

schemes.name: Exit Policy for distressed beneficiaries under the Chief Minister's Rojgar Yojana (CMRY)/Dr. Verghese Kurien Rojgar Yojana (VKRY) Scheme
schemes.target: Distressed CMRY/VKRY loanees of EDC Ltd. (since 2001) and their heirs
schemes.eligibility: All CMRY/VKRY loan accounts with EDC Ltd. since 2001 (also Share Capital Assistance to Local Entrepreneurs and Self Employed Scheme of DITC). Category A: death of beneficiary during currency of loan (past or future); Category B: permanent disability during currency of loan; Category C: incapable to repay due to natural calamities, critical health of borrower/dependant, adverse market conditions or sector impact announced by Government, or other justified reason.
schemes.benefit: Relief from repayment of outstanding loan on case to case basis; Category A: TFC may recommend waiver of entire outstanding EDC term loan with interest, cost and expenses and outstanding Share Capital (DITC) with interest, and handing over financed assets to legal heirs; disability cases decided after valuation of assets if beneficiary continues to use them.
schemes.how_to_apply: Legal heir/next of kin/guarantor furnishes death certificate and letter requesting waiver to EDC Ltd.; placed before Task Force Committee (TFC); waiver ratified by Competent Authority.
schemes.valid_period: 5 years from publication or as further extended
schemes.notes: Department of Finance (DMU) Not. 6/21/2015-FIN; no rupee cap. Category B/C procedures partly cut off. Official Gazette Series I No. 27 dated 01-10-2015; two-column text interleaved; trimmed.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to facilitate community level action for growth of agriculture and for preparing conservation management plan of community forest resources
schemes.target: Tribal (ST) farmers' co-operatives and Forest Rights Act committees
schemes.eligibility: Target population: cultivators/agriculturists of Scheduled Tribe community or forest dwelling STs dependent on Community Forest Resources in areas/villages where Forest Rights Act is implemented. Eligible: (1) Tribal farmers co-operatives registered under the Co-operative Societies Act formed for improved productivity or marketing of farm/forest produce; (2) committees constituted by Gram Sabhas to manage Community Forest Resources under FRA; (3) Forest Right Committees under FRA; (4) Village Panchayat in whose jurisdiction such co-operative/committees are constituted. At least 50% of co-operative members must be ST; minimum 10 ST beneficiaries; land ownership documents/NOC from owner.
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance for running activities: (1) wages of one clerical assistant and one peon at rates fixed under Minimum Wages Act; (2) fixed amount of Rs. 25,000/- per annum for stationery, printing etc.; (3) one time financial assistance of Rs. 1,00,000/- for procurement of desktop computer, UPS, computer table, cupboard, table and chairs etc.; (4) rent per annum for office premises as per rent certificate issued by PWD (Bldg Division). 50% of sanctioned amount released as 1st installment; balance after utilization certificate.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed form to the Zonal Agriculture Officer with: FRC/committee constitution notification, registration certificate of co-operative, Gram Sabha resolution, brief project report, constitution and composition, PWD rent certificate, land ownership documents/NOC, ST certificates, undertaking, ZAO recommendation certificate, Aadhaar copy, mandate form. ZAO forwards to Director of Tribal Welfare, who sanctions.
schemes.valid_period: In force from date of notification; to be evaluated after two years
schemes.notes: Published in Official Gazette Series I No. 39 dated 24-12-2015 (Not. No. DTW/STAT/FA/2014-15/1/14841). Funding source not explicitly stated beyond Government of Goa/Tribal Welfare. Village Panchayat listed as an eligible entity. Same gazette contains 'Financial Assistance to Participate and Organize Exhibition cum Sale, Fairs and Workshop Camp as Udyog Adhar Yojana' but its text is cut off, so not extracted.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to facilitate community level action for growth of agriculture and for preparing conservation management plan of community forest resources, i.e. Sheti Samrudhi Yojana
schemes.target: ST cultivators/forest-dwelling STs organised in farmers co-operatives or FRA committees
schemes.eligibility: Tribal farmers co-operatives registered under Co-operative Societies Act (formed for improved productivity or marketing of farm/forest produce; 50% of members ST); committees constituted by Gram Sabhas to manage community forest resources under Forest Right Act; Forest Right Committees under FRA; Village Panchayat in whose jurisdiction such co-operatives/committees are constituted. Areas/villages where FRA is implemented; minimum 10 ST beneficiaries.
schemes.benefit: For running activities: (1) wages of one clerical assistant and one peon at Minimum Wages Act rates; (2) fixed Rs. 25,000/- per annum for stationery, printing etc.; (3) one time Rs. 1,00,000/- for Desktop Computer, UPS, computer table, cupboard, table and chairs etc.; (4) rent as per PWD (Bldg. Division) Rent Certificate with minimum limit of Rs. 8,000/- per month urban and Rs. 5,000/- per month rural, enhanced @10% every 3 years. Released 50% first installment, balance after utilization certificate.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed application form to the Zonal Agriculture Officer with: ST certificates of members, registration certificate, Gram Sabha/Village Panchayat resolution, ST certificates (min 10 beneficiaries), land ownership/NOC, brief project report, undertaking on sharing resources, constitution of co-operative/committee, notification of committee, PWD rent certificate, ZAO recommendation, Aadhar copy, mandate form. ZAO forwards to Director of Tribal Welfare who sanctions.
schemes.notes: Not. DTW/STAT/FA/2014-15/1/7004 in OG Series I No. 29 dated 20-10-2016, superseding Not. dated 24-12-2015 (modified scheme; signature date not in extracted text). Village Panchayat is an eligible applicant and Gram Sabha/VP resolution required. Max = one-time Rs. 1,00,000 grant (recurring items separate).

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to Participate and Organize Exhibition cum Sale, Fairs and Workshop Camp as Udyog Adhar Yojana
schemes.target: ST artisans/producers and NGOs organising exhibitions for ST people
schemes.eligibility: Individual or group of individuals of Scheduled Tribe category with own capacity to produce/make/market the product for exhibition cum sale; NGOs working for benefit of ST people (for organizing exhibition/fair)
schemes.benefit: (1) Value addition and skill development: max Rs. 1,00,000/- per annum per individual/group/NGO; (2) preparatory work (raw materials, making charges, labour) max Rs. 50,000/- per annum; (3) actual cost of transportation, participation fees, daily allowance max Rs. 50,000/- per annum; (4) actual cost of organizing exhibition/fair/workshop for NGOs max Rs. 1,00,000/- per annum; (5) 50% advance as 1st instalment, balance on production of receipts/bills
schemes.how_to_apply: Proof of Aadhaar or Aadhaar authentication required (or enrolment slip plus bank/post office passbook with photo, PAN, passport, ration card, voter ID)
schemes.notes: Aadhaar Act section 7 notification (DTW/STAT/Aadhaar Notification/2020-21/21/4712) in OG Series I No. 41 dated 6th January, 2022; text cut off before signing date. Amounts are per annum; max_benefit is the largest single component cap. OCR text.

amendments.name: Udyog Adhar Yojana (Financial Assistance to participate and organize exhibition-cum-sale, fairs and workshop camps)
amendments.benefit: Individual: up to Rs. 10,000/- per annum (participation fee Rs. 5,000/-, transport Rs. 2,500/-, raw materials Rs. 1,500/-, labour Rs. 1,000/-). NGO/Society: actual cost up to Rs. 1,00,000/- per annum to organise exhibition/fairs/sale for ST persons within or outside Goa; 50% as 1st instalment, balance 50% on original bills, photographs and report within one month of the event.
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/Exhibitions/2022-23/54/3601, Official Gazette Series I No. 31 dated 03-11-2022. Individual max is Rs. 10,000 per annum; Rs. 1,00,000 is the NGO cap. Gazette also contains StartUp Policy 2021 schemes (only tail annexures in text).

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to ST students under "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana"
schemes.target: ST students from remote areas staying in rented/PG accommodation or travelling long distances; ST students with disability
schemes.eligibility: Original 2012 clauses largely illegible in OCR. Introduction: aimed at ST students who stay in rented houses/paying guest or travel long distances, and poor ST students with disability; supplements Post Matric Scholarship. Income criterion (clause 1(d)) later amended: < Rs. 2,50,000 (2015), < Rs. 3.00 lakhs (2018), parents' income not exceeding Rs. 3.00 lakh (2020).
schemes.benefit: Not legible in OCR text (benefit amounts not visible).
schemes.valid_period: Scheme to be implemented for five years; performance evaluated after two years
schemes.later_amendments: 06-10-2015 – Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana (Amended scheme); 11-11-2020 – Amendment to the Scheme Financial Assistance to ST students under "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana" (2020); 2021-08-24 – Amendment to Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana - introduction sub-clause (d) (2015); 22-02-2018 – Amendment to Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana - income criteria clause 1(d) (2018); 25-01-2022 – Amendment to Scheme Financial Assistance to ST students under "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana"
schemes.notes: Not. DTW/STAT/2012-13/571 (Director Arvind Bugde, 12th October 2012), OG Series I No. 29 dated 18-10-2012. Heavy OCR damage; only fragments (introduction, monitoring committee: Secretary TW chairman, JS Finance, PD RDA, Director of Panchayats, Director of Social Welfare, Director of TW; monthly/annual reports; evaluation) readable.
