schemes.name: Goa State Cultural Award Scheme
schemes.target: Eminent Goan artists (lifetime achievement in art & culture)
schemes.eligibility: Individual artist who has completed 60 years of age with extraordinary contribution to art & culture; contributed in his/her field of art in Goa for minimum 10 years; recipients of Kala Gaurav Puraskar not eligible; not eligible a second time; no posthumous award (except death after recommendation); maximum 12 persons per year across fields (Music, Dance, Drama/Theatre incl. Tiatr, Performing Folk Art, Fine Art & Craft, Bhajan/Kirtan/Choir, Film & AV, Overall contribution, Literature, Creative Photography).
schemes.benefit: Memento, shawl, sriphal, certificate of appreciation and financial purse of Rs. 1,00,000/- per individual, plus monthly financial assistance (pension) of Rs. 3,200/- under the Kala Sanman scheme (not if already availing pension under any State or Central scheme; not paid to dependent after death).
schemes.how_to_apply: Department of Art & Culture releases press advertisement each year inviting recommendations from eminent institutions/individuals; Task Force Committee may also consider names suo-moto and recommends to Director of Art & Culture.
schemes.valid_period: From publication in Official Gazette upto 31st March, 2021
schemes.notes: Issued by Directorate of Art & Culture (Not. DAC/COMPCELL/10-SCHEMES/2015-16/7594), repealing earlier notification; same gazette issue (24-12-2015) as the Tribal Welfare scheme; header department is Tribal Welfare because of portal filing. 'State' funding inferred (Govt of Goa scheme).

schemes.name: Goa Welfare/Pension Scheme for Seafarers, 2021
schemes.target: Retired Indian seamen from Goa in lowly paid sea jobs, seamen invalidated on medical grounds, and widows of deceased seamen
schemes.eligibility: Citizen of India; Seaman of category in Annexure on completion of 60 years of age, employed on board and retired, or invalidated from sea service on medical grounds before retirement, or widow of deceased Seaman; annual income from all sources not exceeding Rs. 1,20,000/-; total 120 months actual service on board (breaks up to 6 months condoned; not applicable to medically invalidated or widows); bonafide resident of Goa by birth, or birth registered in Goa, or either parent born in Goa; widow must be resident of Goa of fifteen years domicile.
schemes.benefit: Gross pension of Rs. 2,500/- per month, remitted on last working day of every month; if in receipt of Dayanand Social Security Scheme/Griha Aadhaar/Kala Samman pension less than this, only the difference is paid.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in Form I to the Office of the Commissioner for NRI Affairs with CDC/Seafarers Identity Document, birth certificate/school leaving certificate, medical certificate (invalidation), death and marriage certificates (widows), income certificate Form II, residence certificate Form III, life certificate Form IV (annually before 31st March), affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper Form V, Voter ID, Aadhaar. Beneficiaries under 2018 scheme continue on production of life certificate.
schemes.valid_period: Deemed in force from 01-12-2021 up to 30-11-2022
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of Home (Foreigners & Citizenship Division), Not. 4/9/2020-HD(F&CD)/NRI/05; date not visible. max_benefit_inr is monthly (Rs. 2,500 per month). Annexure of seamen categories not in extract.

schemes.name: Human Resource Development in Agriculture — Support for education in Agriculture
schemes.target: Goan students pursuing B.Sc/M.Sc (Agri/Hort) and allied degrees (children of farming community)
schemes.eligibility: Apply in prescribed proforma Annexure I; resident of Goa for minimum period of 15 years; selection on merit (aggregate marks of qualifying exam as points) with weightage: student from agricultural family having land in own/parent's/paternal parent's name (Form I & XIV) for B.Sc (Agri)/(Hort) - 10 points; fishing family for B.Sc (Fish...) [OCR gap]; inter-collegiate games/sports - 2 points; B.Sc degree holders seeking admission to UG agriculture/allied - 6 points; maximum added points 20. Post graduation support only for those admitted on own merit. Selected candidates make own stay/travel arrangements and execute bond on Rs. 50 non-judicial stamp paper.
schemes.benefit: Graduation B.Sc (Agri/Hort): Rs. 10,000/- per year/per seat paid to the University as per agreement; educational support Rs. 2,000/- per month for undergraduate students during entire period of study for maximum 4 years. Post Graduation M.Sc (Agri/Hort): educational support Rs. 3000/- per month during entire period of study.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed proforma (Annexure I) to Directorate of Agriculture; submit copy of admission fee receipt after admission.
schemes.valid_period: In force with immediate effect till withdrawn
schemes.later_amendments: 2020-10-13 – Human Resource Development in Agriculture - Study Tour outside State; 2020-10-13 – Human Resource Development in Agriculture - Workshops/Exhibitions/Seminars/Krishi Melas/Trainings; 2020-10-13 – Human Resource Development in Agriculture - Support for education in Agriculture and allied sciences
schemes.notes: max_benefit_inr is a monthly figure (Rs. 3000 per month for PG; Rs. 2000 per month for UG); Rs. 10,000 per year per seat is paid to the University. Part of criteria list lost in trimming. Component 3.9 'Assistance for Agriculture Training Centre' cut off. Issued by Department of Agriculture (Directorate of Agriculture), Not. No. 3/5/EXT/38/Scheme/2013-14/D.Agri/381, published in Official Gazette Series I No. 25 dated 19-09-2013; signing date not visible in extract. Same gazette as the Sanskruti Bhavan amendment (portal title). Trimmed: parts of the text are excerpts.

schemes.name: Human Resource Development in Agriculture — Trainings and study tours
schemes.target: Farmers, farm workers, agricultural labourers, rural youth, students
schemes.eligibility: Skill development in farming operation (2 months, 20 participants/batch): individual/farmers or school dropouts, unemployed rural youth having marginal land or family land or belonging to family of agriculture labourer. Skill development in operation of agricultural machinery: individual/farmer/agriculture labourer having LMV licence. On-campus training: any individual farmer cultivating own or other's land, agricultural labourer, member of NGO, farmers clubs, students from high schools/colleges, with recommendation of Zonal Agricultural Officer. Off-campus training: any farmer, land owner, agricultural labourer, members of farmers clubs, students, women self help groups etc. Study tour within State: farmers cultivating own crops or interested, with recommendation of Zonal Agricultural Officer. Study tour outside State: farmers cultivating own/leased/rented land, agriculture officers, students of agriculture, members of farmers clubs, agri co-operatives, with recommendation of Zonal Agricultural Officer.
schemes.benefit: Skill development trainings: Rs. 300 per day per trainee towards food, refreshment, travel etc. (reduced where Department provides these), certificate at end; external experts @ Rs. 800 per demonstration. On-campus training (2 days, Farmers Training Centre, Ela, Old-Goa, 25 per batch): Rs. 300 per trainee. Off-campus training (1 day, 20-40 participants): expenditure up to Rs. 5000 per training plus Rs. 4000 per training for P.O.L.; expert honorarium Rs. 800 per day. Officers' training: Rs. 150 per day per officer/staff. Study tour within State: Rs. 200 per trainee for lunch, refreshment, stationery plus actual bus fare. Study tour outside State (90 farmers/year, 3 batches, 5-6 days): stipend Rs. 600 per day towards lunch, refreshment and lodging plus actual bus fare or 3-tier A.C. train fare.
schemes.how_to_apply: Through recommendation of the Zonal Agricultural Officer (for on-campus training and study tours); trainings conducted by Departmental Officers.
schemes.valid_period: In force with immediate effect till withdrawn
schemes.notes: Per-day/per-trainee rates only; no single per-beneficiary total stated, so max_benefit_inr left null. Other components: mobile training vehicle (Rs. 15.00 lakhs) for ST farmers in distant areas. Issued by Department of Agriculture (Directorate of Agriculture), Not. No. 3/5/EXT/38/Scheme/2013-14/D.Agri/381, published in Official Gazette Series I No. 25 dated 19-09-2013; signing date not visible in extract. Same gazette as the Sanskruti Bhavan amendment (portal title). Trimmed: parts of the text are excerpts.

schemes.name: Human Resource Development in Agriculture — Workshops/Exhibitions/Seminars sponsorship
schemes.target: Farmers Clubs, NGOs, voluntary organisations, professional institutes organising agricultural events
schemes.eligibility: Farmers Club, NGOs, voluntary organisations or professional institutes organising workshops/exhibitions/seminars must be a registered body and submit duly audited Statement of Accounts for last 3 years.
schemes.benefit: Department will provide maximum assistance of 50% of the cost with specific approval of Government upon receipt of detail proposal. Rs. 5.00 lakhs allocated for the component.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit detailed proposal with audited accounts for last 3 years to Department of Agriculture.
schemes.valid_period: In force with immediate effect till withdrawn
schemes.notes: Rs. 5.00 lakhs is the component allocation, not a per-beneficiary cap. Issued by Department of Agriculture (Directorate of Agriculture), Not. No. 3/5/EXT/38/Scheme/2013-14/D.Agri/381, published in Official Gazette Series I No. 25 dated 19-09-2013; signing date not visible in extract. Same gazette as the Sanskruti Bhavan amendment (portal title). Trimmed: parts of the text are excerpts.

schemes.name: MATRUTVA YOJANA - Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment for infertility amongst Scheduled Tribe couples by IVF (Invitro Fertilization) & IUI (Intra Uterine Insemination) Method
schemes.target: ST married couples with primary infertility
schemes.eligibility: Couples belonging to Scheduled Tribes; married couple who fail to conceive even after three years of marriage due to primary infertility; only cases of primary infertility; no income limit; benefit for birth of first born child only
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance for actual cost of IVF/IUI treatment at Government Hospitals or empanelled Private Hospitals/Nursing Homes in Goa, including diagnostic investigation, medicine, hospital admission, professional fees of Obstetrics and Gynaecology specialist in a specified course/package, and procedures like Laparoscopy; maximum Rs. 5.00 Lakhs (expenditure above borne by beneficiary). Funds of Rs. 5.00 lakhs transferred to Goa Scheduled Tribe Finance and Development Corporation account 'Matrutva Yojana'; payments in stages per treatment cycle (up to 4 cycles)
schemes.how_to_apply: Application form in Annexure-I to Directorate of Tribal Welfare with copy of provisional ST certificate issued by Dy. Collector with verification certificate of Director of Tribal Welfare, Marriage Certificate, Aadhar Card copy. Scrutiny Committee -> medical examination at Government Hospital -> Monitoring Committee -> Sanctioning Committee (chaired by Minister for Tribal Welfare); treatment to commence within 6 months of order
schemes.later_amendments: 2022-04-05 – MATRUTVA YOJANA - Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment for infertility amongst Scheduled Tribe couples by IVF (Invitro Fertilization) & IUI (Intra Uterine Insemination) Method; 26-08-2021 – Financial Assistance for Medical Treatment for infertility amongst Scheduled Tribe couples by IVF (Invitro Fertilization) & IUI (Intra Uterine Insemination) Method under Matrutva Yojana
schemes.notes: Revised scheme notified vide Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2017-18/53 in Official Gazette Series I No. 45 dated 8th February, 2018, replacing original Notification No. DTW/STAT/PC/2016-17/53/9274 (OG Series I No. 37 dated 15-12-2016). Signing date not in extracted text. Trimmed: bill procedure and later clauses may be on later pages.

schemes.name: Merit based Award and recognition of high performance in the Board Exams of SSC and HSSC in the State of Goa
schemes.target: ST students who passed SSC/HSSC board exams
schemes.eligibility: Students belonging to Scheduled Tribes who qualified SSCE/HSSCE Board Examination of Goa Board or any recognized Board conducting SSC/HSSC exams for students in Goa. A. Rank holders: first five rank holders among ST students in SSC and in HSSC (separately for Science, Commerce, Arts and Vocational streams) - no income ceiling. B. Merit award: ST students whose annual family income is less than Rs. Two Lakhs securing benchmark percentage (50% and above).
schemes.benefit: A. Felicitation in public function, Certificate of Appreciation and financial award of Rs. 20,000/- to rank holders. B. Merit award: 50% to 59.99% - Rs. 5000/-; 60% to 69.99% - Rs. 8000/-; 70% to 74.99% - Rs. 10,000/-; 75% and above - Rs. 15,000/-. Students eligible for award of highest amount based on Board exam performance.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed format of Post Matric Scholarship along with attested copy of mark sheet; Director of Tribal Welfare sanctions; amount released electronically to beneficiary bank account.
schemes.valid_period: From date of notification; evaluation after two years
schemes.later_amendments: 06-10-2015 – Amendment to Merit Based Award (clause 4(b)); 15-01-2018 – Amendment to Merit Based Award (clause 4(B)); 15-01-2018 – Merit Based Award and recognition of high performance in the Board Exams of SSC and HSSC in the State of Goa
schemes.notes: Not. No. DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/67, OG Series I No. 46 dated 14-2-2013. Portal title 'Merit based Scholarship to the ST Community Students'.

schemes.name: Merit based Award and recognition of high performance in the Board Exams of SSC and HSSC in the State of Goa - A. Felicitation of Rank Holder students
schemes.target: ST rank holders in SSC/HSSC board exams
schemes.eligibility: ST students who qualified SSCE/HSSCE of Goa Board or any recognised Board conducting exams in Goa; first five rank holders among ST students in SSC, and first five in HSSC separately for Science, Commerce, Arts and Vocational streams. No income ceiling.
schemes.benefit: Felicitation in public function, Certificate of Appreciation and financial award of Rs. 20,000/- transferred electronically to bank account.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed Post Matric Scholarship format with attested mark sheet; sanctioned by Director of Tribal Welfare.

schemes.name: Prashikshan Yatra - Scheme to provide financial assistance for conducting Study Tours (Excursion) for ST Students during Vacations
schemes.target: Educational institutes (Goa Board/CBSE) with ST students in class VIII to XII
schemes.eligibility: Educational Institutes in Goa recognized by Goa Board/CBSE having Scheduled Tribe students; restricted to ST students studying in class VIII to XII who are willing; tour during Diwali, Christmas and Summer vacations with prior written permission of Education and Tribal Welfare Departments; two experienced teachers accompany; use railway concessions; tour from nearest station; accounts settled within one month and report within 15 days.
schemes.benefit: Financial Assistance to the Educational Institutes upto Rs. 1.00 lakh covering: actual travelling cost of up to 40 students and two teachers by rail (second class sleeper non-AC) and/or bus, tour of six days or more; entry fees/passes to monuments/cultural sites; lodging and boarding for minimum 6 days. Other expenditure borne by student/institution.
schemes.how_to_apply: Head of the Educational Institute submits prescribed application form to Director, Directorate of Tribal Welfare, Panaji at least one month in advance, with brief report on purpose and outcome and list of students; enclosures: parent/guardian permission and undertaking, tour programme, list of ST students with caste certificates, school registration certificate, railway/bus tickets. Director of Tribal Welfare sanctions.
schemes.later_amendments: 17-10-2016 – Amendment to Prashikshan Yatra (2016); 17-10-2016 – Prashikshan Yatra - Scheme to provide financial assistance for conducting study tours (Excursion) for ST students during vacations; 2021-08-24 – Addendum to Prashikshan Yatra
schemes.notes: Not. DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/69, OG Series I No. 30 dated 25-10-2012. Later amended 2016 (limit raised to Rs. 1.50 lakh, see c11868bb1d). Max is per institute. Same gazette has 'Mundkarache Ghar' scheme (Not. /70) but its eligibility is truncated - not extracted (max Rs. 30,000/- visible).
