amendments.benefit: Actual travelling cost of students (up to 40 students and four teachers) by Rail or Bus; expenditure on lodging and boarding for minimum period of 5 days; benefit given to the Educational Institute: Rs. 3750/- sanctioned per student, total benefit not to exceed Rs. 1.50 lakh. Expenditure beyond limits borne by student/institution
amendments.notes: Notification No. DTW/STAT/PC/Amendment/2016-17/69/7321, Official Gazette Series I No. 30 dated 27th October, 2016; amends clauses 3(a), 3(c), 3(d) and 5(iv). Max 1.50 lakh is per institute/tour (Rs. 3750 per student). Notified-on date read from two-column layout (17th Oct 2016; adjacent hostel notification dated 18th Oct 2016).

schemes.name: Pre-Primary Schools for Scheduled Tribes Children in Remote Areas
schemes.target: ST children in remote tribal areas lacking pre-primary schools
schemes.eligibility: Eligible applicants: existing primary schools including Government primary/high schools from the locality; NGOs with three years' experience managing pre-primary schools; trained teacher with experience teaching pre-primary students. Conditions: no existing pre-primary school in that locality; at least 10 ST students in a class of 20 to get one teacher and one helper post; an additional teacher and helper if ST students exceed 20 to form a separate class; teacher qualification as per Education Department norms (untrained teacher allowed at Rs. 8,000/- pm if no trained teacher available, must qualify within 3 years).
schemes.benefit: (a) Rent up to Rs. 2,000/- p.m.; (b) Snacks Rs. 300/- p.m. per student; (c) Teaching aids/toys: fixed Rs. 25,000/- in first year, Rs. 15,000/- per annum for next four years; (d) Trained teacher remuneration Rs. 10,000/- p.m. fixed (10% annual increment subject to satisfactory performance); (e) Helper remuneration at Minimum Wages Act rates. Mid-day meals mentioned in objectives.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed form to Director of Tribal Welfare with: Gramsabha/Village Panchayat resolution, NOC/lease agreement of premises, experience certificate, list of ST students, teacher/helper details, application for registration of pre-primary school with Education Department. Scrutiny by Director, placed before State Level Committee (chaired by Secretary, Tribal Welfare); amount transferred electronically to beneficiary bank account.
schemes.valid_period: Scheme to be implemented for five years; evaluation after two years
schemes.notes: Not. No. DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/62/2371, OG Series I No. 25 dated 19-9-2013. Recurring monthly amounts (Rs. 10,000 pm teacher, Rs. 2,000 pm rent); max_benefit_inr is the largest lump sum (Rs. 25,000 first-year teaching aids). Local body role = Gramsabha/VP resolution required with application.

schemes.name: R&D Reimbursement Scheme (Goa StartUp Policy 2021)
schemes.target: Local (Goan) start-ups in R&D stage employing PhD/Master degree holders
schemes.eligibility: Local start-ups certified by Startup IT Promotion Cell (SITPC) with valid start-up certificate; only Goans and local start-ups (local start-up: at least 50% equity held by Goans continuously since inception; Goan: born in Goa, or domicile for 10 years or more in the State, or spouse of such person through marriage registered in Goa); Directors' and employees' bank accounts linked to Aadhaar; employees PhD/Master Degree or equivalent from Government recognized institute; R&D stage in Policy domains with a working prototype (preference for patent applied/obtained); expenses per Accounting Standard 18; only expenditure after notification of Goa Start-up Policy 2021, paid digitally; max 100 start-ups per year; not an entitlement.
schemes.benefit: 50% of R&D expenses, including salaries of PhD holders and Master Degree holders employed by start-ups, reimbursed for two years, subject to a cap of INR 5 lakh per annum; salary component not in excess of INR 2 lakh.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prior approval from SITPC (Annexure 2); submit application form (Annexure 1) with documents (Aadhaar of Director/CEO, PhD employee documents, HR letter, employment contracts, salary slips, bank statements, research proposal, research work, proof of R&D payment) by e-mail or web portal to SITPC within 6 months of expenditure; decision within 45 days, disbursal within 60 days.
schemes.valid_period: Within validity of Goa Start-up Policy 2021
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of IT, Not. 2(1)/DoIT/2020/StartUp Policy-2020/1183, in same gazette (header department is Tribal Welfare). max_benefit_inr is per annum. Gazette also publishes IPR Reimbursement, Incubator Grant, Co-Working Space Subsidy, Seed Capital, Lease Rental/Interest Reimbursement, Salary Reimbursement and Skill Development Promotion schemes of Startup Policy 2021, which are cut off. Also contains Fisheries notification of fish landing centres (not a scheme). Official Gazette Series I No. 31 dated 03-11-2022; trimmed.

schemes.name: Rakshak Puraskars
schemes.target: Persons who showed exceptional courage in aiding/protecting victims of violence, attack or harassment against women and girls in Goa
schemes.eligibility: Any person who has shown exceptional courage, especially in adverse circumstances, in coming to aid, protecting or helping beyond the call of duty victims of any type of violence, attack or harassment against women and girls; resident of Goa for the last 5 years as on 1st January of the respective year or has worked in the State for at least two years; should not receive any other award in the same field during the same year; should be above 25 years of age as on 1st January of the respective year.
schemes.benefit: Cash prize of Rs. 20,000/- and a scroll/citation each; award given to only two persons each year from 2015, presented on Independence Day (15th August); cash paid by electronic transfer to bank account.
schemes.how_to_apply: Department releases advertisement in leading newspapers and Department website; applications in prescribed format in soft copy (CD, Word format) and hard print to Directorate of Women & Child Development, Panaji-Goa, by 20th June; State level Selection Committee selects.
schemes.valid_period: From the year 2015 onwards
schemes.notes: Issued by Directorate of Women & Child Development, Not. 2-706-RAKS-PURSK-2015/02819, in the same gazette issue (Series I No. 8, 21-5-2015); signing date truncated ('Panaji, 13t...'). Index also lists 'Veerjyoti Puraskars' Award (Not. 2-708-VEERJYOTI-2015/02820) but its text is not in the extracted pages.

schemes.name: Revised Rules regulating the grant-in-aid to voluntary organization for running hostels for Scheduled Tribe students (the Goa, Grant-in-aid to Scheduled Tribe Hostels run by Voluntary Organization Rules, 2015)
schemes.target: Voluntary organisations running hostels for ST students
schemes.eligibility: Voluntary organisation registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860. Opening of hostel at the place must be necessary; management must provide accepted standards of amenities (sanitary premises passed by taluka Health Officer, adequate sleeping/dining, free food and lodging to inmates, indoor/outdoor games, first aid; inmates attend school); organisation's funds must meet extra expenditure beyond grant. Annual income of parents of inmate shall not exceed Rs. 2,00,000/-. No grant for an inmate attending college who receives scholarships from other Government institutions. Grant based on attendance: >15 days/month full; 6-15 days 50%; up to 6 days nil (relaxable by Director).
schemes.benefit: Grant-in-aid for boys/girls inmates @ Rs. 1500/- p.m. per inmate for 12 months (subject to attendance and availability of funds); full-time resident superintendent @ 15,000/- per month for 12 months; clerk cum attendant @ 10,000/- per month for 12 months; cook Rs. 10,000/- per month for 12 months and Rs. 8,000/- to assistant cook (one cook up to 50 inmates, one additional assistant cook above 50, 2 additional above 100); Rs. 50,000/- per annum towards medical reimbursement bills; 2 security guards Rs. 10,000/- each per month for 12 months; water purifier reimbursement maximum Rs. 15,000/-; hostel rent fixed by PWD valuation.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed form (Annexure-I) to the Director of Tribal Welfare, Patto, Panaji-Goa, with permission of Village Panchayat/Municipality, NOC from Health Officer, ST certificates and income certificates of inmates, PWD rent certificate/ownership documents/irrevocable NOC of owner, registration certificate.
schemes.valid_period: From date of Notification (OG Series I No. 26 dated 24-09-2015)
schemes.later_amendments: 09-05-2016 – Revised Rules regulating the grant-in-aid to voluntary organization for running hostels for Scheduled Tribe students (Amendment); 18-10-2016 – The Goa, Grant-in-aid to Scheduled Tribe Hostels run by Voluntary Organization Rules, 2015
schemes.notes: Not. DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/85/10603 (Director Sandhya Kamat, Panaji 9th September 2015). Village Panchayat/Municipality permission is a required document but local body does not process the grant. max_benefit_inr = Rs. 50,000 per annum medical reimbursement (largest single stated amount; monthly items: Rs. 1500 p.m. per inmate, Rs. 15,000 p.m. superintendent). Trimmed: later clauses may be missing. Same gazette lists an amended WCD scheme 'Financial Incentive to mother who deliver girl child (MAMTA)' not in text.

amendments.name: Revised Rules regulating the grant-in-aid to voluntary organization for running hostels for Scheduled Tribe students (Amendment)
amendments.benefit: Addendum to Clause 6(xii) 'Rent for Hostel': (xiii) rent for premises hired by the voluntary organization paid at (a) Rs. 10,000/- p.m. or PWD rent assessment, whichever is less, for urban areas; (b) Rs. 5,000/- p.m. or PWD rent assessment, whichever is less, for rural areas; rent enhanced @ 10% on actual rent after every 3 years. Addendum to Clause 6(iv),(v),(vi),(ix) 'Honorarium to Hostel Staff': (xiv) hostel management must maintain staff leave records; leave certificate to be produced with claim, else absence treated as unpaid and honorarium sanctioned for actual days present.
amendments.notes: Not. No. DTW/7/Hostel/Scheme/9/Amendment/2015-16/1331, OG Series I No. 6 dated 12-5-2016. max_benefit_inr is monthly rent cap (Rs. 10,000 per month, urban). Original scheme's full grant rules not in this text.

schemes.name: Sahayata (Scheme to provide Financial Assistance to Organize Programmes)
schemes.target: NGOs, Panchayat Raj Institutions/Municipalities and Forest Rights Act committees working for ST welfare
schemes.eligibility: NGOs registered under appropriate law at least 2 years before applying, working for welfare of Scheduled Tribes, submitting audited accounts of last two years and MoA/Articles; Panchayat Raj Institutions and Municipalities having majority tribal population; Committees constituted under Forest Rights Act (Forest Rights Committee, Sub-Divisional and District Level Committees). Activities: seminars, workshops, competitions, medical camps, awareness camps etc. for tribal upliftment and FRA rights awareness.
schemes.benefit: NGOs: maximum Rs. 50,000/- grant, released in two equal instalments; NGO contributes at least 20% and 80% of cost sanctioned subject to max Rs. 50,000/-; once in a period of two financial years. PRIs/FRA committees: 100% assistance subject to max Rs. 50,000/-, once in one year.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply to Director of Tribal Welfare, Shrama Shakti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji in prescribed format (Form A for NGOs, Form B for FRA committees) at least three months before the activity, with registration certificate, detailed project report with financial implications, audited accounts of last two years; FRA committee/PRI proposals verified and countersigned by BDO. Utilisation certificate (GFR-19), proof of 20% contribution and report within 15 days of the activity.
schemes.notes: Notification No. 1/71/2011-12/schemes/TW, Official Gazette Series I No. 18 dated 01-08-2013; replaces scheme notified vide No. 1/20/2010-11-ADMN/TW dated 25-03-2011 (OG Series I No. 53 dated 31-03-2011). Form B N.B. says Rs. 50,000 or actual cost whichever is less.

schemes.name: Sahayata (Scheme to provide financial assistance to organize/conduct programs) - NGOs/SHGs/clubs
schemes.target: Voluntary organisations, NGOs, SHGs, Mahila Mandals, youth/sports clubs, Sanskrutik Mandals working for ST welfare
schemes.eligibility: Registered under appropriate law; NGO includes VO/SHG/Mahila Mandal/Youth Club/Sports Club/Sanskrutik Mandal with at least 10% ST members; working for welfare of STs as reflected in MoA/AoA; must contribute at least 20% of activity cost.
schemes.benefit: 80% of cost of activity subject to maximum Rs. 40,000/- per activity; maximum Rs. 80,000/- per financial year for minimum 2 and maximum 4 camps/seminars/workshops/competitions/medical camps in ST-populated Village Panchayats and Municipal Councils; released in two equal instalments as grants.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application to Director of Tribal Welfare in prescribed format (in advance or after programme) with MoA/AoA or registration copy; utilisation certificate (GFR-19), proof of 20% contribution, list of ST attendees and 4 photographs within 15 days.
schemes.later_amendments: 05-01-2022 – Sahayata (Scheme to provide financial assistance to organized/conduct programs)
schemes.notes: Notification DTW/6/SAHAYATA/Scheme/13/Amendment/2017-18/5617, Official Gazette Series I No. 32 dated 08-11-2018; revises scheme of 2013/2014. Rs. 80,000 is per financial year per organisation. Director may hold camps with expenditure up to 1 Lakh per camp.

schemes.name: Sahayata (Scheme to provide financial assistance to organize/conduct programs) - Panchayat Raj Institutions/FRA Committees/BDO/Dy. Collector & SDO
schemes.target: PRIs, municipalities with substantial tribal population, Forest Rights Act committees, BDOs, Dy. Collector & SDO
schemes.eligibility: Panchayat Raj Institutions/Committees under Forest Rights Act; Dy. Collector & SDO and BDO; PRI/FRA committee sanctioned only once a year.
schemes.benefit: 100% assistance for programmes/activities subject to maximum Rs. 50,000/- per financial year.
schemes.how_to_apply: Proposals to Director of Tribal Welfare, verified and countersigned by BDO (PRI/FRA committees); Dy. Collector & SDO / BDO proposals countersigned by Collector / Dy. Director of Panchayats.
schemes.notes: Same notification as NGO component (05-11-2018).

schemes.name: Scheme for Children With Special Needs (2018)
schemes.target: Children with special needs in special schools and regular (inclusive) schools; schools/institutions serving them
schemes.eligibility: All schools recognized by Directorate of Education, Government of Goa, imparting education to students with special needs are eligible; any child with special needs admitted in such institution eligible for individual benefits. Disabilities covered include intellectual disability, slow learners, specific learning disability, autism spectrum disorders, hearing impairment, loco-motor/neuro-motor disability, visual impairment, multiple disability/deaf blindness, mental illness, others declared by Director. Certification by Directorate of Education; disability/IQ/medical certificate from IPHB/GMC/District Hospitals only. Financial assistance subject to parents' annual income: below 3 lakhs full; 3-5 lakhs 50%; above 5 lakhs none.
schemes.benefit: Two components: (i) Individual Assistance to the child directly or through school; (ii) grants to institutions running inclusive regular schools and special schools (resource rooms, staff, infrastructure, aids etc.). Sheltered workshops: 80% of expenditure by Government, 20% by management. One-time fixed amount of Rs. 10,000/- to Special School/Vocational Training Centre/Sheltered Workshop for commercial marketing of items made by students. Parents' income-based assistance as above.
schemes.how_to_apply: Implemented by Directorate of Education (Deputy Director of Education (Adult Section) is nodal officer); certification of CwSN by Directorate of Education.
schemes.valid_period: From date of publication in the Official Gazette; replaces 'Revised Scheme for Education of Children with Special Needs'
schemes.notes: Issued by Directorate of Education, Not. 3/96/AE/DE/2012-13, Official Gazette Series I No. 39 dated 27-12-2018. Trimmed: individual assistance amounts and institutional grant rates not in extract. Income-slab rule appears in sheltered-workshop context; its scope is unclear from excerpt.

schemes.name: Scheme for Construction of Multipurpose Community Halls in Areas inhabited by Tribal Community "Sanskruti Bhavan"
schemes.target: ST communities in tribal-inhabited villages
schemes.eligibility: Target areas: Class A - tribal areas in villages within forest areas where Forest Rights Act is implemented; Class B - villages/hamlets with tribal population over 40%; Class C - villages with tribal population density below 40%. Of every 5 halls sanctioned: first 2 in Class A, next 2 in Class B, next 1 in Class C. Land free from all encumbrances must be made available by village community, Village Panchayat, NGOs or group of persons (may also be acquired under Land Acquisition Act or gifted to Government by Gift Deed). Application form asks whether any Government-assisted community hall exists within 2 km radius or in the VP area.
schemes.benefit: Construction of Sanskruti Bhavan (multipurpose community hall) with special anganwadi, reading room, recreation room and hall seating 200 to 300 people; total project cost including cost of land shall not exceed Rs. 50.00 lakhs; entire cost deposited with the Executing Agency after State Level Committee approval of estimate/drawings and construction licence; long-term maintenance agreement with Executing Agency.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed form (Annexure I) to Tribal Welfare Department by Village Panchayat, group of tribals, or NGO working for tribals in the VP area, with land details and ownership documents, NOC of land owner, Village Panchayat/Gram Sabha resolution, and (if by group of tribals) signatures of at least 100 ST persons; scrutinised by Department and placed before State Level Committee chaired by Minister for Tribal Welfare.
schemes.later_amendments: 13-09-2013 – Scheme for Construction of Multipurpose Community Halls in areas inhabited by Tribal Community "Sanskruti Bhavan" (Amendment)
schemes.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/71, Official Gazette Series I No. 29 dated 18-10-2012. Rs. 50 lakh is a per-project cost cap (incl. land), not a per-person benefit. Panchayat may grant use of the hall at rates fixed by Government. Scheme to be evaluated after two years. Same gazette also contains Antya Sanskar Sahay Yojana and Atal Asra Yojana notifications, not in this text excerpt.

amendments.name: Scheme for Construction of Multipurpose Community Halls in areas inhabited by Tribal Community "Sanskruti Bhavan" (Amendment)
amendments.benefit: Clause 5(3) amended: total cost of the project including cost of land shall not exceed Rs. 2.00 crores (in place of Rs. 50.00 lakhs).
amendments.notes: Amend. No. DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/71/2392, OG Series I No. 25 dated 19-9-2013. max_benefit_inr is the project cost ceiling (Rs. 2.00 crores), not an individual benefit. Original scheme's eligibility/applicants not in this text.

schemes.name: Scheme for Empowering Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled Caste (ST/SC) Communities using Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Tools through 40 IT Knowledge Centres
schemes.target: ST/SC students seeking IT skills training
schemes.eligibility: Students belonging to ST/SC community; courses offered by the 40 ITKCs set up by Info Tech Corporation of Goa Ltd (ITG); not for same course in multiple ITKCs; annual income of parent/guardian not exceeding Rs. 1.50 lakhs from all sources; 15 years Domicile Certificate or Residence Certificate.
schemes.benefit: IT skill training courses (Basic IT Skills to Diploma) at ITKCs paid through yearly Grant-in-Aid from Department of IT to M/s ITG; listed course fees range Rs. 750.00 to Rs. 5000.00 (e.g. Certificate in Basic IT Skills Rs. 1000, MS Office Rs. 2500, DTP Rs. 5000, Tally Rs. 3000).
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed form submitted to the chosen ITKC Centre (form addressed to Managing Director, ITG, Porvorim) with photo, caste certificate from Deputy Collector, educational certificates, birth certificate/proof of Goan origin, 15-year domicile certificate, income certificate.
schemes.funding: Tribal Sub Plan (TSP) and Scheduled Caste Sub Plan (SCSP); Grant-in-Aid to M/s ITG
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of Information Technology, Not. 4(72)/2013/Bill for TSP/SCSP Scheme/2851 (Porvorim, 21st February, 2014). Benefit is course fee coverage via GIA to ITG, not a cash amount; max left null. Same issue: Order for free treatment for differently abled children at Paediatric Neuro Rehabilitation Centre, GMC (Rs. 20 registration fee) w.e.f. 1-3-2014.

schemes.name: Scheme for Financial Assistance for Higher Education/Technical Education in Professional Institutions of Repute in India
schemes.target: Meritorious Goan students admitted to IITs, IIMs, BITs
schemes.eligibility: Born in Goa and domiciled in Goa for at least fifteen years; passed Std. X and Std. XII from institutions in Goa as regular student; below age of twenty-two years on date of application; family income not exceeding Rs. 10.00 lakhs per annum (for renewal cases family income should not exceed Rs. 4.50 lakhs per annum); admission obtained in any IIT, IIM or BIT in India; renewal only if student passes exams with not less than 60% marks or equivalent grade; recipient shall not receive benefits under any other scholarship of Government of Goa. Students already enrolled in IInd/IIIrd/IVth year also entitled from date of applicability.
schemes.benefit: (1) Refund of fees paid to the institution subject to maximum of Rs. 1.00 lakh or actual fees, whichever is less; (2) one time grant for purchase of one laptop subject to maximum of Rs. 50,000/- or actual, whichever is less; (3) Rs. 15,000/- per annum towards books, stationery, equipments etc.; (4) maintenance allowance (hostel fees and mess charges) @ Rs. 2,000/- per month or actual, whichever is less. SC/ST students entitled to 50% more financial assistance than General Candidates except for item 5.1(2) (laptop).
schemes.how_to_apply: Applications in prescribed format on or before 20th June every year to the Directorate of Higher Education; selection completed before 30th June; late applications not considered.
schemes.valid_period: From academic year 2010-11
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of Education, Art & Culture, Directorate of Higher Education, Not. 9/287/2010/HE/43 (Panaji, 3rd January, 2011), Official Gazette Series I No. 42 dated 13-01-2011; managed through Higher Education Promotion Fund (HEPF). SC/ST get 50% more, so their effective cap exceeds Rs. 1.00 lakh (not computed). Portal file named 'Vidya-Laxmi-13-01-2011'. Same issue lists Social Welfare 'Amendment to the Scheme Kanya Dhan' (not in extract).

schemes.name: Scheme for Incentive to Green Fodder Cultivation for Perennial and Seasonal Fodder Development in the State
schemes.target: Farmers, agricultural labourers, dairy societies, farmers clubs, SHGs growing green fodder
schemes.eligibility: Any individual/farmer/agricultural labourer residing in Goa for at least 15 years or more; Dairy Society/Farmers Club/Self-help groups with available land in Goa (any fallow agriculture land, marad etc.) with Form I & XIV or affidavit/NOC from landlord. Minimum area 500 sq. mts. Must prepare land and complete cultivation within two months of initial approval. Perennial: minimum two cuttings a year and continue same area for another 2 years. Beneficiaries of existing departmental scheme may apply from April 2012; old-scheme subsidy claims not considered beyond 31-12-2012.
schemes.benefit: Perennial fodder subsidy enhanced from Rs. 40,000/- to Rs. 65,000/- per hectare, paid per 6-monthly cutting: 1st year Rs. 15,000/- + Rs. 15,000/-; 2nd year Rs. 10,000/- + Rs. 10,000/-; 3rd year Rs. 7,500/- + Rs. 7,500/-. Irrigation implements (pump, PVC pipes, sprinklers) with 75% subsidy on total cost; unit costs: 500-1,000 sq m Rs. 5,500/-; 1,000-4,000 sq m Rs. 32,000/-; 4,000-10,000 sq m Rs. 50,000/-; 10,000 sq m and above Rs. 80,000/-. Seasonal fodder Rs. 15,000/- per hectare per crop. Tussocks free of cost from Government Livestock Farm Dhat-Mollem, Cattle Breeding Farm Coperdem and Fodder Seed Production Farm Kalay.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed application form to the Director of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services through the area Assistant Director/Veterinary Officer, with residence certificate from Mamlatdar/Sarpanch or Dairy Society Chairman (verified by Veterinary Officer), Form I & XIV/notarised affidavit or land documents or landlord NOC on Rs. 20 stamp paper, passport photo. For release: inspection report/utilisation certificate, photographs, agreement bond, original bills for irrigation unit.
schemes.notes: Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services Not. 4-1(10)/2012-13/5781 in the same gazette; department field is the portal header. Amounts are per-hectare rates and unit costs, so max_benefit_inr left null (Rs. 65,000/ha perennial; irrigation unit cost up to Rs. 80,000 at 75% subsidy). Inconsistencies: comparison table says residence certificate not required while documents list requires it; agreement bond says continue for further three years vs two years in terms. Sarpanch may issue residence certificate (document only).

schemes.name: Scheme of Post Matric Scholarships to the Students belonging to Scheduled Tribes for Studies in India
schemes.target: ST students at post-matric/post-secondary stage
schemes.eligibility: Indian nationals; belong to Scheduled Tribes of the State/UT where permanently settled; passed Matriculation or Higher Secondary or higher exam; recognised post-matric courses in recognised institutions (excludes Aircraft Maintenance Engineer, Private Pilot Licence, Training Ship Dufferin/Rajendra, Military College Dehradun, pre-examination training centres). Means test: parents'/guardians' income from all sources not exceeding Rs. 2,00,000/- per annum. Not eligible: second course at same stage in different subject; class XI of continuous 12-class schools; those who received coaching at Govt-funded pre-exam centres; holders of other scholarship/stipend (must choose one). Correspondence/distance courses and employed students on leave without pay eligible; all children of same parents eligible; PG medicine eligible if not allowed to practise.
schemes.benefit: Maintenance allowance per month by course group, e.g. Group I Rs. 1200 (hostellers) / Rs. 550 (day scholars); Group II Rs. 820 / Rs. 530 (other groups truncated); CPL course (10 awards per annum) at Group I rates plus all compulsory fees. Reimbursement of all compulsory non-refundable fees. Disability provisions: reader allowance for blind Rs. 240/200/160 p.m. by group; transport allowance up to Rs. 160 p.m.; escort allowance Rs. 160 p.m.; special pay Rs. 160 p.m. to hostel helper; Rs. 240 p.m. extra coaching for mentally retarded/mentally ill. Study tour charges up to Rs. 1600 per annum; thesis typing/printing up to Rs. 1600; correspondence course students annual book allowance Rs. 1200. Students entitled to free board/lodging get 1/3 of hosteller rate.
schemes.how_to_apply: Awarded by the Government of the State/UT to which the applicant belongs (permanently settled); students studying in another State apply to competent authorities of their home State. Income certificate once at admission.
schemes.funding: Central (Government of India, Ministry of Tribal Affairs; share not stated)
schemes.valid_period: Applicable from 01.07.2010
schemes.notes: Government of India, Ministry of Tribal Affairs regulations (OCR; some damage). notified_on is the applicability date. max_benefit_inr = Rs. 1600 (study tour per annum / thesis); fees are reimbursed in full without a stated cap and maintenance allowance is up to Rs. 1200 per month. Trimmed: maintenance table for Groups III/IV and renewal/payment rules partly missing. Funding pattern not stated in the text.

schemes.name: Scheme of scholarship to ST students pursuing Home Nursing Courses
schemes.target: Poor and meritorious ST students pursuing Home Nursing courses
schemes.eligibility: ST students admitted in an institution recognised by State/Central Government for: Certificate Course in Home Nursing (at least six months); Diploma in Home Nursing (twelve months or more); Degree in nursing (three years); Health Worker Course (one year). Regular student born in Goa and domiciled in Goa for at least 15 years. Not to avail any other scholarship/stipend for the same course. Annual income of parent/guardian not exceeding Rs. 1.50 lakhs from all sources (amended to Rs. 6.00 lakhs from 2018-19). Application recommended by Head of Institution. No payment during internship/practical training if remuneration/stipend received. Continuation subject to satisfactory progress and conduct.
schemes.benefit: Course fees: Certificate courses (6-12 months) Rs. 3,500/- or actual whichever is less; Diploma (one year or more) Rs. 5,000/- or actual; Degree in nursing (three years) Rs. 10,000/- or actual; Health Worker course (one year) Rs. 3,500/- or actual. Maintenance allowance: Day scholars Rs. 500/- p.m.; Hostellers Rs. 800/- p.m. One-time additional amount for books, uniform, stationery: Certificate Rs. 1,000/-; Diploma Rs. 2,000/-; Degree Rs. 3,000/-; Health Worker Rs. 2,000/-.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed form to the Directorate of Tribal Welfare, recommended by Head of Institution, with passport photo, attested caste certificate from Deputy Collector, attested certificates of exams passed, income certificate, birth certificate, domicile/residence certificate, original fee receipt, copy of bank pass book.
schemes.valid_period: From date of publication in Official Gazette (OG Series I No. 34 dated 18-11-2010)
schemes.later_amendments: 09-01-2018 – Amendment to Scheme of Scholarship to ST students pursuing Home Nursing Courses - clause 3(v); 09-01-2018 – Scheme of Scholarship to ST students pursuing Home Nursing Courses
schemes.notes: Not. 1/12/2010-11-ADMN/TW (N. B. Narvekar, Panaji 15th November 2010). OCR; hosteller maintenance figure partly garbled ('800/- p. m.'). PDF also contains unrelated Transport and RERA pages.

amendments.name: Amendment to Scheme of Scholarship to ST students pursuing Home Nursing Courses - clause 3(v)
amendments.notes: Not. DTW/11/Home Nursing/Scheme/9/Amendment/2017-18 (Director Venancio Furtado, Panaji 9th January 2018). OCR.

amendments.name: Scheme of Scholarship to ST students pursuing Home Nursing Courses
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/11/Home Nursing/Scheme/9/Amendment/2017-18 in same gazette. Only income limit amended; scholarship amount not in text.

schemes.name: Scheme to provide Assistance in Education to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes & Other Backward Classes children
schemes.target: School-going SC/ST/OBC children from poor families
schemes.eligibility: Bonafide resident of Goa; regular student of a recognised institution; SC/ST/OBC; combined parents'/guardians' income not above Rs. 1,20,000/- per annum; not residing/receiving maintenance grant in a govt/aided institution; no other stipend/scholarship; not eligible twice in same standard.
schemes.benefit: Stipend: I-IV class Rs. 175/- per month; V-VIII Rs. 225/- per month; IX-X Rs. 275/- per month, for the academic year, in 2 equal instalments via the institution (2nd on 75% attendance).
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed form (Appendix-I) to Director of Social Welfare with SDM caste certificate and income certificate from VP Secretary (attested by Sarpanch, countersigned by BDO) or Mamlatdar/Municipality; no renewal application needed.
schemes.later_amendments: 07-05-2008 – Saral Vidya Sahay - enhancement of rates (2008); 12-03-2007 – Saral Vidya Sahay - amendment (2007); 17-04-2018 – Scheme to provide Assistance in Education to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes & Other Backward Classes children
schemes.notes: Notification 62-2-04-BC(136), originally Directorate of Social Welfare (now administered by Tribal Welfare for ST). Max is monthly. Para 12 meritorious scholarship referenced but not in extracted text. Trimmed.

amendments.name: Saral Vidya Sahay - amendment (2007)
amendments.benefit: Scheme renamed 'Saral Vidya Sahay'; clause (a) of para 5(i) (Class I-IV stipend) deleted.
amendments.notes: Directorate of Social Welfare.

amendments.name: Saral Vidya Sahay - enhancement of rates (2008)
amendments.benefit: Stipend under Saral Vidya Sahay: V to VIII Std Rs. 325/- p.m. (11 months); IX to X Std Rs. 375/- p.m. (11 months). Meritorious scholarship: up to VI Std Rs. 900/- per annum; VII to VIII Std Rs. 1000/- per annum; IX Std Rs. 1100/- per annum; X Std Rs. 1600/- per annum.
amendments.notes: OCR partly garbled in the rate table; Rs. 375 p.m. stipend and Rs. 1600 p.a. meritorious scholarship.

amendments.name: Scheme to provide Assistance in Education to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes & Other Backward Classes children
amendments.benefit: Not stated in amendment
amendments.notes: Notification 1-53-2018-19/ADMN/PRE-MAT/DTW/243, OG Series I No. 3 dated 19th April, 2018; effective from date of publication. Clause 4 sub-items (i)-(ii) not visible in extracted text (column layout); benefit amounts not in text.

schemes.name: Scheme to provide financial assistance for scheduled tribe people for the purpose of Short Term Professional Training Courses in the State of Goa
schemes.target: ST youth aged 18-50 seeking skill training for self-employment/livelihood
schemes.eligibility: Belong to ST community of Goa; above 18 and below 50 years of age; course of 15 days to 3 months registered with a Government Department/Institution/Autonomous Body in Goa (e.g. motor driving, tailoring, cookery and bakery, beautician, mobile repairing, computer); one course only; declaration of not being permanently employed in Govt/Corporation/Autonomous body and not already possessing that skill certificate.
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance for actual course fees with maximum limit of Rs. 5000/-; 50% of actual fees (limit Rs. 2500/-) released as advance, balance after completion certificate; Chairman may release entire amount in one instalment in genuine cases.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply in prescribed form to Goa Scheduled Tribes Finance & Development Corporation Ltd. (2nd floor, Dayanand Smriti Building, Swami Vivekanand Road, Panaji) with ST certificate, age proof, educational certificates, learning licence (driving), Aadhar, photo, bank pass book, fee quotation/receipt, declaration signed by Gazetted Officer, mandate form; Corporation recommends, Director of Tribal Welfare sanctions.
schemes.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/STPTC/2019-20, Official Gazette Series I No. 4 dated 23-04-2020; revises earlier scheme. Must join training within three months of 1st instalment, else recovery. OCR damage in parts ('Rs. 2600' once, read as 2500 elsewhere).

schemes.name: Scheme to provide hired private buses to the Government High Schools - 2016
schemes.target: Students of Government High Schools in remote Pernem, Satari and Sanguem talukas; private bus owners
schemes.eligibility: Government High Schools situated in remote places/talukas such as Pernem, Satari and Sanguem; entitled to an additional hired bus in addition to the bus operated through KTCL. Buses: date of manufacture less than 3 years; owner must obtain half-yearly vehicle fitness/road-worthiness certificate from Directorate of Transport; driver and attendant medically fit.
schemes.benefit: Directorate of Education hires private buses; hire charges Rs. 2400/- per day per bus to cover maximum 80 kms per day; expenses towards mileage beyond 80 kms per day borne by Government. Payment monthly on certified bills through Headmaster endorsed by PTA Chairman. All running expenses borne by owner.
schemes.how_to_apply: Directorate of Education registers private buses by issuing advertisement in three local dailies; route determined by school (PTA).
schemes.valid_period: From date of publication in Official Gazette
schemes.notes: Education Dept notification DE/Accts/Pvt.CONT.18/2015/255 (Porvorim, 2nd May 2016) published in the same gazette as the Tribal Welfare hostel amendment; department field is the portal header (Tribal Welfare), but this is an Education, Art & Culture scheme. Rs. 2400/day is a hire charge paid to bus owners, not a per-beneficiary benefit, so max_benefit_inr left null. Issued with Finance concurrence U.O. No. 1400019161 dated 02-02-2016.

schemes.name: Scheme to support Orphan child/children of Widow belonging to ST Community (revised 2014)
schemes.target: Children of ST widows and ST orphans up to 18 years
schemes.eligibility: (1) Widow who is a DSSS beneficiary, belonging to ST community, with minor children (limited to 2 children up to 18 years); (2) ST orphan under care of guardian (grandparents/near relatives/protective home/Dharmasala) up to 18 years; (3) non-ST widow who is DSS beneficiary with minor ST children (limited to 2 children).
schemes.benefit: Fixed maintenance allowance of Rs. 1,500/- per month per child of a widow; Rs. 2,000/- per month per orphan child.
schemes.how_to_apply: Widow applies in Form A (Annexure A), guardian in Form B, to Directorate of Tribal Welfare; amount released to joint account of child and mother/guardian. Enclosures: marriage certificate, husband's death certificate, ST certificate, children's birth certificates, DSS sanction order.
schemes.valid_period: Five years
schemes.later_amendments: 29-04-2020 – Amendment to Scheme to support Orphan child/children of Widow belonging to ST Community
schemes.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2013-14/64/9719, Official Gazette Series I No. 48 dated 27-02-2014; replaces 2012 scheme (also partly present in document). Max is a monthly figure (Rs. 2,000 per month per orphan). Trimmed.

amendments.name: Amendment to Scheme to support Orphan child/children of Widow belonging to ST Community
amendments.benefit: Unchanged (Rs. 1,500 p.m. per child of widow; Rs. 2,000 p.m. per orphan per 2014 scheme).
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/SAT/PC/2020-21/64/85, Official Gazette Series I No. 6 dated 07-05-2020. Monthly figure.

schemes.name: Scheme to support Orphan Child/Children of Widows belonging to ST Community
schemes.target: Orphan children and children of widows of ST community, up to age 18
schemes.eligibility: (1) Any widow who is a DSS (Dayanand Social Security) beneficiary belonging to ST community and having minor children; benefit limited to 2 children. (2) Any orphan under care of a guardian (grandparents or near relatives) or in a protective home/dharmasala etc., up to the age of 18 years.
schemes.benefit: (a) Fixed maintenance allowance of Rs. 1,500/- per month per child of a widow; (b) fixed maintenance allowance of Rs. 2,000/- per month per child who is an orphan; till the child attains 18 years.
schemes.how_to_apply: Widow: Form A to Directorate of Social Welfare (sanctioned by Director of Social Welfare, paid along with DSS benefits) with marriage certificate, husband's death certificate, ST certificate, income certificate, DSS beneficiary evidence. Orphan: guardian applies in Form B to Directorate of Tribal Welfare with birth certificate of child, death certificate of father/mother, ST certificate, income certificate, election/ration card of applicant; amount transferred by ECS to joint account of orphan/guardian.
schemes.valid_period: Scheme to be implemented for five years from 2012 notification; evaluated after two years
schemes.notes: Notification DTW/STAT/PC/2012-13/64, Official Gazette Series I No. 29 dated 18-10-2012. max_benefit_inr is a per-month, per-child figure (Rs. 2,000 p.m. for an orphan).

schemes.name: Self Certification Scheme
schemes.target: Factories, shops and commercial establishments
schemes.eligibility: Optional; only factories/establishments with valid licence/registration under Factories Act, 1948 and Goa, Daman and Diu Shops and Establishments Act, 1973; factories involving Hazardous Process or High Risk Industries (section 2(cb) Factories Act) not covered.
schemes.benefit: Regulatory: not more than 5% of establishments under the scheme inspected; inspection on specific complaints/accidents only with prior approval of Commissioner, Labour and Employment. Covers Minimum Wages, Payment of Wages, Contract Labour, Payment of Bonus, Maternity Benefit, Inter-State Migrant Workmen, Equal Remuneration, Goa Shops & Establishments, Goa Labour Welfare Fund Acts. One-time registration fee payable: Rs. 5000/- (0-20 labours), Rs. 10000/- (21-100), Rs. 15000/- (more than 100).
schemes.how_to_apply: Online application at www.goaonline.gov.in in prescribed proforma between 1st January and 31st March every year (for year ending 31-03-2020, up to 31st December 2020); deemed enrolled if no discrepancy communicated within 15 days.
schemes.valid_period: Option valid for five years once opted
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of Labour, Not. 24/10/2020-LAB (Porvorim, 14th May, 2020). Not a financial assistance scheme; fees are paid by the establishment, so max_benefit_inr null.

schemes.name: Short Term Loan Scheme of Goa State Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation Ltd.
schemes.target: ST individuals/students needing urgent funds for education, medical or business
schemes.eligibility: Any individual from ST community of State of Goa.
schemes.benefit: Short term loan up to Rs. 1,00,000/- as an advance for education, medical and business needs.
schemes.later_amendments: 2025-10-03 – Amendment to Short Term Loan Scheme - Clause 7(f)
schemes.notes: Notification 1-285(7)/2018-19/ADMN/DTW/346; only first page present — purposes, interest, repayment and procedure not in text. This is a loan, not a grant.

amendments.name: Amendment to Short Term Loan Scheme - Clause 7(f)
amendments.benefit: Clause 7(f) amended: education loan at interest rate of 2% per annum payable within 20 months.
amendments.notes: Date of amendment notification not legible (OCR). Amendment cites original as published in OG Series I No. 11 dated 14th June, 2019 (original page shows 14th June 2018). Text cut after '20 months'.

schemes.name: State Agriculture Awards
schemes.target: Outstanding self-cultivating farmers of Goa
schemes.eligibility: Full-time resident of Goa and full-time farmer; totally dependent on agriculture as main source of income; integrates agriculture activities; originality in venture; minimum area of own/inherited/long-lease land (figure illegible); not a past recipient of State Krishi Award; companies, institutions or organisations not eligible.
schemes.benefit: Cash award and citation: Krishi Ratna Rs. 2.00 lakhs (best farmer/lifetime achievement); Krishi Vibhushan Rs. 1.00 lakhs (2nd); Krishi Bhushan Rs. 0.50 lakhs (3rd).
schemes.how_to_apply: Nomination form (annexed) available at Zonal Agricultural Offices; last date 15th October 2013; judged by committee with outside judges, Director of Agriculture as Member Secretary.
schemes.valid_period: Immediate effect; till withdrawn; covers all talukas
schemes.notes: Notification No. 3/5/EXT/31-SAA/2013-14/D.Agri/286; Official Gazette Series I No. 18 dated 1-8-2013. Trimmed: details may be on later pages; OCR poor.

schemes.name: State Cultural Award for the field of institution for outstanding performance in Art & Culture
schemes.target: Goan cultural institutions with 15+ years of work
schemes.eligibility: Any Goan institution (or institution working for Goan artists) working in the field of art and culture; functioning institutions which have completed 15 years and given extraordinary contribution; constitution with duties clearly defined and good reputation in the local community; preference criteria trimmed.
schemes.benefit: Memento, certificate of appreciation and financial purse to the extent of Rs. 3.00 Lakh.
schemes.how_to_apply: Department of Art & Culture issues press release/advertisement inviting recommendations from institutions/individuals; Committee may take suo-moto cognizance and recommends to Director of Art & Culture.
schemes.valid_period: Upto 31st March, 2021
schemes.notes: Issued by Directorate of Art & Culture (index: Not. DAC/COMPCELL/10-SCHEME/2015-16/7592) in the same gazette issue; header department is Tribal Welfare because of portal filing. Scheme name taken from gazette index; opening of the scheme text trimmed.

schemes.name: The Goa State Village Panchayat/NGO’s Libraries Financial Assistance Scheme, 2018
schemes.target: Libraries run by Village Panchayats, Municipalities, Zilla Panchayats and NGOs
schemes.eligibility: Existing libraries run by Municipalities/Zilla Panchayat/NGOs continue under same management. New libraries: NGOs registered under Societies Registration Act, 1860 or Indian Trusts Act, 1882; Municipalities, Village Panchayat, Zilla Panchayat eligible. New library sanctioned where minimum population 1000 in village/ward/area or 4 km radius from existing library (relaxable). Class A: min 25,000 books, 30 magazines, 15 newspapers, 300 sq. mts.; Class B: 15000 books, 25 magazines, 12 newspapers, 200 sq. mts.; Class C: 5000 books, 20 magazines, 12 newspapers, 100 sq. mts.; Class D: 2000 books, 15 magazines, 10 newspapers, 40 sq. mts. Staff qualifications prescribed; library open min 6½ hrs on working days; separate bank account in name of library; annual report by 31st May and CA-audited statement with utilization certificate by 31st August; staff paid via ECS. Non-aided libraries may open Children's libraries and institutions serving differently abled may open libraries (both Class C).
schemes.benefit: Class A: one Senior Librarian, one Junior Librarian, one Library Attendant subject to maximum Rs. 4,20,000/- (Rs. 14,000/- p.m. Senior Librarian, Rs. 12,000/- p.m. Junior Librarian, Rs. 9,000/- p.m. Library Attendant) plus 100% of admissible non-remuneration expenditure up to Rs. 2,00,000/-. Class B: Junior Librarian and Library Attendant up to Rs. 2,52,000/- plus up to Rs. 1,50,000. Class C: up to Rs. 2,52,000/- plus up to Rs. 1,00,000. Class D: up to Rs. 2,52,000/- plus up to Rs. 60,000. New library token grant Rs. 1,00,000/-. Admissible items include minor repairs up to Rs. 20,000/- per year; furniture/equipment up to Rs. 75,000/- (A), Rs. 50,000/- (B), Rs. 40,000/- (C), 25,000/- (D); celebrations up to Rs. 25,000/- (A), Rs. 20,000/- (B), Rs. 15,000/- (C), Rs. 10,000/- (D).
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed form for opening of library to the Director, Directorate of Art & Culture, Sanskruti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji-Goa, with relevant documents and bank account details.
schemes.valid_period: In force from date of issue of Notification, in supersession of all previous orders
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of Education, Art & Culture (Directorate of Art and Culture), Not. DAC-5-Estt-SL-LS-10, Official Gazette Series I No. 42 dated 17-01-2019; signing date not visible. max_benefit_inr is the Class A staff remuneration cap (per library, apparently annual). Same issue lists Central Sector Coastal Berth Scheme (Sagarmala) and Scheme for Imparting Training under Khadi & Village Industries Sector, 2018 - not in extract.

schemes.name: The Revised Common Scheme to provide financial assistance to the Primary Agricultural Credit Co-operative Societies, Taluka Farmers Service Co-operative Societies, Marketing Co-operative Societies, Consumer Co-operative Societies, Processing Co-operative Societies, Dairy Co-operative Societies and Women Self Help Group Co-operative Societies, 2013
schemes.target: PACS, Taluka Farmers Service, Marketing, Consumer, Processing, Dairy and Women SHG co-operative societies
schemes.eligibility: Registered co-operative societies of the listed types. Share capital conditions: byelaw making share capital non-refundable for 15 years; refund Government contribution after 15 years via Share Capital Redemption Fund; increase share capital yearly by 1/15 of Government contribution; dividend not above 12% until Government contribution refunded; submit Managing Committee/Board resolution; not a defaulter in repayment of Government investments; submit audited accounts for last 3 years. Godown loan-cum-subsidy: godown only on unencumbered land owned by the society; plans/estimates approved by PWD and Registrar; no other borrowing for the godown; complete within 12 months; bank guarantee equal to assistance; agreement bond. Societies with minimum 40% ST/SC shareholders get higher subsidy share (70% or more for 90% subsidy for dairy).
schemes.benefit: Share Capital Contribution: PACS up to Rs. 50,000/- after registration and further Rs. 1,00,000/- (turnover < Rs. 5.00 lakhs) or Rs. 1,50,000/- (turnover > Rs. 5.00 lakhs); Taluka Farmers Service societies up to Rs. 2,00,000/- after registration and further up to Rs. 12,00,000/- in aggregate (turnover > Rs. 20.00 lakhs for two consecutive years); Marketing societies up to 6 times members' paid-up share capital; Consumer societies up to Rs. 50,000/- on matching basis and further Rs. 1,00,000/- without matching if running in profit; Processing societies up to 5 times members' share capital, max Rs. 5,00,000/-; Dairy societies up to Rs. 50,000/- without matching. Godown-cum-office building loan-cum-subsidy: 50% loan and 50% subsidy of PWD-approved cost (35% loan / 65% subsidy for societies with minimum 40% ST and SC shareholders); Dairy societies 50/50, 35/65 (40% ST/SC) or 10% loan / 90% subsidy (70% or more ST/SC members), subject to maximum of Rs. 12.00 lakhs or PWD-approved cost whichever is lower. Loan for 15 years at Government-fixed interest; penal interest @ 2% on overdue instalments. Scheme also covers Managerial Subsidy and Grant (details not in extracted text).
schemes.how_to_apply: Through the Registrar of Co-operative Societies, Government of Goa, Panaji, with Managing Committee/Board resolution, audited accounts of last 3 years; godown plans and estimates approved by PWD.
schemes.valid_period: From date of publication in Official Gazette (Series I No. 49, 06-03-2014)
schemes.notes: Co-operation Dept Not. 1-31-2013/PLG/RCS published in the same gazette as the Sahayata amendment; department field is the portal header but this is a Co-operation Dept scheme. Repeals notifications 1-24-2010-11/PLG/RCS/154 dated 11-10-2011 and 1-27-2012/PLG/RCS/187 dated 02-08-2012. Trimmed: managerial subsidy and grant components are on later pages not in the text. Notification signing date not visible. max_benefit_inr = Rs. 12,00,000 (aggregate TFSC share capital; also godown cap Rs. 12.00 lakhs).

schemes.name: Varah Palan Scheme
schemes.target: Farmers/unemployed youth setting up piggery units
schemes.eligibility: Any farmer residing minimum 05 years in the State; should have undergone training in Piggery Management; any individual in the State but area of operation only Panchayat. Documents: 5-year residence proof (Mamlatdar certificate/electoral roll/driving licence/passport/bank account etc.), Aadhaar, piggery training certificate, land ownership (Form I & XIV/Kisan Card) or lease deed/NOC from land owner for 6 years or tenancy evidence, site plan, NOC from Village Panchayat, caste certificate if SC/ST/OBC, photograph. Unit must run minimum 5 years (pro-rata recovery otherwise). Gobar gas subsidy only if no such benefit from other Government agency.
schemes.benefit: Cost Rs. 120/- per kilo live body weight; subsidy @ 62.5% for males to maximum Rs. 9,000/- each and @ 74% for females to maximum Rs. 8,000/- each; maximum 20 females and 02 males (piglets max 20 kg; sows max 90 kg; boars max 120 kg). Shed construction: maximum Rs. 2,000/- per pig (Annexure I: max Rs. 44,000/-). Gobar Gas Unit: max unit cost Rs. 50,000/-, subsidy 75% i.e. Rs. 37,500/-. Other equipment (Annexure III): max cost Rs. 42,100/-, subsidy 75% i.e. Rs. 31,575/-. Subsidy credited via DBT.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed form to Directorate of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Panaji through respective Veterinary Officer/Assistant Director, with NOC from Village Panchayat; purchase piglets from Government Piggery Farm, Curti, Ponda (or other registered farm with NOC/permission); set up unit within 6 months of sanction; execute agreement bond; subsidy released after completion, inspection by committee, and utilization certificate (to loan account if bank-financed).
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services, Not. 3-1(13)/2017-18/6430, Official Gazette Series I No. 45 dated 08-02-2018; signing date not visible. max_benefit_inr = largest single component cap (infrastructure Rs. 44,000); overall total not stated. Inconsistency: text says equipment max cost Rs. 42,100/subsidy Rs. 31,575, Annexure II says Rs. 34,800/Rs. 26,100; text says boars max 120 kg, Annexure I says 90 kg. NOC from Village Panchayat required.

schemes.name: Yuva Srujan Puraskar (Navsarjan Chetana Puraskar)
schemes.target: Young Goan artists aged 25-40
schemes.eligibility: Individual artist aged 25-40 years (relaxable by up to 5 years in exceptional cases) with extraordinary contribution to art & culture; contributed in his/her field of art in Goa for minimum 5 years; not eligible a second time; maximum 6 persons per year in fields such as Music/Dance, Drama/Tiatr, Folk Art, Photography/Painting, Craft, Sculpture, Bhajan/Kirtan, Literature, Film.
schemes.benefit: Memento, certificate of appreciation and financial purse to the extent of Rs. 25,000/- per individual.
schemes.how_to_apply: Department of Art & Culture releases press advertisement every year inviting recommendations (procedure partly trimmed).
schemes.valid_period: From publication in Official Gazette upto 31st March, 2021
schemes.notes: Issued by Directorate of Art & Culture (Not. DAC/COMPCELL/10-SCHEMES/2015-16/7593) in the same gazette issue; header department is Tribal Welfare because of portal filing. Signing date not visible (trimmed).

schemes.name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-Matric Scholarship for needy Scheduled Tribe students studying in Classes IX & X
schemes.target: ST students in Classes IX and X
schemes.eligibility: ST student enrolled full time in Classes IX/X in Government or recognised school; parents'/guardian's income not above Rs. 2.00 lakh per annum; not getting any other centrally funded pre-matric scholarship; awarded by State of domicile.
schemes.benefit: Scholarship for 10 months (day scholars Rs. 150 p.m., hostellers Rs. 350 p.m. per 2019 letter; OCR of table shows '150 360'); books and ad hoc grant Rs. 750 / Rs. 1000 per annum; for students with disabilities in private unaided schools: reader, transport, escort, helper allowances Rs. 160 per month each and coaching allowance Rs. 240 per month.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in State-prescribed form with photograph, ST certificate (Revenue Officer not below Tehsildar), income declaration/certificate, previous-year receipt for renewal, submitted through Head of School to Block/District authorities.
schemes.funding: 100% Central (over and above State committed liability)
schemes.valid_period: Effective from 01-07-2012
schemes.notes: Ministry of Tribal Affairs DO letter and guidelines. Mixed monthly/annual amounts, so no single max set. OCR damage in rate table.

amendments.name: Increase in scholarship amount under Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST students
amendments.benefit: Scholarship revised from Rs. 150/- to Rs. 225/- p.m. for day scholars and from Rs. 350/- to Rs. 525/- p.m. for hostellers.
amendments.notes: MoTA letter No. 19012/03/2017-Sch. Max is monthly (hostellers).

schemes.name: Guidelines for implementation of schemes under Tribal Sub-Plan
schemes.target: ST population; departments implementing Tribal Sub-Plan schemes
schemes.eligibility: Benefits of TSP schemes of all departments extended to ST population per village/municipal classification: Category A - Village Panchayats/Municipal Councils/Corporation with 1000 or more ST population and 40% or more ST (Annexure I, 16 VPs); Category B - VPs/Municipal Councils with 15% ST population excluding Category A (Annexure II, 42 VPs + 1 municipality); Category C - revenue villages/wards not in A or B with 10% ST population (Annexure III, 26 revenue villages + 13 municipal wards).
schemes.benefit: Limits for a single project: No limit for Category A; limit of 10 crores for Category B; limit of 2 crores for Category C. Limits may be relaxed in genuine/emergency cases with prior approval of Sanctioning Committee (chaired by Minister for Tribal Welfare).
schemes.how_to_apply: Head of Department seeking relaxation submits request letter with justification to Director of Tribal Welfare, who places it before the Sanctioning Committee.
schemes.valid_period: From date of notification; projects sanctioned earlier exempted; supersedes earlier guidelines
schemes.notes: Not. No. DTW/STAT/STPOP/2014-15/7835, published in Official Gazette Series I No. 44 dated 29-1-2015. These are project-cost limits for departments, not individual benefits. Same gazette also has ST population data notification (7834) and Atal Asra Yojana construction regulation annexure.

schemes.name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post Matric Scholarship for ST Students
schemes.target: ST students at post-matriculation/post-secondary stage
schemes.eligibility: Indian nationals belonging to Scheduled Tribes; for studies in India, awarded by State where applicant is permanently settled; recognised post-matric/post-secondary courses in recognised institutions (excluding Aircraft Maintenance Engineer's, Private Pilot Licence, Training Ship Dufferin (Rajendra), Military College Dehradun, pre-examination training centres); parents/guardians income from all sources not exceeding Rs. 2,50,000/- per annum
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance (scholarship) to complete education; amounts not stated in circular
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply compulsorily online on National Scholarship Portal (https://scholarships.gov.in); portal opens 20th July 2022, last date 31st October 2022; institutes (with valid AISHE/DISE/NCVT code, KYC approved) verify and forward; verified applications to Directorate by 15th November 2022; institutes submit Annexure 'A' by 30th November 2022 to dir-tw.goa@nic.in
schemes.valid_period: Academic year 2022-23
schemes.notes: Circular No. DTW/4/PMS/Scheme/6/Circular/2022-23/2065; OCR date reads ') 9 /07/2022', taken as 19-07-2022 (matches posted date). Guideline copy enclosed but not in text.

schemes.name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre Matric Scholarship for students belonging to Scheduled Tribe community studying in class IXth & Xth
schemes.target: ST students in class IX and X
schemes.eligibility: Student belongs to Scheduled Tribe community; parents/guardians income not exceeding Rs. 2.00 lakh per annum; not availing any other centrally funded Pre Matric Scholarship; regular full-time student in Government school or school recognized by Govt./Central/State Board; scholarship for a class only for one year (no scholarship for repeated class).
schemes.benefit: Pre-matric scholarship (financial assistance to families); amounts not stated in circular.
schemes.how_to_apply: Online on National Scholarship Portal https://scholarships.gov.in (open from 20 July 2022; last date 30/09/2022). Fresh (IX) students register; X students renew. Documents (fresh): attested Income Certificate, Caste Certificate, Bank Pass Book copy, Marksheet, Bonafide Certificate; (renewal): Marksheet, Income Certificate, Bonafide Certificate. School verifies and submits to District Nodal Officer.
schemes.valid_period: Academic year 2022-23; applications by 30-09-2022
schemes.notes: Circular No. DTW/6/Central Pre Matric/6/Circular/2022-23 (date illegible in OCR, August 2022). Encloses DBT Mission letter dated 15-07-2022 with NSP timelines (pre-matric: INO verification 16-10-2022, second level 31-10-2022; post-matric submission 31-10-2022).

schemes.name: Vidya Laxmi
schemes.target: ST girl children passing 10th and entering 11th standard
schemes.eligibility: Girl child who has passed 10th standard and gets admission in 11th standard of any stream (Science/Arts/Commerce/Vocational/ITI); all girl children of families notified as ST under Constitutional Order whose annual income does not exceed Rs. 3,00,000/- per annum
schemes.benefit: Rs. 26,000/- by way of fixed deposit in the name of the girl child and the Officer nominated by Government; paid to beneficiary only when she passes 12th standard Board Examination or equivalent within 3 attempts or within 2 years of first attempt, whichever is earlier; otherwise forfeited (also forfeited on drop-out)
schemes.how_to_apply: Proof of Aadhaar or Aadhaar authentication required (or Aadhaar enrolment application plus alternative documents: birth certificate/school ID, proof of relationship such as ration card etc.)
schemes.notes: Aadhaar Act section 7 notification (DTW/STAT/Aadhaar Notification/2020-21/21/4712, OG Series I No. 41 dated 6th January, 2022) restating scheme benefits; funded from consolidated fund of State of Goa. OCR text.

amendments.name: Amendment to Vidya Laxmi (clause 2)
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/5/Vidya Laxmi/Scheme/9/Amendment/2018-19/252. Benefit of Vidya Laxmi not stated in this document.

amendments.name: Vidya Laxmi
amendments.notes: Gazette index (Series I No. 3, 19-4-2018) lists Tribal Welfare Not. DTW/5/Vidya Laxmi/Scheme/9/Amendment/2018-19/252 at page 180 and Not. 1-53-2018-19/ADMN/PRE-MAT/DTW/243 'Scheme to provide Assistance in education to SC, ST & OBC children'; neither text is in the extracted pages (17 pages, trimmed). Amendment contents unknown.

amendments.name: Vidya Laxmi
amendments.notes: Notification DTW/5/Vidya Laxmi/Scheme/9/Amendment/2018-19/252 in same gazette. Only target group amended; benefit not in this text.

schemes.name: Vidya Laxmi Scheme for ST girl student
schemes.target: ST girl students admitted to Std XI
schemes.eligibility: ST girl student who passed Std X examination and gets admission in Std XI of any stream; annual family income not exceeding Rs. 3,00,000/-.
schemes.benefit: An amount of Rs. 25,000/- provided by way of Fixed Deposit in the name of the girl child; benefit released after passing the Standard Board examination (OCR reads "Xi" Standard Board") on submission of release form to the Directorate.
schemes.how_to_apply: Prescribed application form (from Directorate, Dy. Director office South Goa, or tribalwelfare.goa.gov.in) submitted through the Principal of the institute with photograph, attested mark sheet/passing certificate, income certificate, ST certificate, bank pass book. Institutes in North Goa submit to Directorate of Tribal Welfare, Shram Shakti Bhavan, Patto, Panaji; South Goa to Dy. Director of Tribal Welfare, Old Collectorate Building, Margao. Last date 30 November 2022.
schemes.valid_period: Academic year 2022-23
schemes.notes: Circular No. DTW/5/VIDYA LAXMI/Scheme/6/Circular/2022-23; OCR date '2० /07/2022' read as 20-07-2022 (Devanagari zero). Standard after which FD is released is OCR-garbled ('Xi"'), likely XII board exam - verify. Approval U.O. No. 2608 dated 15/07/2022 & U.O. No. 285 dated 18/07/2022.

schemes.name: Assistance towards Sugarcane supplied by the Sugarcane Growers (State Sector Scheme)
schemes.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with disabilities
schemes.target: Sugarcane growers in Goa
schemes.eligibility: All farmers cultivating sugarcane in the State of Goa; must possess valid Krishi Card issued by the Directorate of Agriculture; sugarcane area verified by Zonal Agriculture Office representatives with SSSKL Fieldman and area certificate issued; harvested cane inspected by SSSKL Fieldman or Agriculture Department representative and the farmer; farmer must load and bring harvested cane to Sanjivani Sahakari Sakhar Karkhana (SSSKL), Dayanandnagar, Dharbandora at own cost.
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance as per Fair & Remunerative Price (FRP) fixed by the National Federation of Co-operative Sugar Factories Ltd., New Delhi, from time to time, paid on actual tonnage of cane weighed at SSSKL weighbridge, for 2025-26 and 2026-27.
schemes.how_to_apply: SSSKL registers sugarcane farmers in May 2025; SSSKL submits details of farmers who supplied cane with weigh slips and signed GAR 32 to the Zonal Agricultural Office; Zonal Agricultural Officer verifies and forwards to District Agricultural Office, which issues Sanction Order; assistance drawn and disbursed by Zonal Agricultural Officer.
schemes.notes: Issued by Department of Agriculture, Directorate of Agriculture (Not. 3/Crops & PP/41/Sp.Asst.Sugarcane/25-26/D.Agri/134); header department is DEPwD because it appears in the same gazette (Series I No. 7, 15-05-2025). Withdraws the earlier 'Special Assistance for Sugarcane Grower' scheme notified 10-06-2021. Not the portal-titled scheme.

schemes.name: Divya Niwaas Yojana
schemes.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with disabilities
schemes.target: Registered organisations running residential facilities/half way homes for persons with disabilities
schemes.eligibility: Any registered voluntary organization, NGO, Government organization or institution engaged in empowerment of PwDs; registered under Section 50 of RPwD Act, 2016; minimum 20 inmates at time of applying; at least 1 year field experience in empowerment of PwDs; financial viability to independently run the facility for minimum three months in case of delays/discontinuation; good reputation with no criminal cases registered; capable of community mobilization and networking; accessible physical and digital infrastructure. Clauses 4(2), 4(3), 4(4) not applicable to Government organizations.
schemes.benefit: Operational grant (recurring) for homes for PwDs: Medical Officer/Counsellor/Therapist Rs. 60,000/- pm; Administrative staff Rs. 1,34,000/- pm (Manager Rs. 20,000, Clerk Rs. 18,000, 6 Attendants/Care takers/Aaya/Driver @ Rs. 16,000 = Rs. 96,000); Administrative expenses Rs. 46,000/- pm; Food Rs. 1,20,000/- pm; Medical Rs. 40,000/- pm; Total Rs. 4,00,000/- pm. Plus one-time grant of Rs. 50,000/- for furniture, utensils etc. once in five years. Reimbursement of actual expenditure: organisation bears 25%, department refunds 75%; released in 2 installments a year (second on Utilization Certificate, Form 12A GFR 2017).
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in prescribed proforma Annexure-I, II & III to DEPwD with report of last 1 year field experience, Section 50 RPwD registration certificate, audited annual accounts for last one year, list of inmates (Annexure-II), details of amenities/services, affidavit by NGO President (rest trimmed). Grantee open to inspection by Assistant Director.
schemes.notes: max_benefit_inr is the monthly operational grant ceiling (Rs. 4.00 lakhs per month). Food line reads 'Rs. 200/- per 20 inmates' as printed. Non-submission of UC/audited accounts within six months disqualifies future grants. Trimmed: later clauses and document list cut. Same gazette (15-05-2025) also contains the sugarcane scheme (extracted under 9286f3c768) and the High Support scheme (not in extract).

schemes.name: Divyang Bandhan Yojana
schemes.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with disabilities
schemes.target: Married couples where one or both partners are persons with disabilities
schemes.eligibility: Applicant resident of Goa for the last 15 years; must apply within three years from date of marriage; marriage took place in Goa or registered in Goa; husband and wife living together for not less than two years; at least one partner a person with disabilities with minimum 40% disability; combined annual income certificate from Competent Authority not exceeding Rs. 8.0 lakhs p.a.; not eligible again for a second marriage to a PwD partner after dissolving the first marriage for which award was availed; cannot be claimed as a matter of right.
schemes.benefit: Monetary award to the extent of Rs. 1,00,000/- paid to the partner who is a person with disabilities (if both are PwDs, paid jointly in the name of both).
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in Appendix-I signed by both husband and wife, submitted to the Department through the respective Block Development Officer, with: Marriage Certificate from Sub-Registrar showing registration in Goa; UDID Card/Enrolment slip; BDO certificate (Appendix-II) that couple has lived together not less than two years; joint declaration (Appendix-III); pre-receipt of Rs. 1,00,000/- countersigned by BDO; bank passbook copy (joint account if both PwD); also income certificate, disability certificate, Aadhaar per checklist. BDO enquires into bona fides and forwards to DEPwD; Director DEPwD sanctions.
schemes.valid_period: Until further orders; to be reviewed and revamped after three years from notification
schemes.notes: Notified as an amendment of the 'Rules regulating the Grant of Awards for Marriage with Disabled Persons', replacing them with this full scheme. Award recoverable as arrears of Land Revenue if obtained by false information. Not trimmed.

schemes.name: Divyang Kaushal Yojana
schemes.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with disabilities
schemes.target: Registered organisations running sheltered workshops/skill training for persons with disabilities (above 18 years)
schemes.eligibility: Registered Organizations/Government Organizations/NGOs/Trusts/Institutions engaged in empowerment of PwDs; registered under Section 50 of RPwD Act, 2016; minimum enrolment of 20 persons with disabilities (PwD defined as above 18 years of age); sanctioned units restricted to six per District; at least 3 years field experience; financial viability to sustain the workshop for minimum six months in case of delays/discontinuation; good reputation with no criminal cases; capable of community mobilization; accessible physical and digital infrastructure; affidavit that assistance under a similar scheme of another department not availed. Clauses 4(2), 4(3), 4(4) not applicable to Government organizations.
schemes.benefit: Recurring operational grant: 1 Vocational in charge Rs. 25,000/- pm; 2 vocational assistants/special educators @ Rs. 20,000/- pm each for 20 PwDs = Rs. 40,000/- pm, plus 1 more per additional 10 PwDs (maximum 4, Rs. 80,000/- pm); 1 clerk cum accountant Rs. 18,000/- pm; 2 Attendant/Care taker @ Rs. 16,000 = Rs. 32,000/- pm; Administrative expenses Rs. 15,000/- pm; Transport allowance @ Rs. 2,000/- pm per inmate Rs. 40,000/- pm; Food (Rs. 200/- per inmate) Rs. 1,20,000/- pm (additional Rs. 200 per inmate above base number); Total Rs. 2,90,000/- pm. Plus one-time grant of Rs. 10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten lakhs only) for setting up the workshop, furniture, machinery, 50% cost of raw material etc., once in five years. Reimbursement basis: organisation bears 25%, department refunds 75%; 2 installments a year. Entire profit to be distributed to the PwDs in the workshop.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in Annexure I, II & III to the Director, Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Porvorim, with report of last 3 years field experience, Section 50 RPwD registration certificate, audited accounts for last one year, list of PwDs (Annexure-II), details of workshop activities, affidavit of NGO President, bank passbook copy. Sanctioned by committee chaired by Minister for DEPwD.
schemes.valid_period: Until further orders; to be reviewed and revamped after three years from notification
schemes.notes: max_benefit_inr is the one-time setting-up grant (Rs. 10,00,000); monthly operational ceiling is Rs. 2.90 lakhs per month. Grant table numbering skips VI-VII as printed. Trimmed: some clauses (interpretation, documents iv) cut. Small Devanagari share in text but content is English.

One NGO/Trust selected per district (North and South Goa). Affidavit that similar assistance from other department not availed.
schemes.benefit: Recurring grant-in-aid for honorarium of staff and operational expenses (Annexure III): Psychologist/Clinical Psychologist 2 x 20000 per person; Occupational Therapist/Physiotherapist 2 x 60000 per person; Audiologist/Speech Therapist 2 x 60000 per person; Special Educator 2 x 20000 per person; Social Worker 1 x 20000; Project Co-ordinator 1 x 45000; Data Entry Operator 2 x 18000 per person; MTS/Cleaner 2 x 16000 per person; Driver 2 x 16000 per person; POL (fuel) diesel up to ceiling of 336 litres p.m. and repairs/maintenance Rs. 75000 p.a. or actual whichever is less. 5% increase in honorarium after every twelve months on renewal. Released quarterly on utilisation certificate, staff attendance and vehicle log book.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application in Annexure I to Director, Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Porvorim, with registration certificate and MoA, RPwD Act registration certificate, Managing Committee resolution, CA-audited accounts of last two years, activity report, and affidavit of non-availment; verified and forwarded to Selection Committee (Minister DEPwD, Secretary, Director, State Commissioner).

schemes.name: Grant of Scholarship to Students with Disabilities
schemes.department: Department for Empowerment of Persons with disabilities
schemes.target: Students with benchmark disabilities pursuing higher, technical, professional, music or vocational education
schemes.eligibility: Regular student of a recognized Board of Education or University (also extended to Music and Vocational Courses through recognized Board/University); benchmark disability i.e. 40% or more as defined in RPwD Act, 2016; combined income certificate from Competent Authority not exceeding Rs. 8.0 lakhs p.a.; not in receipt of any other scholarship from any other source; more than one child with disabilities in a family are both eligible; must have UDID Card, Aadhaar card and Aadhaar-seeded bank account; repeaters in a standard not eligible (failure can be condoned at Director's discretion); full-time or correspondence course in institution affiliated to Board/University (other course conditions partly trimmed); those who received free craft training/general education under Govt schemes eligible for higher technical training/higher education, but switching from craft training to academic courses or vice-versa not considered; those receiving free boarding/lodging from voluntary/State source eligible at day-scholar rate if tuition fees paid.
schemes.benefit: Scholarship: Std IX to XII Rs. 900/- p.m.; B.A./B.Com./B.Sc. Rs. 1100/- p.m.; M.A./M.Com/M.Sc. and other Professional courses Rs. 1300/- p.m. Reader's allowance for visually impaired students (if certified by head of institution): Rs. 300/- / Rs. 530/- / Rs. 600/- p.m. respectively. Hostel allowance (certified by Head/hostel warden): IX to XII Rs. 400/- p.m.; B.A./B.Com./B.Sc. Rs. 500/- p.m.; M.A./M.Com/M.Sc. and Professional courses Rs. 450/- p.m. Academic year taken as 11 months; paid through ECS.
schemes.how_to_apply: Application to the Department for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities within the period specified from time to time, with Disability Certificate issued by Goa Medical College Bambolim, District Hospital North/South or Institute of Psychiatry and Human Behavior, Bambolim; Income Certificate from Competent Authority; (remaining document list trimmed). Payment disbursed through ECS after G.A.R 33 is furnished by the school/institution; Director is sanctioning authority.
schemes.notes: max_benefit_inr is the monthly scholarship rate (Rs. 1300 p.m.); reader and hostel allowances are additional per month. Supersedes 'The Grant of Scholarship for Differently Abled Persons' (Not. dated 20-05-2008). Scholarship may be cancelled/withheld for failure, unsatisfactory progress/conduct, or false information. amendments.notes: Notification No. 3/crops & PP/67/CGF/2021-22/D.Agri/399; Official Gazette Series I No. 21 dated 19-8-2021.

amendments.name: Assistance for Community Farming (amendment)
amendments.benefit: Assistance of 90% for Community Farming Projects irrespective of category of group on standard cost/GSR for common infrastructure; machinery assistance only after completion of 1st year of cultivation (Custom Service Support for hired machinery in 1st year; value-addition/post-harvest machinery allowed in 1st year); infrastructure assistance limited to Rs. 2.50 lakhs per ha irrespective of area; para A(iv) deleted; DAO forwards proposal for evaluation before High Power Committee.
amendments.notes: Notification No. 3/2/1/Crop&PP/Agron/CFG/D.Agri/76; Official Gazette Series I No. 14 dated 4-7-2019. Max is per ha.

schemes.name: Assistance for High Yielding and Certified Seed
schemes.target: Farmers growing paddy, pulses, oilseeds and field crops
schemes.eligibility: Farmers growing paddy, pulses, oil seeds and other field crops in Goa (individually or jointly as group members); Farmers Clubs, Farmers Associations and SHGs registered under Societies Act and/or with NABARD or Directorate of Agriculture with members cultivating field crops.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy at source: farmers purchase seed at 50% of cost directly from the approved co-operative societies (Goa Bagayatdar Sahakari Khareedi Vikri Saunstha, Goa Krishi Bazar Marketing and ... etc.)/departmental sub-offices; society reimbursed by Department. Per-farmer seed limit applies (figure not legible), not applicable to groups.
schemes.how_to_apply: Buy seed at 50% cost at approved co-operative society outlets; societies bill Department via Zonal Agriculture Officer.
schemes.valid_period: Immediate effect
schemes.notes: Notification No. 3/4/Agron/PPG/3-2(1)/2013-14/D.Agri; appears in later-page excerpts (Official Gazette Series I No. 15 dated 11-7-2013). Trimmed: details may be on later pages.

schemes.name: Assistance for Purchase of Agriculture Inputs
schemes.target: Scheduled Tribe farmers
schemes.eligibility: Applicant farmer belonging to Scheduled Tribe; should possess cultivable land in own name or on lease or other written agreement.
schemes.benefit: Assistance of 75% of the cost of inputs (seed, planting material, pesticides, soil conditioners, bio-fertilizer etc.) with maximum subsidy limit of Rs. 12000/ha; maximum area 2.00 ha per farmer for one crop season, limited to subsidy of Rs.24000/-.
schemes.how_to_apply: Purchase inputs, then submit claim to Zonal Agriculture Officer with Form I & XIV, original bills/cash receipts, caste certificate, ECS mandate form and Form GAR 32. ZAO verifies and recommends; Plant Protection Section sanctions; paid by ECS.
schemes.valid_period: 5 years from notification in Official Gazette
schemes.notes: Gazette Series I No. 38 dated 20-12-2019 (Not. No. 3/Crops & PP/27&31/SCP/TSP Scheme File/2019-20/D.Agri/302). OCR errors in text. Portal title says 'Scheduled Tribe Farmers Assistance for Purchuse'.
